title: BDR HubSpot & RevOps
description:
elefante RevOps | HubSpot Diamond Partner | Remote


We're hiring an SDR to be the front line of our growth engine.

At elefante RevOps, we don't just implement HubSpot — we build the revenue machines behind some of the fastest-growing B2B companies. As a HubSpot Diamond Partner, we help businesses turn their CRM into a competitive advantage.

This role isn't about smiling and dialing into the void. You'll be working real inbound leads, building relationships across multiple channels, and handing qualified opportunities to our AE team with full context and momentum.

What You'll Own


Pipeline Generation You'll be responsible for turning marketing-qualified leads into sales-qualified opportunities. That means fast response times, sharp discovery conversations, and clean handoffs that set our AEs up to close.

Omnichannel Outreach Email, LinkedIn DMs, SMS, WhatsApp, phone — you'll meet prospects wherever they are. No single-channel reps here. You'll craft personalized sequences that actually get replies.

LinkedIn Presence You'll post on LinkedIn at least 3x per week. Not recycled content — real insights about RevOps, HubSpot, and the problems our prospects face. You'll build your personal brand while building our pipeline.

Discovery That Qualifies You'll run discovery meetings scored against our SPICED framework. We're not looking for someone who books meetings for the sake of it — we want someone who qualifies hard so our AEs walk into real opportunities.


The Numbers That Matter
  • Respond to inbound MQLs within 10 minutes
  • Post on LinkedIn 3x per week minimum
  • Book 3 discovery meetings per week
  • Run discovery meetings with a 70%+ SPICED score
  • Generate 2 SQLs per week
  • Handover SQLs to AE with full context and next steps


What We're Looking For
  • Experience in B2B SaaS sales development or business development
  • Familiarity with HubSpot CRM (or similar platforms — Salesforce, Pipedrive)
  • Strong written and verbal communication across multiple channels
  • Comfortable on camera and on LinkedIn — you're not shy about putting yourself out there
  • Understanding of sales frameworks (SPICED, MEDDIC, BANT, or similar)
  • Self-starter who thrives in a fast-paced, remote environment
  • Fluent in English (Portuguese is a plus)


Why elefante
  • HubSpot Diamond Partner — you'll learn from practitioners who live in the platform
  • Remote-first culture with a global team
  • Direct path to AE — we promote from within

Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.

title: BDR HubSpot & RevOps
description:
elefante RevOps | HubSpot Diamond Partner | Remote


We're hiring an SDR to be the front line of our growth engine.

At elefante RevOps, we don't just implement HubSpot — we build the revenue machines behind some of the fastest-growing B2B companies. As a HubSpot Diamond Partner, we help businesses turn their CRM into a competitive advantage.

This role isn't about smiling and dialing into the void. You'll be working real inbound leads, building relationships across multiple channels, and handing qualified opportunities to our AE team with full context and momentum.

What You'll Own


Pipeline Generation You'll be responsible for turning marketing-qualified leads into sales-qualified opportunities. That means fast response times, sharp discovery conversations, and clean handoffs that set our AEs up to close.

Omnichannel Outreach Email, LinkedIn DMs, SMS, WhatsApp, phone — you'll meet prospects wherever they are. No single-channel reps here. You'll craft personalized sequences that actually get replies.

LinkedIn Presence You'll post on LinkedIn at least 3x per week. Not recycled content — real insights about RevOps, HubSpot, and the problems our prospects face. You'll build your personal brand while building our pipeline.

Discovery That Qualifies You'll run discovery meetings scored against our SPICED framework. We're not looking for someone who books meetings for the sake of it — we want someone who qualifies hard so our AEs walk into real opportunities.


The Numbers That Matter
  • Respond to inbound MQLs within 10 minutes
  • Post on LinkedIn 3x per week minimum
  • Book 3 discovery meetings per week
  • Run discovery meetings with a 70%+ SPICED score
  • Generate 2 SQLs per week
  • Handover SQLs to AE with full context and next steps


What We're Looking For
  • Experience in B2B SaaS sales development or business development
  • Familiarity with HubSpot CRM (or similar platforms — Salesforce, Pipedrive)
  • Strong written and verbal communication across multiple channels
  • Comfortable on camera and on LinkedIn — you're not shy about putting yourself out there
  • Understanding of sales frameworks (SPICED, MEDDIC, BANT, or similar)
  • Self-starter who thrives in a fast-paced, remote environment
  • Fluent in English (Portuguese is a plus)


Why elefante
  • HubSpot Diamond Partner — you'll learn from practitioners who live in the platform
  • Remote-first culture with a global team
  • Direct path to AE — we promote from within
  • You'll work with real inbound demand, not cold lists

title: AI Engineer (LATAM)
description:
Company Description

Rounds is revolutionizing the hiring process by enabling teams to identify top AI-native candidates with unmatched accuracy and speed. Powered by Sophia, our AI agent, Rounds learns from your team’s dynamics, top performers, and the critical success factors for a role to provide evidence-based recommendations. Our approach focuses on identifying candidates who will excel in their roles, beyond just performing well in interviews. Backed by prominent supporters such as NeetCode, Z Fellows, LeapYear, and the CEO of Wellfound, Rounds is shaping the future of AI-driven hiring.


Role Description

This is a full-time role for an AI Engineer where you will:

  • Build and improve AI systems that generate and evaluate real-world interview simulations
  • Design evaluation frameworks that measure reasoning, tradeoffs, and decision-making
  • Work with LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic) to create reliable, high-signal outputs
  • Identify failure modes in AI behavior and improve system robustness
  • Collaborate closely with product and founders to define what “good” looks like in hiring
  • Ship quickly and iterate based on real usage


Qualifications

  • Strong software engineering fundamentals (ability to build end-to-end systems)
  • Experience working with LLMs in production environments
  • Ability to critically evaluate AI outputs and identify weaknesses
  • Comfortable working in ambiguous, fast-moving environments
  • Strong product intuition and attention to detail


Nice to have:

  • Experience with LLM evaluation, benchmarking, or prompt systems
  • Background in developer tools, infrastructure, or systems design
  • Experience building 0→1 products

title: Senior Frontend Developer
description:
A Arena.im é uma startup de IA do Vale do Silício , com um aporte de $16M e investida por CRV, Redpoint e Craft Ventures. Nossos clientes incluem ESPN, Red Bull, Disney e NFL . Junte-se ao time e ajude a construir aplicações em tempo real que atingem 180M de usuários mensais.


Na Arena, você vai trabalhar em problemas técnicos de verdade, em escala global:

  • Construir sistemas de mensagens em tempo real para suportar 500 mil+ usuários simultâneos por aplicação
  • Garantir alta disponibilidade em aplicações que rodam nas homepages e apps de alguns dos sites mais acessados da internet

Colabore com engenheiros de alto nível, com forte expertise em AI Agents

title: Video Editor
description:
Podify is a podcast production company that offers podcast editing, video editing, web development, and writing services. We are looking to expand our team of in-house video editors as full-time team members who are dedicated, reliable, and talented.


About the Role:

Today it is essential for a podcast to have a video. Our team is composed of video editors and production experts who deeply care about the quality of the shows they work on. As part of the video editing team, you will be responsible for taking raw video and audio files as well as edited podcast episodes and converting them into long-form and short-form videos. You will work closely with our creative directors, audio editors, and project managers to create visually stimulating video content. You will need to utilize motion graphics, subtitles, and B-rolls to help make every video professional and beautiful. We are looking for people who consider themselves artists and take great pride in telling visual stories. This is a FULL-TIME role and you will be expected to work a minimum of 40 hours per week.


Experience and Skills Necessary:


  • Adobe Premiere Pro
  • Adobe After-Effects
  • Adobe Audition
  • Sub-titling
  • Waves Plugins
  • Descript
  • Teamwork
  • Communication
  • Accountability
  • Self-awareness


Qualifications:


  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment
  • Confident in making strategic decisions
  • Creative and always think of what’s new and trending with video marketing
  • Have an excellent eye for design and attention to detail
  • Self-motivated, organized, accountable, and can communicate effectively to work within tight timelines
  • Highly creative and imaginative with a love for podcast/video
  • Proven experience as a video editor or related role
  • Experience creating video assets for radio/podcasts/podcast production is a big plus
  • Excellent writing, editing, and proofreading skills
  • Self-motivated, organized, accountable, and can communicate effectively while working within tight timelines
  • Incredible attention to detail, with a strong grasp of the English language and a knowledge of American English


Perks:


  • Hours are flexible. You don’t have to work at a specific time if the job gets done on time and you work the minimum number of hours (40 hours per week minimum)
  • Flexible Vacation, if you need time off, just let us know
  • Opportunity to advance/get bonuses, if you do an excellent job, we will give you a raise and bonuses.
  • Opportunity to receive company shares and/or options upon advancement
  • Paid for on-the-job learning. We expect you to want to get better at your job. We will pay you for the time you spend learning to advance your job skills. The number of hours will be approved by your manager


Pay:

Salary will be commensurate with qualifications and experience


About Podify:

Podify is a media services and technology company that specializes in the production and promotion of podcasts. We work with podcasters to provide audio & video editing, web development, writing, marketing, and social media management. Our clients subscribe to our monthly membership to receive these services and we create applications, technology, and automation tools to simplify the podcast production and promotion workflow.


Our Work Culture:

We are a global company and treat every member of the team like family. We believe that work should be enjoyable. We have a culture that allows every employee to manage their workload, so they are responsible for their own work and deadlines.


How to Apply for the job:

Apply here on LinkedIn or send an email to

a. Share 4-7 sentences on why you would like this position and why you are a good fit.

b. Links to videos you have edited that you are most proud of

c. Include your CV/resume with relevant job experience

d. Mention your expected salary in PKR value


IMPORTANT NOTE: If you have applied for this role before, please note if you were interviewed or just applied.

title: BDR HubSpot & RevOps
description:
elefante RevOps | HubSpot Diamond Partner | Remote


We're hiring an SDR to be the front line of our growth engine.

At elefante RevOps, we don't just implement HubSpot — we build the revenue machines behind some of the fastest-growing B2B companies. As a HubSpot Diamond Partner, we help businesses turn their CRM into a competitive advantage.

This role isn't about smiling and dialing into the void. You'll be working real inbound leads, building relationships across multiple channels, and handing qualified opportunities to our AE team with full context and momentum.

What You'll Own


Pipeline Generation You'll be responsible for turning marketing-qualified leads into sales-qualified opportunities. That means fast response times, sharp discovery conversations, and clean handoffs that set our AEs up to close.

Omnichannel Outreach Email, LinkedIn DMs, SMS, WhatsApp, phone — you'll meet prospects wherever they are. No single-channel reps here. You'll craft personalized sequences that actually get replies.

LinkedIn Presence You'll post on LinkedIn at least 3x per week. Not recycled content — real insights about RevOps, HubSpot, and the problems our prospects face. You'll build your personal brand while building our pipeline.

Discovery That Qualifies You'll run discovery meetings scored against our SPICED framework. We're not looking for someone who books meetings for the sake of it — we want someone who qualifies hard so our AEs walk into real opportunities.


The Numbers That Matter
  • Respond to inbound MQLs within 10 minutes
  • Post on LinkedIn 3x per week minimum
  • Book 3 discovery meetings per week
  • Run discovery meetings with a 70%+ SPICED score
  • Generate 2 SQLs per week
  • Handover SQLs to AE with full context and next steps


What We're Looking For
  • Experience in B2B SaaS sales development or business development
  • Familiarity with HubSpot CRM (or similar platforms — Salesforce, Pipedrive)
  • Strong written and verbal communication across multiple channels
  • Comfortable on camera and on LinkedIn — you're not shy about putting yourself out there
  • Understanding of sales frameworks (SPICED, MEDDIC, BANT, or similar)
  • Self-starter who thrives in a fast-paced, remote environment
  • Fluent in English (Portuguese is a plus)


Why elefante
  • HubSpot Diamond Partner — you'll learn from practitioners who live in the platform
  • Remote-first culture with a global team
  • Direct path to AE — we promote from within
  • You'll work with real inbound demand, not cold lists
  • Competitive base + uncapped commission on qualified pipeline


Ready to build pipeline and grow your career?

  • Drop a comment, DM me, or apply directly. Let's talk.

title: Video Editor
description:
Podify is a podcast production company that offers podcast editing, video editing, web development, and writing services. We are looking to expand our team of in-house video editors as full-time team members who are dedicated, reliable, and talented.


About the Role:

Today it is essential for a podcast to have a video. Our team is composed of video editors and production experts who deeply care about the quality of the shows they work on. As part of the video editing team, you will be responsible for taking raw video and audio files as well as edited podcast episodes and converting them into long-form and short-form videos. You will work closely with our creative directors, audio editors, and project managers to create visually stimulating video content. You will need to utilize motion graphics, subtitles, and B-rolls to help make every video professional and beautiful. We are looking for people who consider themselves artists and take great pride in telling visual stories. This is a FULL-TIME role and you will be expected to work a minimum of 40 hours per week.


Experience and Skills Necessary:


  • Adobe Premiere Pro
  • Adobe After-Effects
  • Adobe Audition
  • Sub-titling
  • Waves Plugins
  • Descript
  • Teamwork
  • Communication
  • Accountability
  • Self-awareness


Qualifications:


  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment
  • Confident in making strategic decisions
  • Creative and always think of what’s new and trending with video marketing
  • Have an excellent eye for design and attention to detail
  • Self-motivated, organized, accountable, and can communicate effectively to work within tight timelines
  • Highly creative and imaginative with a love for podcast/video
  • Proven experience as a video editor or related role
  • Experience creating video assets for radio/podcasts/podcast production is a big plus
  • Excellent writing, editing, and proofreading skills
  • Self-motivated, organized, accountable, and can communicate effectively while working within tight timelines
  • Incredible attention to detail, with a strong grasp of the English language and a knowledge of American English


Perks:


  • Hours are flexible. You don’t have to work at a specific time if the job gets done on time and you work the minimum number of hours (40 hours per week minimum)
  • Flexible Vacation, if you need time off, just let us know
  • Opportunity to advance/get bonuses, if you do an excellent job, we will give you a raise and bonuses.
  • Opportunity to receive company shares and/or options upon advancement
  • Paid for on-the-job learning. We expect you to want to get better at your job. We will pay you for the time you spend learning to advance your job skills. The number of hours will be approved by your manager


Pay:

Salary will be commensurate with qualifications and experience


About Podify:

Podify is a media services and technology company that specializes in the production and promotion of podcasts. We work with podcasters to provide audio & video editing, web development, writing, marketing, and social media management. Our clients subscribe to our monthly membership to receive these services and we create applications, technology, and automation tools to simplify the podcast production and promotion workflow.


Our Work Culture:

We are a global company and treat every member of the team like family. We believe that work should be enjoyable. We have a culture that allows every employee to manage their workload, so they are responsible for their own work and deadlines.


How to Apply for the job:

Apply here on LinkedIn or send an email to

a. Share 4-7 sentences on why you would like this position and why you are a good fit.

b. Links to videos you have edited that you are most proud of

c. Include your CV/resume with relevant job experience

d. Mention your expected salary in PKR value

title: Professor de Espanhol
description:
Faça parte da comunidade de professores que está transformando o ensino de idiomas no Brasil!


Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares!


A Idioma Independente , referência em inovação no ensino de idiomas, está buscando pessoas proativas, com perfil proativo e fluência em um segundo idioma, que querem ter sucesso no âmbito profissional, para se credenciar como professores e fazer parte da nossa comunidade engajada.


Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online: você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história.


Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de 22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco. Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível.


*Esta não é uma vaga CLT*


O que oferecemos?


  • Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora
  • Acesso exclusivo a uma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeos de treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis, com vídeos totalmente atualizados .
  • Mentorias semanais com especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais.
  • Plataforma exclusiva para acompanhamento das aulas.
  • Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar.
  • Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade.
  • Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser).
  • Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas.
  • Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente.


Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?


Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você.


Necessário:


  • Maior de 18 anos , fluente em Português e outro idioma.
  • Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar.
  • Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde.
  • Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.


O diferencial?


Aqui você é mais que um professor.


Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas , onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.


Esta não é uma vaga CLT , mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.


Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.


Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii com certeza é o seu lugar.


Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas. Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!


O que eu faço?


  • Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida
  • Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as
  • Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados
  • Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as
  • Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as
  • Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as


Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio.


QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?


  • Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês.
  • Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano.
  • Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos.


Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores.


Seja diferente, seja independente

description:
O Grupo Petrópolis é a única grande empresa do setor cervejeiro com capital 100% nacional. Produz as marcas de cerveja Itaipava, Cabaré, Crystal, Lokal, Black Princess, Petra e Weltenburger, Brassaria Ampolis com os rótulos Cacildis, Biritis, Ditriguis e Forévis, as vodkas Blue Spirit Ice e Nordka, a Cabaré Ice, os energéticos TNT Energy Drink e Magneto, o refrigerante It!, o isotônico TNT Sports Drink e a água Petra. Com oito fábricas em operação e aproximadamente 132 centros de distribuição, o grupo é responsável pela geração de aproximadamente 22 mil empregos diretos.


Por meio dos projetos ambientais, promove o plantio e manutenção de milhares de árvores, além de ações de sustentabilidade e programa de educação ambiental para escolas municipais. Conta também com o Saber Beber, programa comprometido em orientar as pessoas sobre os benefícios do consumo moderado e as consequências do consumo exagerado de álcool.


O respeito é um dos valores do Grupo Petrópolis, e por isso todas as crenças, identidades culturais, gêneros, idades, raças, opções individuais e pessoas com deficiência são respeitadas e valorizadas. Para todas as nossas vagas consideramos candidatos representados por esta ampla diversidade.


Buscamos profissional para atuar na gestão funcional e governança do ecossistema SAP de RH, com foco em SAP SuccessFactors (lado cliente, sem acesso a provisioning), SAP HCM migrando para SAP S/4, garantindo sustentação, evolução e alinhamento estratégico das soluções.

  • Acompanhar roadmap, tendências e atualizações SAP.

  • Entender e suportar as liberações de Acessos conforme papéis e responsabilidades da governança GP.
  • Módulos SFSF atualmente instalados: EP, LMS, Recruiting, Metas e Desempenho, Carreira e Sucessão.

2. Gestão de Sistemas Satélites

description:

Our roles are typically filled at lightning speed, so if you’re considering applying, get your application in quickly!



About the client

  • A global organization that acquires and scales vertical market software companies delivering mission-critical solutions in specialized industries.


  • The company focuses on long-term growth, operational excellence, and customer success, providing acquired businesses with a permanent home where they can continue to thrive.


  • Operating with an active mergers and acquisitions strategy, the organization creates a fast-paced environment where finance and operations teams play a crucial role in integrating new businesses and driving scalable processes.


About the role

  • The Lead Finance Systems (Oracle NetSuite) Specialist is responsible for leading end-to-end ERP integration projects for newly acquired companies.


  • This role focuses on migrating legacy financial systems into a centralized Oracle NetSuite environment and ensuring alignment with standardized financial processes.


  • You will oversee discovery, configuration, migration, and post-go-live support with minimal oversight.


  • Working closely with finance leadership and operational teams, you will ensure data integrity, compliance, and successful adoption of the new systems.


  • This is a leadership role requiring both technical ERP expertise and strong project management skills.


Responsibilities

  • Lead end-to-end migration projects for newly acquired companies, including legacy ERP data migration and system configuration.


  • Conduct discovery sessions to understand current-state processes and design future-state configurations within Oracle NetSuite and connected tools.


  • Create and manage project plans, timelines, risks, and deliverables, ensuring on-time and high-quality execution.


  • Coordinate the migration of chart of accounts, vendors, customers, transactions, and ledger balances from legacy ERPs into NetSuite.


  • Lead configuration and deployment of core modules within NetSuite (e.g., GL, AP, AR, Fixed Assets, Bank Recs, etc.).


  • Standardize financial processes across acquired entities to align with group policies and reporting standards.


  • Collaborate with accounting and finance teams to ensure business readiness for go-live and support month-end close activities post-migration.


  • Serve as the primary point of contact for project stakeholders, including acquired company finance teams, internal technical resources, and group leadership.


  • Present regular updates and recommendations to the group finance and senior leadership.


  • Document system configurations, process flows, and migration procedures for knowledge transfer and audit purposes.


  • Contribute to the refinement of deployment methodologies and onboarding playbooks to drive scalability and efficiency.


Must have skills

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Information Systems, or a related field.


  • 4+ years of experience in ERP migration, financial systems implementation, or post-merger integration.


  • Hands-on experience with Oracle NetSuite, including system configuration and data migration.


  • Strong understanding of finance and accounting processes, including multi-entity, intercompany, consolidation, and reporting structures.


  • Proven ability to manage complex projects independently and communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.


  • Experience with SQL (4+ years).


  • NetSuite experience.


  • Architectural design experience.


  • Integration experience.


  • Leadership experience.


  • Strong analytical, organizational, and detail-oriented mindset.


Nice to have skills

  • CPA designation.


  • Experience with tools and technologies such as OneWorld, SuiteSuccess, SuiteCloud, ETL processes, CSV imports, data mapping, data cleansing, and integration frameworks.


  • Experience with the implementation and integration of financial systems.


  • Strong collaboration skills.


Conditions

  • Remote role (100% remote). Primary timezone: UTC-4 with at least 6 hours of overlap required with U.S. time zones.


  • Contractor role — 12-month contract, renewable.


  • Full-time dedication (40 hours/week).


  • BYOD (bring your own device) required.

title: SAP S/4 HANA Application Architect - Product Management (Arquitecto de aplicaciones SAP S/4 HANA - Gestión de productos) - End-user Support/Consultant
description:
ASSA ABLOY Global Solutions is rolling out SAP S/4 HANA across the Division which will enable and support its business expansion strategy in line with the new operating business model.


Primary Job Purpose

Responsible to support and assist in the design and implementation of the Supply Chain Operations template including configurations and determining the best ways to use S/4 HANA by merging business and IT needs and focusing on utilizing the system for the greatest efficiency and utilization.


Work very closely with Lead Solution Architect – Sales & Operations to meet SAP implementation deliverables.


Key Position Accountabilities

  • Being part of Global IT team and responsible for SAP MM (Materials Management) and Variant Configuration related system configuration and associated developments are designed, built, tested & deployed according to S/4 HANA best practices.
  • Lead and Support the Product Management Area in the SAP implementation project from solution and architecture perspective and ensure timely completion of related project activities with key focus on quality.
  • Facilitate and support Solution Architects, Workstream managers & leads right from requirement gathering, solution design with focus on Material master data processes and integration of same with sales and Customer Service, finance & Operation workstreams.
  • Responsible for creating/maintaining functional specifications for WRICEF (Workflow, Report, Interface, Conversion, Enhancement, Forms) objects.
  • Analyse, create and document business processes during the project implementation.
  • Support larger project team during configuration, testing, training, migration, cutover, go-live and up-grade phases.
  • Support incidents or change requests for the live Business units.


SELECTION CRITERIA

Essential:

  • Bachelor / Master's degree in Business, Computer Science, or equivalent discipline is required with minimum 10 years of consulting experience with multiple Industries.
  • Minimum 2 full lifecycle implementations / roll outs & support project experience in the area of material master data, data modelling, data governance in S/4 HANA or SAP ECC Projects with knowledge of integration across financial and logistics processes in SAP as a lead subject matter expert.
  • Hands on experience defining various types of Material master, Variant Configuration, Bill of Materials, Class & Characteristics and Object dependencies.
  • Should have demonstrated hands-on experience in delivery of large, complex, global engagements involving multi-currency, multi-location, multi-organization complexities.
  • Should have solution design capabilities to reengineer business processes, sound knowledge of process modelling, ERP and packaged application fit/gap analysis, addressing critical business challenges typical to the industry or regional process nuances.
  • Understanding on SAP Best Practices and knowledge in Master data, MM module, their integrations & technology.
  • Ability to learn new tasks quickly; demonstrate flexibility when presented with change.
  • Lead and support a team environment.
  • Strong communication skills in English, self-driven and motivated.
  • Ability to manage and deliver multiple priorities in a constrained timeline


Desirable:

  • SAP S/4 HANA Certification in SAP MM.
  • Knowledge of new features in SAP S/4HANA like embedded analytics, user experience using Fiori, SAP cloud platform


WORK ENVIRONMENT FACTORS

  • Office based/Remote with occasional international travel.
  • Health and Safety accountability statements.
  • Working times are European time zone, however open to be available in US/APC time zone as well for the need basis.

title: Cybersecurity Customer Success Manager - Brazil
description:
WHO ARE WE?

We are a bunch of super enthusiastic, passionate, and highly driven people, working to achieve a common goal! We believe that work and the workplace should be joyful and always buzzing with energy!


CloudSEK, one of India’s most trusted Cyber security product companies, is on a mission to build the world’s fastest and most reliable AI technology that identifies and resolves digital threats in real-time. The central proposition is leveraging Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning to create a quick and reliable analysis and alert system that provides rapid detection across multiple internet sources, precise threat analysis, and prompt resolution with minimal human intervention.


Founded in 2015, headquartered at Singapore, we are proud to say that we’ve grown at a frenetic pace and have been able to achieve some accolades along the way, including:


CloudSEK’s Product Suite:

  • CloudSEK XVigil constantly maps a customer’s digital assets, identifies threats and enriches them with cyber intelligence, and then provides workflows to manage and remediate all identified threats including takedown support.
  • A powerful Attack Surface Monitoring tool that gives visibility and intelligence on customers’ attack surfaces. CloudSEK's BeVigil uses a combination of Mobile, Web, Network and Encryption Scanners to map and protect known and unknown assets.
  • CloudSEK’s Contextual AI SVigil identifies software supply chain risks by monitoring Software, Cloud Services, and third-party dependencies.

Key Milestones:

  • 2016 : Launched our first product.
  • 2018 : Secured Pre-series A funding.
  • 2019 : Expanded operations to India, Southeast Asia, and the Americas.
  • 2020 : Won the NASSCOM-DSCI Excellence Award for Security Product Company of the Year.
  • 2021 : Raised $7M in Series A funding led by MassMutual Ventures.
  • Awards & Recognition : Won NetApp Excellerator's \"Best Growth Strategy Award,\" CloudSEK XVigil joined NVIDIA Inception Program, and won the NASSCOM Emerge 50 Cybersecurity Award.
  • 2025 : Secured $19 million in funding led by Tenacity Ventures, Commvault.


Role Overview:

As a Customer Success Manager at CloudSEK, you will be the primary point of contact for a few strategic accounts, ensuring they derive maximum value from our cybersecurity solutions. Your role will involve deep engagement with clients, providing expert guidance on threat management, and ensuring seamless integration and utilization of CloudSEK’s products. Your background in cybersecurity will be crucial in understanding and addressing the specific needs and challenges faced by our clients.


Your mission->

I. Account Management:

  • Manage and nurture relationships for a client accounts, ensuring high levels of customer satisfaction and retention.
  • Conduct Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) and Annual Business Reviews (ABRs) to assess and enhance customer engagement.
  • Visit customers twice a year to strengthen relationships and understand their evolving needs.

II. Cybersecurity Expertise:

  • Provide expert guidance on threat intelligence, data leak prevention, and other cybersecurity issues.
  • Act as a security analyst, offering insights and recommendations based on threats generated by CloudSEK’s platform.
  • Collaborate with customer security teams to ensure optimal usage of CloudSEK’s solutions.

III. Customer Engagement:

  • Develop and execute customer engagement strategies to build strong relationships with key stakeholders, including CXOs and CISOs.
  • Foster customer champions within client organizations to drive advocacy and referrals.
  • Generate and share client-specific quality reports, gathering feedback to continuously improve service delivery.

IV. Revenue Generation and Retention:

  • Identify opportunities for upselling and cross-selling CloudSEK’s products and services.
  • Ensure on-time renewals and maintain a high customer retention rate.
  • Source referrals and participate in revenue generation activities.

V. Product Usage and Feedback:

  • Ensure 100% product usage for features subscribed by the customers.
  • Conduct configuration reviews and provide recommendations for product enhancements.
  • Gather and analyze customer feedback to contribute to product development and improvement.

VI. Operational Excellence:

  • Maintain accurate records of customer interactions and activities in CRM systems.
  • Contribute to the team by sharing knowledge, conducting training sessions, and writing internal articles.


What we're looking for:

  • 4-5 years of experience in Cybersecurity, Client-facing experience, or a related role in the cybersecurity industry.
  • Strong understanding of cybersecurity principles, threat intelligence, and digital risk management.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build strong relationships with clients.
  • Proven track record of achieving customer success goals and driving revenue growth.
  • Ability to work independently and manage multiple accounts simultaneously.


Cookie points if you have experience in the below skills:

  • Business reviews
  • Onsite meetings
  • Maintaining NRR and GRR
  • Threat analysis and Value delivery


Benefits of Joining CloudSEK

We provide an environment where you can develop and enhance your skills while delivering meaningful work that matters. You’ll be rewarded a competitive salary as well as a full spectrum of generous perks and incentives which include:

  • Flexible working hours.
  • Food, unlimited snacks and drinks are all available while at office.

And, the finest part is yet to come! Every now and then we ensure to unwind and have a good time together, which involves games, fun, and soulful music. Feel free to show off your artistic side here!


CloudSEK is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply.

Nossos valores são a nossa base: Cliente em primeiro lugar, Respeito, Espírito de Equipe, Responsabilidade e Eliminação de desperdícios.


E o nosso propósito resume a nossa essência: \"Nós desenvolvemos soluções de transporte sustentável para todos.\"

title: Senior Full Stack Software Engineer (React / Python / Go or Node.js or Java)
description:
We are seeking a remote, full-time Senior Full Stack Software Engineer with 8+ years of software development experience. Candidates must have a strong background in React.js and either Golang, Node.js, or Java experience with a strong desire to adopt Golang as the primary back-end technology.

In this position, you will play a foundational role in building the core platform that enables power utilities to shift from decades-old legacy systems into an AI-native future. Candidates must bring working proficiency with AI tools and APIs to ensure seamless integration of intelligent functionality into the client's products.

This role requires strong coding fundamentals, system design capability, and the mindset of a builder who thrives in a startup environment. You will work in small, agile teams reporting directly to the CTO, collaborating closely with AI engineers, security leaders, and product managers. Together, you will build and deliver AI-native services delivered at startup speed.

Our client is building the AI-centric operating system for utilities. It harnesses AI at the enterprise level to better orchestrate customer delight, facilitate power optimization, improve the health of the grid, and unlock flexibility at scale. Funded by a strategic industry partner and one of the founders at Groupon, the client is poised to transform how utilities run and how customers experience energy.


Responsibilities

  • Front-End Development : Build, implement, and maintain front-end applications
  • Back-End Architecture & Development : Design, implement, and maintain APIs, services, and distributed systems that form the backbone of the client's OS
  • AI Integration : Collaborate with AI engineers to integrate models, embeddings, and agent services into back-end systems. Operate AI APIs, ensuring outputs are production-ready and aligned with enterprise utility requirements.
  • System Modernization : Transform legacy workflows into modern, secure, scalable codebases using cloud-native best practices
  • Security & Compliance : Partner with security leaders to ensure all services adhere to stringent utility-sector regulations, implementing secure coding practices by default
  • Agile Delivery : Deliver features and improvements in cycles measured in weeks, balancing speed with reliability


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 8+ years of software engineering experience in SaaS or enterprise environments
  • Strong proficiency in React, Python, and either Golang, Node.js, or Java (non-Golang developers will learn and adopt Golang on the job)
  • Demonstrated ability to deliver high-quality code in fast-moving teams
  • Basic proficiency with AI/ML tooling (e.g., calling APIs, integrating model outputs)
  • Solid understanding of databases (SQL and NoSQL), message queues, and distributed architectures
  • Cloud-native engineering experience (AWS, Azure, GCP)
  • Clear communicator, adaptable, eager to learn and grow AI capabilities over time
  • Strong sense of ownership and accountability in small teams


Desired Experience

  • University degree or relevant industry experience
  • Experience working on ERP systems or within the power utilities industry


Additional Information

  • Enjoy a fun, fast-growing entrepreneurial company
  • Be part of a highly collaborative learning culture share knowledge, be inclusive, learn and grow together. Embrace teamwork!
  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with smart and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Lets learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent that enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

description:

title: LLM Data Specialist (Python, AI Annotation, Research Tasks)
description:
Title: LLM Data Specialist (Python, AI Annotation, Research Tasks)

Location : Kenya (Remote)

Job Type : short term Contract


Role Overview:

We are looking for highly analytical professionals to join as S3 Annotators, responsible for producing and validating advanced OpenClaw trajectories for research-oriented tasks involving ambiguous goals, multi-step reasoning, and long-context workflows. This role requires strong problem-solving ability, research thinking, and the capability to justify decisions while executing complex, multi-tool workflows used to train sophisticated AI agents.


What does day-to-day look like

  • Create and validate OpenClaw trajectories for complex, research-oriented tasks
  • Work on tasks such as data analysis, web research, and document synthesis
  • Operate under underspecified or ambiguous goals, making logical and defensible decisions
  • Use Python (notebooks, scripts) for data processing, automation, and analysis
  • Perform workflows spanning multiple tools, environments, and applications
  • Clearly document both what actions were taken and why they were taken
  • Review and improve trajectory quality for reasoning depth and correctness
  • Collaborate with teams to refine evaluation standards and annotation frameworks.


Requirements

  • Background in research, data science, engineering, or related fields (academic or industry)
  • 5+ years of experience in Python / Bash, including experience with notebooks and data wrangling
  • Experience with OpenClaw or similar advanced environments
  • Experience with web research, scraping tools, or data analysis workflows
  • Ability to articulate reasoning behind decisions and steps
  • Experience handling multi-step workflows across tools or platforms
  • Exposure to LLM-based tools, AI systems, or agentic workflows


Nice to have

  • Academic research experience (thesis, publications, lab work)
  • Familiarity with evaluation methodologies or experimental design
  • Experience in AI evaluation, RLHF, or advanced annotation workflow

title: Ruby on Rails Developer
description:
Senior Software Engineer I, L3 Messaging Team (Remote)

We're recruiting a Senior Software Engineer I to own the technical direction of a mission-critical messaging platform serving hundreds of healthcare organizations across the United States.


THE ROLE

Our client is a fast-growing, mission-driven organization transforming patient engagement at scale. They've built the leading platform powering communications for underserved populations, with proven impact reaching millions. Now they're looking for a seasoned backend engineer to lead their Messaging Team technical direction and mentor the next generation of engineering talent.


You'll own complex features end-to-end, drive architectural decisions that shape how millions of patient communications are delivered, and share team lead responsibilities with your peers. This is a highly visible, technically autonomous role with direct impact on health equity outcomes.


WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

  • 5+ years hands-on backend engineering with Ruby on Rails at scale
  • Deep experience building, maintaining, and scaling APIs and distributed systems
  • Advanced SQL skills and comfort working with large, complex datasets
  • Proven ability to independently own complex projects end-to-end and mentor junior engineers
  • Data-driven mindset you rely on evidence, not intuition
  • Excellent communicator (especially in fully remote environments)
  • Passionate about mission-driven work and advancing health equity


BONUS POINTS

  • Experience with Twilio, RCS, or MMS messaging platforms
  • Familiarity with healthcare compliance (TCPA, consent workflows, carrier regulations)
  • Tech stack: React, PostgreSQL, Google Cloud, Sidekiq
  • Event-driven architecture or high-throughput message delivery pipelines


WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Own and drive the technical direction of key messaging platform features
  • Design and build backend messaging systems (delivery pipelines, consent management, scheduling orchestration, API integrations)
  • Mentor L2 engineers, lead technical design discussions, and set engineering standards
  • Contribute to architectural decisions that shape messaging infrastructure at scale
  • Participate in on-call rotations (PagerDuty) and help improve team processes
  • Work cross-functionally with Product, Customer Success, and Data teams


YOUR IMPACT

  • Month 1: Master the platform architecture and contribute to technical design discussions
  • Month 3: Independently deliver complex features with meaningful impact on patient outcomes
  • Month 6: Be recognized as a technical leader driving strategic initiatives across the engineering department

title: Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager
description:
About NatureCo

NatureCo delivers nature-based solutions (NbS) for investors, corporates and other purpose driven organisations to scale up action on climate change and biodiversity loss. We specialise in nature-based project development including reforestation, agroforestry, farmer managed natural regeneration and mangrove restoration. NatureCo has extensive expertise in working with local communities to protect and restore natural ecosystems through participation in the global voluntary carbon market.

NatureCo is currently implementing a large-scale reforestation project in Brazil for the generation of verified carbon credits.

We are a diverse, mission-driven team that values inclusion, integrity, and innovation. NatureCo is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to building an equitable and inclusive workplace for all.

Role and responsibilities

The Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager is the primary field-based interface with landholders, communities, reforestation contractors, and other local stakeholders for NatureCo’s projects in Brazil. This position will build and manage a pipeline of landholders interested in reforestation, lead outreach and onboarding, coordinate site inspections, lead the collection of relevant data required for carbon standard checks, and lead signature of landholder agreements. The role will also play a key role in ensuring compliance (contracts and carbon standards) as well as coordinate schedules between landholders and contractors for the implementation of reforestation activities. This will include confirming site readiness, conducting periodic field quality audits, documenting and tracking progress, and resolving issues that could delay delivery or degrade quality.

The role requires a strong combination stakeholder engagement and management experience, and a commitment to quality and impact. The role requires extensive travel and field work across Minas Gerais, Bahia and Espírito Santo.


Primary roles and responsibilities include:

Landholder engagement, onboarding, and pipeline management

  • Map priority municipalities and referral partner networks (city governments, co-ops, farmer associations, NGOs); plan and run outreach activities, events and information sessions.
  • Manage the landholder onboarding process (identify → qualify → onboard → contract), using CRM/trackers to keep status, documents and next actions current.
  • Prepare clear information packs (benefits, obligations, timelines) and respond to inquiries in a timely, professional manner.
  • Maintain ongoing landholder relationship management to support retention, satisfaction, and smooth site access throughout implementation.

Eligibility, due diligence & agreements

  • Coordinate site inspections and initial diagnostics in consultation with other team members (parcel boundaries, vegetation status, access, water, risks).
  • Support land tenure verification and FPIC documentation
  • Lead closure of contract signatures.
  • Maintain organized repository of all landholder records within NatureCo’s data management system

(land titles, eligibility documents, contracts, site maps, inspection notes, photos, consultation records).

Reforestation delivery enablement

  • Translate signed landholder agreements into implementation-ready site plans (site-specific scope, access instructions, constraints, schedule windows).
  • Align field schedules with landholders and contractors to ensure access, minimize disruption to farm activities, and maintain trust and cooperation.
  • Support in the delivery of field delivery progress from contractors by site (start/finish dates, activities completed, challenges, next steps), and escalate issues early (access, weather delays, input shortages, labor constraints).
  • Support in monitoring reforestation activities (during and post planting) and coordinate, where required, rapid response with contractors/landholders (grazing, fire risk, pests, drought stress).

Stakeholder engagement and safeguards

  • Plan and document stakeholder consultations and community meetings in accordance with NatureCo policies and procedures (agendas, attendance lists, minutes, photos).
  • Support the team in the operation of the grievance mechanism: receiving grievances and responding in accordance with the NatureCo grievance mechanism.
  • Maintain landholder contact and ensure landholder information is kept up to date.
  • Coordinate access, for other project staff and contractors as required.

Reporting

  • Lead or assist the development of formal monthly, quarterly, and annual project implementation reports for internal and external stakeholders in line with contract and/or carbon standard requirements.
  • Prepare ad hoc reports, documents, and presentations for internal and external stakeholders.

Teamwork and culture

  • Support the management of a cross-functional, international team, fostering collaboration and ensuring that project milestones and goals are met.
  • Stay current on emerging best practices in NbS and carbon projects; proactively share insights across the organisation and with partners.


Skills and attributes

To perform successfully in this role, you will have:

  • A minimum of five (5) years of experience in reforestation projects with direct contact with rural landholders and reforestation planting service providers.
  • Degree in forest engineering, agronomy, ecology, or environmental science.
  • Intermediate English and native Portuguese language skills
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage confidently across cultures and stakeholder groups.
  • Strong project management skills, including experience managing timelines, deliverables, and working across multidisciplinary teams.
  • A proactive, self-starting approach with the ability to anticipate problems, adapt quickly, and take initiative under limited supervision.
  • A collaborative mindset and ability to lead and motivate internal teams and external partners
  • Ability to provide strategic and technical guidance across complex, multi-stakeholder projects.
  • Strong organisational skills and attention to detail in documentation and reporting.
  • A positive, energetic personality with resilience and drive to see projects through to delivery.


Extensive travel within Brazil is a requirement to perform this position.


Location

  • Remote, with residence in Minas Gerais, Espirito Santo, or Bahia


Submission instructions

  • Email CV and brief cover letter to with subject: Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager
  • Submission deadline: 30 March 2026

title: Back-End Developer Project (.Net / C#)
description:
We are seeking a remote, full-time Back-End Developer with 5+ years of experience and strong expertise in .NET and C#. This role focuses on ingesting and transforming data from multiple sources, running data validations, and ensuring high data quality across ETL pipelines and backend services. The ideal candidate has experience with APIs, legacy data migrations, and AWS-based data environments. Experience with ECS Fargate, SQS, Kinesis, Firehose, S3, and Apache Iceberg is a plus.

This project has a 3-6 month duration with a possibility for long-term engagement.

Our client is a leading energy technology company focused on digitizing fuel operations through a single, real-time platform. Their software connects people, equipment, and facilities to provide enterprise-wide visibility and data-driven insights that fuel asset optimization, improve operational efficiency, and help organizations manage risk, maintenance, and fuel logistics more effectively.

Responsibilities


  • Receive and process raw data from multiple internal and legacy systems.
  • Design and implement data transformation pipelines that convert incoming data into standardized formats.
  • Develop and maintain .NET / C# services and APIs used for data ingestion and transformation.
  • Build and execute data validation and quality checks to ensure the reliability and accuracy of data pipelines.
  • Support ETL processes, including exporting data from legacy systems and integrating it into modern platforms.
  • Work closely with existing engineers responsible for data migration and integration efforts.
  • Act as a data quality advocate, focusing on validating and testing data flows rather than application UI or front-end functionality.
  • Monitor and troubleshoot data pipeline performance and reliability.
  • Collaborate with engineering and data teams to improve data consistency, validation processes, and pipeline stability.


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication and teamwork skills
  • 5+ years of experience in software engineering or data engineering roles.
  • Strong experience with .NET and C# development.
  • Experience developing APIs and backend services.
  • Hands-on experience with data pipelines, ETL processes, and data transformation.
  • Experience implementing data validation and data quality checks.
  • Experience integrating data from multiple systems or legacy platforms.
  • Familiarity with AWS-based data infrastructure and services.


Preferred Experience

  • Experience with Python for data processing or scripting.
  • Experience working with Apache Iceberg tables for data lake management.
  • Experience with AWS data and streaming services, such as:
  • Amazon ECS Fargate
  • Amazon SQS
  • Amazon Kinesis
  • Amazon Kinesis Firehose
  • Amazon S3


Additional Information

  • Enjoy a fun, fast-growing entrepreneurial company, and work with smart and creative people
  • Be part of a highly collaborative learning culture - share knowledge, be inclusive, learn and grow together. Embrace teamwork!
  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter - think big!
  • Making mistakes is human - lets learn from them - be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual - no presumptions or judgment
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Bolsista Graduado Engenharia de Software - Grupo Boticário - Avanços em dados e produtos digitais para P&D - Talento Inovação IEL PR
description:

Ele convida indústrias a proporem projetos de Pesquisa, Desenvolvimento e Inovação (PD&I ) nos quais a participação dos bolsistas promova o crescimento profissional em PD&I empresarial e contribua para a inovação da empresa. O programa oferece bolsas para graduandos, graduados, mestres e doutores, permitindo atividades de PD&I nas instalações das empresas pelo território nacional, após aprovação da Comissão Interna do IEL Paraná.


Sobre a Oportunidade:


O Grupo Boticário é uma das maiores empresas de beleza do Brasil e referência em inovação, tecnologia e desenvolvimento de soluções que impulsionam a pesquisa e o negócio. Em um ambiente dinâmico e estratégico, a companhia investe continuamente em iniciativas que fortalecem sua transformação digital e ampliam sua capacidade de gerar valor por meio de dados.

Buscamos um bolsista para atuar em um projeto voltado à internalização e evolução de uma plataforma de dados e produtos digitais para P&D, apoiando a estruturação de processos, a automação de rotinas e a geração de insights para acelerar decisões e resultados.

Essa é uma oportunidade para contribuir com um projeto de alto impacto, conectando tecnologia, Engenharia de Software, ciência de dados e inovação em um dos maiores ecossistemas de beleza do país. Venha fazer parte dessa transformação no Grupo Boticário!


Projeto: Projeto de avanços em dados e produtos digitais para P&D


Formação Acadêmica:

Graduado em Engenheiro de Software, Ciência da Computação, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas.

Idioma:


Principais Atividades:

  • Executar testes de carga, testes unitários e de integração em ambiente de homologação;
  • Elaborar documentação técnica do código-fonte e da arquitetura da solução;
  • Criar manuais de utilização para os usuários pesquisadores;

Conhecimento Necessário:

  • Sólida experiência em desenvolvimento Back-end com Python 3.12+, Django e Django REST Framework;
  • Experiência em desenvolvimento Front-end com ReactJS e TypeScript, com uso de Design System;
  • Experiência com conteinerização de aplicações utilizando Docker e versionamento com Git;
  • Conhecimento e experiência em PostgreSQL, incluindo modelagem, queries e otimização;

Conhecimento Desejável:

  • Domínio em pipelines de processamento e integração de bases heterogêneas;

Formato de trabalho : Remoto.

Soft Skills : Proativo, Comunicação, trabalho em grupo, Flexibilidade, Agilidade, Resiliência.

title: ServiceNow Applications Engineer
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.


Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?

Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.


Sobre a posição

Estamos em busca de um(a) ServiceNow Applications Engineer com forte expertise em AppEngine , desenvolvimento de aplicações customizadas e automação de processos, para atuar em um ambiente altamente técnico e colaborativo.

O(a) profissional será responsável por liderar iniciativas de desenvolvimento, governança de plataforma e soluções de automação industrial, combinando visão estratégica, excelência técnica e interação com múltiplas áreas do negócio.


Principais Responsabilidades

  • Desenvolver aplicações e workflows customizados em ServiceNow (AppEngine, Flow Designer, IntegrationHub)
  • Projetar soluções escaláveis, seguras e aderentes às melhores práticas da plataforma
  • Integrar ServiceNow com sistemas externos via REST/SOAP
  • Criar e manter Script Includes, Business Rules, ACLs e UI Policies
  • Orientar desenvolvedores juniores e plenos, incluindo code reviews e mentoring
  • Garantir governança da plataforma, reusabilidade e qualidade técnica das entregas
  • Desenvolver e sustentar aplicações de processo e automação industrial, utilizando tecnologias de Controle Avançado e Otimizadores em tempo real
  • Participar de projetos estratégicos, atuando como referência técnica e colaborando em melhorias cross-funcionais


Requisitos Obrigatórios

  • Inglês avançado/fluente
  • Experiência sólida com:
  • JavaScript e Glide API
  • ServiceNow AppEngine
  • Flow Designer
  • Script Includes, Business Rules, ACLs, UI Policies
  • Integrações via REST/SOAP
  • Experiência com HRSD, S2P e outros módulos/plugins ServiceNow
  • Vivência com DevOps, ATF e GitHub
  • Experiência em automação industrial / controle de processos
  • Conhecimento em tecnologias de refino e processos químicos
  • Experiência com Multivariable Predictive Control (AspenTech DMC, Honeywell RMPCT)

title: AI Engagement Manager
description:

Dry Ground AI designs, builds, and maintains AI-powered solutions that accelerate operational velocity for small and mid-sized businesses. Our flagship AI Velocity Plan gives clients a rapid, iterative path from concept to production. You will be the linchpin who keeps those iterations moving forward.



Why This Role Matters


As Engagement Manager, you will own the post-sale customer journey: orchestrating handoffs from Sales to Engineering, driving on-time delivery, and continually identifying new ways to create value. You are part project conductor, part trusted advisor, and part growth catalyst.


Core Responsibilities


Project Leadership

  • Lead multiple AI implementation projects from kickoff through launch and optimization.
  • Create and maintain project plans, timelines, and risk logs
  • Hold engineering and data teams accountable for sprint deliverables, escalate blockers, and manage tradeoffs between scope and schedule.


Customer Success and Relationship Management

  • Act as the main point of contact for a portfolio of AI Velocity and maintenance clients
  • Conduct regular check-ins, business reviews, and planning sessions.
  • Communicate updates clearly and translate technical milestones into business impact.


Opportunity Expansion

  • Analyze client workflows and data to uncover new AI opportunities.
  • Frame and scope these opportunities as projects to add to the Velocity backlog.
  • Collaborate with Sales to support renewals and upsells.


Process Improvement

  • Improve our delivery playbook, templates, and dashboards.
  • Promote best practices in documentation, change management, and knowledge transfer.



Required Qualifications


  • Fluent English speaking and writing skills. You will run executive meetings and prepare client-facing materials.
  • 5 or more years managing complex software or data/AI projects.
  • Strong experience in customer-facing roles such as Customer Success, Consulting, or Solutions Delivery.
  • Comfortable engaging with technical teams about APIs, data pipelines, and ML concepts. You do not need to code, but must bridge the gap between business and technical language.
  • Proficient with tools like Notion, Jira, and Asana.
  • Analytical thinker who can read KPIs, prioritize work, and quantify ROI.
  • Employment verification, education verification, and an international background check will be required.
  • Must be authorized to work in your local jurisdiction.



Preferred Qualifications


  • Familiarity with GenAI, LLM tools, or MLOps platforms such as LangChain, Pinecone, or vector databases.
  • Understanding of B2B SaaS commercial models.
  • Certifications like PMP, PMI-ACP, or CSM are a plus.



What We Offer


  • High-impact role on a fast-moving team building innovative AI solutions.
  • Work from anywhere. We are a fully remote company with clients based in the U.S.
  • Competitive time off and flexible work environment.
  • Performance-based bonus opportunities.
  • Training and development support.
  • Work-from-home allowance.

title: Desenvolvedor Tasy
description:
Curte unir tecnologia, saúde e impacto real na vida das pessoas? Como Consultor Desenvolvedor Tasy EMR, você será peça-chave na evolução de soluções para hospitais e clínicas, ajudando a transformar a jornada de cuidado em algo mais ágil, seguro e inteligente.

Você vai atuar em uma empresa focada em inovação em saúde, com times multidisciplinares, ambiente colaborativo e espaço para propor melhorias de verdade.

  • Desenvolver, parametrizar e customizar módulos no Tasy EMR.
  • Levantar requisitos com áreas de negócio e traduzir em soluções técnicas.
  • Construir integrações (interfaces) entre Tasy e outros sistemas.
  • Realizar testes, homologação e suporte pós-implantação.
  • Documentar soluções, fluxos e boas práticas.
  • Apoiar usuários-chave em treinamentos e dúvidas.
  • Sugerir melhorias contínuas em processos e sistemas.


Requisitos obrigatórios:

  • Experiência comprovada com Tasy EMR (desenvolvimento, parametrização ou consultoria).
  • Vivência em ambiente hospitalar ou de saúde suplementar.
  • Conhecimento em banco de dados (SQL) para consultas e ajustes.
  • Experiência com análise de requisitos e desenho de processos.
  • Capacidade de comunicação clara com áreas técnicas e de negócio.

Diferenciais:

  • Experiência com integrações HL7, webservices, APIs ou ESB.
  • Atuação prévia em projetos de implantação ou migração de Tasy.
  • Noções de metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban).
  • Conhecimento em outros sistemas de gestão hospitalar/EMR.
  • Formação em TI, Engenharia, Sistemas de Informação, Saúde ou áreas correlatas.

title: Analista de Negócios de Tecnologia Sr.
description:
Já pensou em trabalhar em uma empresa líder global em dados, insights, consultoria e que contribui para o sucesso e crescimento das principais organizações do mundo?

Então essa é a sua chance!



Buscamos: Analista de Negócios de Tecnologia Sr.



Resumo:

Estamos em busca de um profissional com profundo conhecimento em metodologias ágeis, experiência comprovada na coleta de requisitos e atuação como Scrum Master, além de um backgroud em desenvolvimento de sistemas. O candidato ideal deve demonstrar habilidades em liderança de projetos e ser capaz de atuar como facilitador de equipes ágeis, assegurando a entrega de soluções de alta qualidade.



Atribuições :

  • Liderar projetos: Coordenar equipes e garantir a entrega de soluções de alta qualidade dentro dos prazos estabelecidos.


  • Auxiliar na definição e levantamento de requisitos: Elaborar e documentar histórias de usuário, assegurando que estejam claras, completas e alinhadas com as necessidades do negócio.


  • Elaborar e monitorar status reports: Acompanhar KPIs e métricas de desempenho dos projetos, fornecendo informações precisas sobre o progresso e as áreas de melhoria.


  • Fornecer suporte técnico ao time de desenvolvimento: Ajudar na resolução de problemas técnicos, apoiar a tomada de decisões e facilitar a comunicação eficaz entre os membros da equipe.


  • Colaborar com diversas áreas interdependentes: Trabalhar com diferentes equipes e stakeholders, tanto dentro quanto fora do departamento de TI, para garantir que os projetos atendam às expectativas e requisitos das partes interessadas.


  • Atuar como Scrum Master: Facilitar a execução das reuniões e eventos ágeis, promovendo a adoção das melhores práticas e garantindo a eficiência dos processos ágeis.


  • Prestar consultoria e suporte aos clientes internos: Orientar sobre as regras de negócio dos sistemas em utilização e assegurar que as soluções atendam às suas necessidades.



Requisitos :

  • Experiência mínima de 6 anos como Scrum Master ou analista de desenvolvimento, com atuação em levantamento de requisitos.
  • Formação superior completa ou cursando último ano em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia da Computação, Sistemas de Informação, Análise de Sistemas ou áreas correlatas de tecnologia.



Conhecimento técnico fundamental:

  • Experiência prévia como Scrum Master ou em um papel similar de liderança de projetos ágeis;
  • Sólido conhecimento e experiência em desenvolvimento de sistemas;
  • Experiência em liderança e gestão de projetos;
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de gestão ágil, como Azure DevOps.



Conhecimento técnico desejável:

  • Conhecimento básico na plataforma Azure (provisionamento, acesso e gerenciamento de recursos);
  • Conhecimento de práticas DevOps (containers, integração e deploy contínuo);
  • Conhecimento básico de Databricks;
  • Certificação de SCRUM Master.



Idiomas:

  • Inglês avançado fundamental;
  • Espanhol é um diferencial.




O que oferecemos?

Além de um clima descontraído e total open space, compartilhamos de alguns outros benefícios que trazem qualidade de vida e muita felicidade:



  • Vale Refeição e Alimentação
  • Horário Flexível
  • Modelo de trabalho remoto
  • Assistência Médica e Odontológica
  • Convênio Farmácia
  • Participação nos Lucros e Resultados
  • Previdência Privada
  • Licença Maternidade com duração de 6 meses
  • Licença Paternidade estendida com duração de 20 dias
  • Licença Maternidade/Paternidade para casais homoafetivos
  • Convênio com empresas parceiras
  • Programa de Qualidade de vida: Convênio com academias, palestras sobre temas relevantes, vacinação contra a gripe; Programa Global de Assistência ao colaborador e seus familiares (assistência jurídica, psicológica ou financeira) e muito mais
  • Programa de Mobilidade Interna: valorizamos talentos internos e por isso as vagas disponíveis são divulgadas internamente possibilitando ao colaborador mudar de área ou divisão diferente da que atua



Se o seu perfil corresponde aos nossos valores e objetivos, deixe seu currículo conosco e não perca a chance de fazer parte de nossa equipe. Esperamos por você!



No IBOPE a diversidade faz parte do negócio, gerando inovação e resultados. Não fazemos distinção de raça, religião, nacionalidade, gênero, identidade de gênero, orientação sexual, idade, deficiência, gravidez, estado civil ou qualquer outra forma de discriminação.

title: Systems Administrator, Senior
description:
Newfold Digital empowers the world’s business owners, content publishers, and those with ideas to control their online destiny with power and confidence. We enable everyone to be able to establish their online presence. From buying a domain and setting up a website, to growing their business and presence online, we come together to make sure small businesses have all the tools and support they need to achieve their goals.


We are seeking a seasoned Senior Systems Administrator to lead the management and optimization of our Cloudflare environment and broader cloud infrastructure. This role demands hands-on expertise in Cloudflare services—DNS, WAF, CDN, caching, proxy, and security configurations—to enhance the performance and protection of our global web platforms.


You will also manage cloud platforms such as OCI, AWS, Azure, or GCP, with a strong focus on Linux/Unix systems, automation, observability, and hybrid infrastructure operations.


Key Responsibilities


Cloudflare Administration

  • Manage DNS, WAF, firewall rules, caching, and rate limiting policies
  • Optimize proxy configurations, security settings, and performance features (e.g., Argo, Workers)
  • Mitigate threats (DDoS, bots) and conduct regular audits
  • Maintain documentation and stay updated with new Cloudflare features


Cloud & Infrastructure Management

  • Administer and optimize OCI or other cloud platforms (compute, storage, IAM, networking)
  • Automate deployments using Terraform, Ansible, and CI/CD pipelines
  • Monitor and troubleshoot performance using Grafana, Prometheus, Zabbix, etc


System Operations

  • Perform system maintenance and patching on Linux/Unix platforms
  • Troubleshoot OS, hardware, and database (MySQL/PostgreSQL) issues
  • Automate routine tasks via Bash, Python, or Ruby scripts

Required Skills

  • 3–5+ years of hands-on Cloudflare experience in production
  • Strong understanding of Cloudflare WAF, DNS, CDN, caching, and Zero Trust
  • Expertise in managing proxies (NGINX, HAProxy), DDoS mitigation
  • Scripting knowledge: Python, Bash, or Ruby
  • Proficiency with IaC tools (Terraform), observability (Grafana, Prometheus)
  • Solid networking fundamentals: TCP/IP, HTTP/S, DNS, TLS/SSL
  • Cloud experience with OCI or equivalent (AWS, Azure, GCP)

Preferred Experience

  • 6+ years managing hybrid cloud infrastructure
  • Experience with Cloudflare Workers, Pages, or Load Balancing
  • Familiarity with CI/CD, Ansible, Puppet, or OCI CLI
  • Security/cloud certifications (OCI, AWS, Azure)


Why you'll love us

  • We offer a 100% remote position with a monthly home office allowance of R$180.00 and an additional allowance for purchasing items for your office.
  • We provide Meal Vouchers or Food Vouchers worth R$44.55 per working day.
  • Health and dental insurance with no co-payment for employees.
  • Well-being program: Wellhub and Telemedicine!
  • Do you have a dog, cat, rabbit, hamster, goat, turtle, or even a mini dragon? We have a partnership for pet health insurance!
  • Life insurance.
  • Free website hosting.
  • Merit and promotion annual cycle.


And muuuuuuch more!
