title: Full Stack Developer
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, transparência, autenticidade, engenhosidade e empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores? Aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?

Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.


Nosso Cliente

Esta vaga atenderá nosso cliente, uma grande multinacional do segmento de petróleo e gás.


O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

  • Desenvolver aplicações web full stack utilizando combinações de .NET Core , C# , Node.js , React , Angular ou Vue .
  • Criar e integrar APIs RESTful , garantindo segurança, estabilidade e alta performance.
  • Construir funcionalidades robustas no front-end utilizando frameworks JavaScript modernos.
  • Trabalhar com Azure Web Apps , Azure SQL , Azure Functions e API Management para desenvolver soluções em nuvem escaláveis e seguras.
  • Colaborar em um ambiente Agile/Scrum , participando de refinamentos, plannings, reviews e cerimônias de time.
  • Utilizar GitHub para versionamento, code reviews, integração contínua e boas práticas modernas de desenvolvimento.
  • Realizar troubleshooting, debugging e otimizações de aplicações em ambiente de produção.
  • Implementar práticas de secure coding , garantindo conformidade, segurança e confiabilidade do software.
  • Aplicar habilidades analíticas em automações, manipulação de dados ou geração de insights quando necessário.
  • Contribuir para soluções digitais modernas, escaláveis e orientadas a dados, dentro de um ambiente global e colaborativo.


O que você precisa ter

  • Experiência sólida em desenvolvimento de software full stack.
  • Experiência prática com:
  • .NET Core e C#
  • Pelo menos um framework front-end moderno (React , Angular , Vue )
  • Node.js para serviços backend ou full stack com Vue
  • Experiência construindo e consumindo APIs REST .
  • Familiaridade com Azure SQL , Azure Web Apps e práticas de desenvolvimento em nuvem.
  • Entendimento sólido de versionamento com GitHub .
  • Vivência com metodologias ágeis e participação em times Scrum .
  • Conhecimento de boas práticas de secure coding .
  • Inglês avançado (escrita e conversação).


Será um destaque no seu perfil

  • Experiência com Python para analytics, automações ou utilitários backend.
  • Vivência com Azure API Management ou práticas de governança de APIs.
  • Conhecimento de ferramentas de trabalho ágil, como Azure DevOps (ADO) .
  • Capacidade de aplicar conceitos básicos de dados/analytics para enriquecer funcionalidades.
  • Experiência com consultas OData (especialmente em ADO ou outras APIs).


Onde você vai trabalhar

No conforto da sua casa. A posição é oferecida em regime 100% Home Office , com atuação para um time global e ambiente ágil.

title: Finance Manager
description:
About Us

Established in March 2018, Bybit is one of the fastest growing cryptocurrency derivatives exchanges, with more than 70 million registered users. We offer a professional platform where crypto traders can find an ultra-fast matching engine, excellent customer service and multilingual community support. We provide innovative online spot and derivatives trading services, mining and staking products, as well as API support, to retail and institutional clients around the world, and strive to be the most reliable exchange for the emerging digital asset class.


Our core values define us. We listen, care, and improve to create a faster, fairer, and more humane trading environment for our users. Our innovative, highly advanced, user-friendly platform has been designed from the ground-up using best-in-class infrastructure to provide our users with the industry's safest, fastest, fairest, and most transparent trading experience. Built on customer-centric values, we endeavour to provide a professional, 24/7 multi-language customer support to help in a timely manner.


As of today, Bybit is one of the most trusted, reliable, and transparent cryptocurrency derivatives platforms in the space.


Key Responsibilities

  • Oversee daily liquidity positioning in both BRL and digital assets, ensuring the firm meets all operational and regulatory obligations.
  • Maintain rigorous oversight of treasury-related accounting entries, ensuring accuracy in the general ledger and alignment with local Brazilian accounting standards.
  • Maintain accounting practices in strict accordance with the Accounting Standard for Institutions Regulated by the Central Bank of Brazil (COSIF), ensuring all financial statements are audit-ready.
  • Lead the preparation and timely submission of CADOC (Central Bank of Brazil Data Collection) reports, ensuring all financial data transmitted to regulators is accurate and consistent.
  • Implement and monitor ACAM frameworks to ensure the Brazilian entity remains within the risk appetite defined by the Central Bank and global HQ.
  • Develop and execute strategies to minimize idle cash, manage currency exposure (FX), and optimize transaction costs across local banking partners.
  • Act as the primary point of contact for local banking partners and regulatory bodies regarding treasury operations, audits, and financial inquiries.
  • Monitor market volatility and counterparty risk, implementing hedging strategies where necessary to protect the firm’s balance sheet.


Requirements

  • Experience: Minimum of 5–7 years of experience in Treasury, Corporate Finance, or Financial Operations, preferably within a Fintech, Bank, or Crypto-related institution.
  • Technical Knowledge: Deep understanding of Central Bank of Brazil (BCB) regulations.
  • Hands-on experience with CADOC reporting and ACAM risk management guidelines.
  • Strong background in Accounting (IFRS/CPC) and financial statement analysis.
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Economics, Finance, or a related field. Professional certifications (e.g., CRC, CFA, or specialized Treasury certifications) are a significant plus.
  • Language Skills: Fluency in English and Portuguese is mandatory, as you will collaborate with global teams and local regulators.
  • Crypto Proficiency: Familiarity with blockchain technology, wallet management, including understanding of blockchain custody, proof of reserves methodologies, and the specific dynamics of the VASP market in Brazil.

Será um grande diferencial se:

  • Conhecimento básico ou contato prévio com Docker, Ansible, Apache e Kong;

  • Conhecimento ou vivência em monitoração de serviços;

  • Espanhol e/ou Inglês em nível básico a intermediário;

O que oferecemos?

A HST é uma empresa certificada GPTW! Oferecemos a oportunidade de crescimento em um ambiente de desafios em que a contrapartida de cada Pessoa equivale ao tamanho da sua vontade de crescer !

  • Contratação em regime CLT;

title: Senior Data Product Analyst
description:
About Us:

YipitData is the leading market research and analytics firm for the disruptive economy and most recently raised $475M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation of over $1B. Every day, our proprietary technology analyzes billions of alternative data points to uncover actionable insights across sectors like software, AI, cloud, e-commerce, ridesharing, and payments.

Our data and research teams transform raw data into strategic intelligence, delivering accurate, timely, and deeply contextualized analysis that our customers—ranging from the world’s top investment funds to Fortune 500 companies—depend on to drive high-stakes decisions. From sourcing and licensing novel datasets to rigorous analysis and expert narrative framing, our teams ensure clients get not just data, but clarity and confidence.

We operate globally with offices in the US (NYC, Austin, Miami, Mountain View), APAC (Hong Kong, Shanghai, Beijing, Guangzhou, Singapore), and India. Our award-winning, people-centric culture—recognized by Inc. as a Best Workplace for three consecutive years—emphasizes transparency, ownership, and continuous mastery.


What It’s Like to Work at YipitData:

YipitData isn’t a place for coasting—it’s a launchpad for ambitious, impact-driven professionals.

From day one, you’ll take the lead on meaningful work, accelerate your growth, and gain exposure that shapes careers.


Why Top Talent Chooses YipitData:

  • Ownership That Matters : You’ll lead high-impact projects with real business outcomes
  • Rapid Growth : We compress years of learning into months
  • Merit Over Titles : Trust and responsibility are earned through execution, not tenure
  • Velocity with Purpose: We move fast, support each other, and aim high—always with purpose and intention

If your ambition is matched by your work ethic—and you’re hungry for a place where growth, impact, and ownership are the norm—YipitData might be the opportunity you’ve been waiting for.


About Signals:

  • Signals is YipitData’s Company Intelligence platform designed to help private equity firms, venture capital investors, finance, and corporate teams identify, diligence, and monitor software and technology companies using alternative data. Signals provides proprietary spend insights on 250K+ companies into a unified web platform, Chrome extension, and data feeds.
  • Customers use Signals to discover emerging companies, validate market trends, conduct diligence with deeper data (including invoice and product-level detail), and monitor portfolio performance using continuously refreshed alternative data


About The Role:

Our Signals product is quickly growing, and we are scaling our Data Product team to support new customer growth and product coverage expansion through our application, data feeds and AI agent experiences. We are looking for a highly skilled and experienced Senior Data Product Analyst to join our Data Product team. This individual will be responsible for managing a team of Data Product Analysts and will own end-to-end delivery for product initiatives, translating product goals into clear plans, leading execution, and ensuring impact across analysis, data operations, and QA workflows.


As a Senior Data Product Analyst, Team Lead, you will:

  • Own strategy and end-to-end execution for a portfolio of high-impact data product initiatives, driving measurable product value through strong product and data judgment
  • Lead a team of 2+ Data Analysts who:
  • Deliver product-facing analyses and datasets, turning messy inputs (ERP financial data, web scraped data, invoices) into clean data insights
  • Build and maintain evaluation datasets and QA guidelines to measure and improve our AI and LLM powered workflows including defining quality targets, running experiments, and iterating based on results
  • Partner with Engineering to translate product needs into scalable workflows for our data products including defining business rules /requirements and improving QA / validation logic
  • Work primarily in Databricks, Google Sheets and with our proprietary AI agent tools, leveraging SQL, PySpark, and Python
  • Operate as a player-coach, setting a high bar for speed, rigor, and innovation, balancing hands-on efforts yourself for the highest-impact work (complex analyses, ambiguous edge cases, AI evaluation design, and deep dive investigations) with coaching the team so execution scales beyond you
  • Own delivery planning and alignment, translate product goals into clear requirements and execution plans (scope, milestones, risks), apply strong product and data judgment to define what matters, and keep stakeholders aligned through consistent updates
  • Run delivery day to day, drive prioritization and tradeoffs across competing requests, ensure timelines are met, and track/report progress, blockers, and next steps against your plan
  • Partner cross-functionally with Data Science,Engineering, and other key teams to identify leverage points, shape solutions, and drive adoption of improvements that increase product value and operational scalability
  • Have the opportunity to grow your career in the team with increasing levels of responsibility and diversified ownership areas


You Are Likely To Succeed If:

  • You have 5+ years of experience as a Data Analyst, Data Scientist, Data Engineer or other technical function, including working with large datasets
  • You have 1+ years of experience leading others to deliver strong outcomes, through direct people management and/or team leadership (mentoring, coaching, setting direction, reviewing work, and driving accountability).
  • Nice to have: 1+ year of direct people management experience (including performance management)
  • You have experience working in a high-growth environment and managing many processes in parallel
  • You have experience owning end-to-end delivery for complex initiatives, applying strong product and data judgment to define success metrics, make pragmatic scope tradeoffs, and drive outcomes, including:
  • Scoping ambiguous problems
  • Building execution plans
  • Managing tradeoffs
  • Keeping stakeholders aligned through clear written and verbal updates
  • You are familiar working with large-scale datasets using Python and SQL (nice to have: PySpark, Databricks, and modern AI-assisted tools)
  • You have experience using AI and LLM tools to accelerate data work including generating/refactoring SQL and Python, exploring datasets, drafting labeling guidelines, and validating outputs before applying them to real workflows
  • You are excited to identify and pilot AI driven initiatives, turning repetitive manual work into scalable processes through automation and better tooling while balancing risks and accuracy considerations of new AI systems
  • You have experience with data transformation techniques, maintenance of data pipelines, and quality assurance techniques
  • You are excited about the potential to train and raise the team’s ability to own projects, execute independently, and deliver consistently
  • You are available to work US Eastern time zone hours
  • Advanced English proficiency (B2–C1 or higher).


What We Offer:

  • Our compensation package includes competitive salary and comprehensive benefit offerings.
  • Opportunities to build a career as a manager or individual contributor through our career ladder that promotes based on impact. You will have regular career conversations with your manager where you will discuss your short and long-term career goals. We are committed to helping you develop in your career and offer the potential for internal mobility opportunities
  • We care about your personal life, and we mean it. We offer flexible work hours, a remote-first work environment, flexible vacation, team events, learning reimbursement, and more!
  • Your growth at YipitData is determined by the impact that you make, not by tenure, unnecessary facetime, or office politics. Everyone at YipitData is empowered to learn, self-improve, and master their skills in an environment focused on ownership, respect, and trust.
  • Personal laptop
  • Health and wellness package


Candidates must have primary residency (and be physically located) in the country of hire (AKA Brazil) in order to be considered for the position. If hired, the worker must maintain primary residency in the country of hire in order to be eligible for employment.


We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer.


Kindly submit your application and CV in English.

title: AI Web Engineer (Systems & Automation)
description:
AI Web Engineer (Systems & Automation)

We’re looking for an AI web engineer who can both ship high-quality websites using tools like Claude Code and help us build a repeatable, scalable workflow for how we develop sites.

This role is hands-on. You’ll be building real client websites while also shaping how we do it as a team.


What you’ll do

  • Build production-ready marketing websites and web experiences using AI-assisted workflows (Claude Code, etc.)
  • Work directly from Figma designs and help define a clean Figma → code handoff process
  • Operate in a fast, iterative “vibe coding” style — rapid prototyping, refining, and shipping
  • Identify patterns across projects and turn them into reusable components, structures, and prompts
  • Help establish a repeatable blueprint for how we build websites with AI (structure, tooling, QA, deployment)
  • Collaborate with design and engineering to continuously improve speed and quality


What we’re looking for

  • 4–5 years of experience in web development / frontend engineering
  • Strong experience as a web engineer / frontend developer
  • Proven ability to ship complete websites (not just components or partial work)
  • Experience using AI tools in development workflows (Claude, Cursor, Copilot, etc.)
  • Comfortable working from Figma and translating designs into clean, production-ready code
  • Solid fundamentals in modern web development (HTML, CSS, JavaScript, frameworks as needed)
  • Ability to move fast, iterate, and make pragmatic decisions
  • Interest in systematizing workflows , not just building one-off projects


Nice to have

  • Experience creating internal tooling, templates, or developer workflows
  • Familiarity with design systems and component libraries
  • Experience working in agency or fast-paced product environments
  • Strong taste in UI implementation and attention to detail


What success looks like

  • You can take a Figma file and turn it into a live, polished website quickly using AI
  • You reduce build time across projects by introducing better workflows and patterns
  • You help turn “vibe coding” into a structured, repeatable system
  • The team can build faster and more consistently because of your contributions


About the role

  • Hands-on engineering role (this is not a pure systems or ops position)
  • High ownership and autonomy
  • Focus on speed, quality, and repeatability

title: Head of GTM & Growth | Valere Evolve
description:
About Valere Evolve

Valere Evolve is an AI transformation platform that accelerates AI maturity by unifying workforce education, custom development, knowledge capture, and autonomous execution into a single integrated system. Built on three connected pillars — Learn, Build, and Scale — each phase feeds directly into the next. Learning prepares the workforce. Labs builds the systems. Dactic captures institutional knowledge. Conducto orchestrates execution at scale. The result is a continuous transformation loop rather than a stack of disconnected tools and vendors. One platform. From ambition to AI-native operations.


The Role

As Head of GTM & Growth, you are the commercial engine behind Valere Evolve. You will own the full go-to-market strategy and growth execution — from market positioning and pipeline creation to partnership development and revenue scaling. This is not a planning role. You will be expected to build, launch, and iterate in market with the same hands-on urgency that defines the product itself.

You bring demonstrated experience taking AI products and platforms to market, using AI-native tools to scale your own work, and a track record of growing user bases through high-leverage execution. You have done this before. You know what it takes to move a technical platform from early adopters to scaled commercial traction, and you know how to do it with a lean, intelligent team.

This role requires the ability to execute across multiple simultaneous growth motions — and the strategic judgment to know when to lean into each one based on what the market is telling you.


Impact You Will Have

  • Own Market Entry & Expansion: Define and execute the GTM strategy across target segments, verticals, and channels — translating Valere Evolve's platform vision into a repeatable, scalable motion that drives pipeline and accelerates time-to-revenue
  • Build the Growth Engine: Design and personally run the growth infrastructure — outbound sequences, nurture flows, content strategy, and conversion optimization — leveraging AI-native tools to operate at a velocity that outpaces traditional GTM teams
  • Drive Strategic Partnerships: Identify, develop, and close high-leverage partnerships with channel partners, systems integrators, enterprise resellers, and platform ecosystems that unlock distribution and accelerate adoption at scale — structuring agreements that embed platform value directly into partner programs as a retention and growth mechanism
  • Expand from Within: Develop and execute playbooks that convert active client relationships into platform adoption, creating organic expansion from within accounts that are already experiencing Valere's value firsthand
  • Translate Product Into Commercial Narrative: Work closely with product and delivery to develop positioning, messaging, and sales enablement that clearly articulates the value of the Learn → Build → Scale loop to enterprise buyers
  • Convert Strategy to Revenue: Build the frameworks, KPIs, and real-time dashboards that connect GTM activity to pipeline health, conversion rates, expansion revenue, and customer acquisition cost
  • Scale the User Base: Execute demand generation and account-based programs that grow the active user base across direct, partner-led, and paid acquisition channels — with measurable growth targets tied to platform adoption milestones


Key Responsibilities

  • GTM Strategy & Multi-Motion Execution — Own the full go-to-market roadmap including ICP definition, pricing frameworks, and launch execution. You will design and operate across multiple distinct growth motions simultaneously, building the systems to manage, measure, and optimize each one with clarity and speed
  • Partnership Development & Distribution — Source and structure strategic partnerships that create meaningful distribution leverage — including experience embedding platform capabilities and educational content directly into partner programs, proposals, and client engagements. Own the full partnership lifecycle from identification through activation and ongoing revenue contribution
  • Account Expansion & Organic Growth — Build and execute the internal playbooks, enablement materials, and account triggers that convert existing relationships into platform adoption and drive organic growth from within active engagements. Identify the signals that indicate expansion readiness and move on them
  • Targeted Outbound & Enterprise Penetration — Execute precision outbound campaigns targeting key individuals and internal champions inside large organizations. Build the entry-point strategy, manage the champion relationship, and develop the expansion motion that follows initial adoption to grow platform footprint organically from the inside out
  • Paid Acquisition & Influence-Driven Demand — Build and manage a paid acquisition strategy that drives platform awareness and qualified demand at scale — including the identification and activation of credible voices in the AI and enterprise transformation space to amplify reach and accelerate top-of-funnel growth
  • AI-Native Operations — Build and operate GTM workflows using AI-native tools — from prospecting automation and pipeline intelligence to content generation and deal acceleration. You use the tools. You don't delegate the tools.
  • Revenue & Pipeline Ownership — Work directly with sales and leadership to manage pipeline, forecast accuracy, and growth targets. You are accountable to the number.
  • Market Intelligence — Continuously monitor the competitive landscape, buyer behavior, and adoption trends to sharpen positioning and identify untapped growth vectors across all active acquisition channels
  • Cross-Functional Alignment — Serve as the connective layer between product, delivery, and commercial teams — ensuring GTM motion is tightly integrated with product roadmap, customer outcomes, and client-facing team capabilities


What We Look For

  • Experience: 4+ years in GTM, growth, or commercial leadership roles, with at least 2 years of demonstrated experience bringing AI products or platforms to market in a hands-on capacity
  • AI Product GTM (Required): Proven track record of taking AI-native products or platforms from early traction to scaled commercial adoption. You understand the buyer journey, the objections, the trust barriers, and what actually moves enterprise deals forward
  • AI-Native Operator (Required): You actively use and scale your work with AI tools. You have built GTM workflows, systems, and processes powered by AI automation — not as a pilot, but as standard operating procedure
  • Multi-Motion GTM Execution (Required): Demonstrated ability to design and run multiple simultaneous growth motions — partner-led distribution, account expansion, precision outbound, and paid acquisition — and the strategic maturity to resource and prioritize across them as market conditions evolve
  • Partnership Builder: Demonstrated ability to develop and close strategic partnerships that create real distribution leverage — including experience structuring agreements where platform access or educational content is embedded as a core component of the partnership value proposition
  • Account Expansion Experience: Proven ability to convert existing client or customer relationships into product adoption — building the internal plays and triggers that drive organic growth from within active accounts
  • Enterprise Outbound & Champion Development: Hands-on experience running targeted outbound to individual practitioners and decision-influencers inside large organizations, with the ability to build internal champions and develop the expansion motion that follows initial adoption
  • Paid Acquisition & Influencer Marketing: Working knowledge of paid acquisition strategy in B2B and B2B2C contexts, including performance measurement, creator or partner identification, and building programs that sustain organic reach alongside paid investment
  • Strategic Mindset with Execution Bias: You can build the roadmap and execute it in the same week. You are equally comfortable in a board-level positioning conversation and building the outbound sequence that follows it
  • Data-Driven Growth: Fluency in GTM analytics, funnel metrics, and revenue operations. You build dashboards, track what matters, and adjust based on signal — not assumption
  • Communication: Ability to translate complex platform capabilities into compelling narratives for enterprise buyers, partners, and executive stakeholders across every channel and motion
  • Builder Mentality: You don't wait for a team or a budget to grow. You find leverage, build fast, and scale what works
  • Genuine Enthusiasm for AI: Deep curiosity about the evolving AI landscape and a conviction that AI transformation is the defining enterprise challenge of this decade


How to Apply

To be considered for this role, all applicants must submit a brief Loom or video recording (5 minutes or less) shared with , including two things:

  • A personal introduction — who you are, what drives you, and why this role and this moment in AI transformation excites you
  • A concrete GTM example — walk us through a specific product or platform you've taken to market. We want the real story: the motion you chose, the obstacles you hit, how you adapted, and the measurable outcome. Slide decks and polished narratives are not what we're looking for. Show us how you think and execute.

Submissions without a video will not be reviewed. We are not evaluating production quality — we are evaluating clarity of thought, commercial instinct, and evidence of hands-on execution.

title: Site Reliability Engineer
description:

  • Experiência com Git.


O QUE OFERECEMOS PARA VOCÊ

️ Vale Refeição/Vale Alimentação (flexível)

Assistência Médica

title: Software Engineer
description:
Exciting Career Opportunity: Software Engineer - Quality & AI Infrastructure

Location: Remote

Salary: $30K-$60K per year


Most of your time will be spent making our existing software more reliable. You'll dig into production bugs, trace them to root cause, and write the tests that should have caught them. You'll review pull requests in a way that raises the bar without demoralizing anyone. You'll tackle the tech debt that everyone complains about in retros but nobody picks up.


The other part — and this is growing — is our AI agent work. We're building tooling, orchestration, and evaluation systems for LLM-powered features. This isn't a research project. It's production software that needs the same rigor as everything else we ship. We need someone who can bring that rigor.


What you'll do

  • Debug and fix issues across the stack, from staging through production
  • Build meaningful test coverage (the kind that actually catches regressions)
  • Review code thoroughly — with context, not just style nits
  • Refactor the parts of the codebase that slow the team down

title: Research Engineer, RL Environments
description:
About Turing

Turing builds large-scale datasets and reinforcement learning (RL) environments that power post-training for the world's leading AI labs and enterprises, including OpenAI, Anthropic, Google DeepMind, Microsoft AI, Amazon, Apple, and many more. We create RL environments to evaluate and improve our customers' models on complex, multi-step workflows across high-value domains — designing the tasks, reward signals, and verifiers that drive measurable model improvement through RL training.


The Role

We are looking for a Research Engineer, RL Environments to help design and build frontier-quality RL environments, reward systems, and evaluations that improve state-of-the-art models for leading AI labs and enterprise clients.

This is a hands-on, research-facing technical role. You will work directly with customer researchers and engineers to translate their post-training and RL goals into concrete environment specs — designing tasks with verifiable outcomes, building reward and verifier systems, and ensuring environments are robust against reward hacking and distribution collapse.


We're targeting candidates with roughly 4–5 years of experience building deep learning or RL systems — especially where strong results depended on environment design, reward engineering, training infrastructure, or rigorous evaluation.


What You'll Do:

1. Design and build RL environments and verifier systems

  • Work with customer researchers to translate RL training goals into environment specs: target capabilities, task distributions, difficulty curves, and success criteria.
  • Design task suites with verifiable outcomes — single-step and long-horizon workflows with clear ground-truth signals.
  • Build reward functions, verifiers, automatic validators, and evaluation harnesses that provide reliable training signal and resist gaming.
  • Define environment interfaces: APIs, tool schemas, state abstractions, database schemas, and simulator-like dynamics that give agents realistic constraints.


2. Build quality systems that keep environments robust at scale

  • Audit environments and trajectories for subtle failure modes: reward hacking, leakage, ambiguity, distribution shifts, and degenerate task distributions.
  • Implement automated validation: deduplication, decontamination, consistency checks, difficulty controls, and diversity monitoring.
  • Develop synthetic task generation and augmentation pipelines: programmatic generators, controlled perturbations, hard negatives, and scenario templating with diversity constraints.


3. Prove impact through evaluations and training runs

  • Design and run evals reflecting customer-intended model capabilities.
  • Produce analysis connecting environment design choices to training outcomes: pre/post comparisons, error breakdowns, and ablations identifying which environment and reward attributes drive model lift.
  • When needed, run RL or fine-tuning experiments (or partner with research) to validate that your environments produce measurable improvement.


4. Collaborate with cross-functional delivery teams

  • Provide clear specs, examples, and edge cases to engineers, domain SMEs, and data production groups.
  • Run fast feedback loops based on trajectory analysis and quantitative signals.
  • Review and improve outputs from large-scale task and environment creation efforts.


Who We're Looking For:

1. Required Qualifications

  • 4–5 years of experience building or improving deep learning or RL systems where environment design, data quality, or reward engineering mattered materially.
  • Hands-on experience with reinforcement learning — any of: environment/gym development, reward design, PPO/GRPO/DPO, trajectory collection, or RL training infrastructure.
  • Strong intuition for what makes a good training task: verifiability, appropriate difficulty, resistance to shortcuts, and realistic constraints.
  • Demonstrated ability to be extremely detail-oriented in diagnosing subtle quality issues and failure modes in data or environments.
  • Python proficiency required; comfort with SQL and structured data workflows strongly preferred.
  • Ability to communicate clearly with researchers and engineers — turning RL training objectives into concrete environment specs.


2. Highly valued experience

  • Post-training experience: RLHF/RLAIF, verifier training, reward modeling, or constitutional AI methods.
  • Experience building custom gym environments, simulators, or distributed RL training systems.
  • Agentic evaluation: tool use, multi-step workflows, long-horizon tasks, trajectory analysis.
  • Systems thinking: ability to simulate an application's API and data schema and design tasks reflecting real-world constraints.
  • Experience with LLM fine-tuning at scale.


Why Turing

  • Work directly with the world's leading AI labs on the RL environments powering post-training for frontier models.
  • Real impact: your environments and reward systems will directly shape how models learn to reason, act, and improve.
  • Talent-dense team with high autonomy, rapid iteration, and an exceptional learning curve.


Values:

  • We are client first : We put our clients at the center of everything we do, because their success is the ultimate measure of our value.
  • We work at Start-Up Speed: We move fast, stay agile and favor action because momentum is the foundation of perfection
  • We are Al forward: We help our clients build the future of Al and implement it in our own roles and workflow to amplify productivity.


Advantages of joining Turing:

  • Amazing work culture (Super collaborative & supportive work environment; 5 days a week)
  • Awesome colleagues (Surround yourself with top talent from Meta, Google, etc. as well as people with deep startup experience)
  • Competitive compensation
  • Flexible working hours


Don’t meet every single requirement?

Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single qualification. Turing is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, protected veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristics. At Turing we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace and celebrate authenticity, so if you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

title: Senior Network Security Engineer
description:
The Network Security Engineer is responsible for protecting an organization’s networks and data from cyber threats. This role involves designing, implementing, and maintaining security infrastructure (firewalls, intrusion detection/prevention systems, VPNs, etc.) and monitoring the network for vulnerabilities or incidents. The engineer will play a critical role in upholding Zero Trust security principles and ensuring high availability and integrity of network services in a dynamic, cloud-enabled environment.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Security Infrastructure Management: Configure, deploy, and maintain network security systems (firewalls, IDS/IPS, VPN gateways, encryption devices) to safeguard internal networks and cloud environments.
  • Threat Monitoring & Incident Response: Monitor network traffic and logs for suspicious activities; promptly investigate and respond to security incidents or breaches to minimize impact.
  • Vulnerability Assessment: Conduct regular security audits, vulnerability scans, and penetration tests to identify and remediate network weaknesses. Implement patches and updates to address vulnerabilities and ensure systems are protected against emerging threats.
  • Access Control & Policies: Enforce access controls and network segmentation (supporting a Zero Trust Network Access model) by administering firewalls and network access control lists. Develop and update network security policies, standards, and procedures to align with best practices and compliance requirements.
  • Collaboration & Advisory: Work closely with IT infrastructure teams, application developers, and security architects to integrate security measures into new projects and systems. Provide guidance on secure network design and educate team members on security best practices.
  • Documentation & Compliance: Maintain detailed documentation of configurations, incidents, and changes. Ensure all network security measures comply with relevant regulations and industry standards (e.g., NIST, ISO 27001, PCI-DSS) and assist in preparing for security audits.

Required Qualifications & Skills:

  • Education & Background: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or related field (or equivalent work experience).
  • Technical Skills: Strong understanding of networking protocols (TCP/IP, DNS, VPN, etc.) and hands-on experience with network security technologies (firewalls such as Palo Alto/Cisco/Fortinet, IDS/IPS, VPN solutions, SIEM tools). Proficiency in configuring and managing firewalls and routing/switching equipment in complex networks.
  • Security Expertise: Knowledge of cybersecurity principles , threat landscape, and best practices (e.g., Zero Trust architecture, defense-in-depth, encryption, secure network design ). Ability to perform log analysis, intrusion detection, malware analysis basics, and incident handling.
  • Problem-Solving: Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills for diagnosing network and security issues. Ability to respond effectively under pressure during security incidents or outages.
  • Communication & Teamwork: Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Ability to work collaboratively with cross-functional teams, explain technical issues to non-technical stakeholders, and provide user training or guidance on security policies when needed.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Advanced/Cloud Security: Experience with cloud security (AWS, Azure, or GCP networking and security services) or secure network design in hybrid cloud environments . Familiarity with SASE (Secure Access Service Edge) frameworks or software-defined networking is a plus.
  • Automation & Scripting: Scripting or automation skills (e.g., Python, PowerShell) to automate network/security tasks and improve efficiency in security operations.
  • Advanced Education: Master’s degree in Cybersecurity or Information Systems.

Experience Requirements:

  • Experience: Minimum 5+ years of hands-on experience in network security, cybersecurity engineering, or a related IT infrastructure security role. Proven track record implementing and managing firewalls, IDS/IPS, VPNs, and performing security monitoring and incident response in an enterprise or managed services environment.

Certifications:

  • Industry Certifications: Professional certifications are highly advantageous . Preferred certifications include CISSP, CISM (for security management knowledge) or CEH, GIAC (for technical security skills). Vendor-specific certifications such as Palo Alto Networks PCNSE/PCNSA are also valuable and demonstrate expertise in relevant technologies.

title: Senior DevOps Engineer / Architect
description:
Senior DevOps Engineer / Architect


Location: Remote (Brazil)



About Sphise Technologies


Sphise Technologies is a global outsourcing and talent solutions company, partnering with high-growth businesses to build strong, high-impact teams across finance, technology, and operations. Our trusted technology partner is scaling a modern cloud platform and is seeking a Senior DevOps Engineer / Architect to lead infrastructure strategy and DevOps practices. As the platform continues to grow, this role will be instrumental in building scalable cloud infrastructure, strengthening CI/CD pipelines, and ensuring the platform remains secure, reliable, and cost-efficient.


Position Overview


We are looking for a Senior DevOps Engineer or Architect who will take ownership of infrastructure-as-code, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud operations. You will play a critical role in ensuring the platform is scalable, secure, and reliable while optimizing performance and cloud cost efficiency.

This position requires a hands-on technical leader who can collaborate closely with engineering, security, and product teams while mentoring developers on DevOps culture and tooling.



What You'll Do:


  • Design, build, and maintain infrastructure using Terraform , ensuring reproducible and version-controlled environments.
  • Own and manage Azure cloud infrastructure including networking, compute, storage, identity, and platform services.
  • Architect and maintain CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions for applications built with .NET, PHP, Node.js, React, and Next.js.
  • Implement best practices in pipeline automation, testing integration, artifact management, and deployment workflows .
  • Strengthen platform security by implementing IAM best practices, secrets management, network segmentation, and encryption strategies .
  • Integrate security scanning tools (SAST/DAST/SCA) and compliance checks into infrastructure and deployment pipelines.
  • Build and maintain observability using DataDog and SolarWinds , including monitoring, logging, dashboards, and alerts.
  • Define reliability standards including SLOs, SLIs, and incident response runbooks .
  • Optimize cloud infrastructure costs through resource tagging, autoscaling strategies, reserved capacity planning, and cost monitoring dashboards .
  • Collaborate with engineering teams to promote DevOps culture, automation, and self-service capabilities .



What You Bring:


  • 5+ years of experience in DevOps, Platform Engineering, or Site Reliability Engineering.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure cloud infrastructure .
  • Deep expertise with Terraform and infrastructure-as-code practices .
  • Proven experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions .
  • Strong understanding of cloud security practices , including IAM, secrets management, and vulnerability scanning.
  • Experience with Cloudflare services such as CDN, WAF, DNS, and Zero Trust.
  • Strong Linux administration and scripting experience (Bash, Python, or PowerShell ).
  • Experience working with SQL Server in cloud environments .
  • Hands-on experience with monitoring and observability tools such as DataDog or SolarWinds .
  • Strong communication and documentation skills.



Nice to Have

  • Experience with AWS infrastructure such as EC2, S3, RDS, IAM, EKS, or Lambda.
  • Experience with Databricks or modern data platform infrastructure .
  • Familiarity with policy-as-code frameworks such as OPA, Sentinel, or Azure Policy.
  • Experience working with Docker, Kubernetes, Helm, or container security practices .
  • Knowledge of FinOps practices and cloud cost optimization strategies .
  • Experience implementing SRE methodologies such as SLOs and error budgets .



What We Offer:

  • Competitive compensation package aligned with senior-level expertise.
  • Fully remote work environment with flexible collaboration across global teams.
  • The opportunity to shape and lead the DevOps architecture of a growing cloud platform.
  • Work with modern cloud technologies and engineering best practices .
  • A collaborative, engineering-focused culture with high ownership and impact .
  • Opportunities for professional development, certifications, and technical growth .

title: Founding QA / Test Automation Engineer (Full Stack, AI + Data Systems)
description:
Job Description

We’re a stealth startup backed by a repeat founder and top-tier investors.


We’re rebuilding the financial plumbing behind a trillion-dollar asset class — commercial real estate insurance — one of the largest, most archaic financial systems in the United States.


Today, this market still runs on manual workflows, fragmented data, and decades-old infrastructure.

Our top competitors represent over $300B in combined market value, and the core workflows in this industry have not been meaningfully disrupted in decades.


We’re building an AI-native platform that ingests fragmented insurance data across documents, APIs, and third-party systems, and transforms it into a unified, structured layer for underwriting and decision-making.


Incubated by a team that has already built two successful companies in this exact industry and ICP, we’re now assembling a world-class team to build the next one.


We are assembling the Avengers of financial services and insurance tech — a small, elite team of builders who want to define this category.


We’re looking for a Founding QA / Test Automation Engineer to ensure every data point we produce is correct, reliable, and production-ready.


This is not traditional QA. This is owning quality across AI systems, data pipelines, and critical financial infrastructure — where silent failures are unacceptable.


The Role

As the Founding QA / Test Automation Engineer, you will:

- Own testing across the full stack — frontend, backend, and AI/ML outputs

- Build testing infrastructure and CI/CD pipelines from scratch

- Design regression frameworks to detect accuracy drift across model and prompt changes

- Validate complex data pipelines where correctness is non-negotiable

- Define and enforce quality standards across deterministic systems and AI/ML outputs

- Work directly with founders and engineers to ship quickly without compromising quality

- Set the bar for all future QA and engineering hires


What You’ll Own

- End-to-end validation of data and document processing systems from ingestion through structured output

- Regression frameworks to ensure accuracy and consistency across evolving AI/ML systems

- API integration testing and validation of external data flows

- Frontend critical user flows across core product experiences

- CI/CD pipelines and automated quality gates across the stack

- Monitoring and alerting for production systems to ensure reliability at scale


Who Are You?

- You’ve tested systems where correctness actually matters (financial data, insurance, data infrastructure, or document processing)

- Experience at high-growth startups where speed and quality both matter

- You understand how to validate data pipelines and AI/ML outputs — not just web apps

- You’ve built or want to build automated testing frameworks from scratch

- Comfortable operating across backend systems, APIs, and frontend applications

- Highly technical, AI-native, and systems-oriented

- Relentless attention to detail — you catch what others miss


Technical Skills

- Python (pytest or similar)

- Playwright or Cypress

- CI/CD (GitHub Actions or similar)

- Experience testing APIs, data pipelines, and distributed systems


Bonus:

- Experience testing LLM or AI systems

- Experience building regression or evaluation frameworks

- Experience with document processing or OCR systems

- Experience working in insurance or insurtech environments


Culture & Expectations

This is an intense, output-driven environment.

We operate at high velocity with a small team of exceptional builders.

We operate on a 9-9-6 cadence — because rebuilding an industry demands it.

High ownership. High accountability. High standards.

We don’t care about pedigree, background, or years of experience. We care about ability.

We are looking for the top 0.0001% — people who take pride in building systems that must work.


Logistics

- Quarterly trips to NYC for collaboration


Compensation

Competitive salary

Meaningful equity

Leadership path fully uncapped for the right person


Who This Is Ideal For

A QA / Test Automation engineer who has operated as a founding or early QA hire (#1/#2) at a high-growth startup, or someone who has built and scaled testing infrastructure in fast-moving environments. You should genuinely believe you are the strongest QA engineers in any room and want the opportunity to own quality end-to-end — from building the testing foundation to shaping how an entire engineering organization thinks about correctness and reliability.


Why Join Now?

You’d be joining at the exact moment when:

- The company is fully incubated and de-risked by proven founders

- Two successful companies have already been built in this domain

- The wedge is validated, pipeline active, customers already aligned

- The market is at a breaking point and demanding change

- The next 18 months will define a multi-billion-dollar outcome


If you’re hungry, relentless, and want to help rearchitect a trillion-dollar market — reach out. There aren’t many chances to be this early on something this big.

title: Business Development Manager
description:
Native Teams is a global platform for work payments and employment. Beyond managing payroll, compliance, and taxes, we integrate financial tools to maximise the value of every work payment, worldwide.


We are expanding our global team and looking for a Business Development Manager to bring their wider knowledge and help us get our product and service more widely known and used.


In this role, you will play a key role in driving new business and revenue growth by managing the full sales cycle from outbound outreach to discovery, solution design, negotiation, and closing. You will work closely with prospective clients to understand their needs, educate them on Native Teams' solutions, and guide them through the decision-making and onboarding process. Your goal is to acquire new customers and expand revenue within assigned markets and ICPs.


Would you like to take on a new challenge in the field of sales in a successful, fast-growing global start-up?


Location: Remote

Salary range: Flexible


Key Responsibilities


Outbound & Pipeline Generation

  • Proactively identify and engage prospective clients through outbound outreach, networking, events, and other channels.
  • Execute outbound strategies tailored to defined ICPs and market segments.
  • Research accounts for understanding business context, hiring plans, and potential use cases.

  • Respond promptly and professionally in line with internal SLAs.
  • Run a structured qualification to assess fit and readiness.

  • Conduct high-quality discovery calls to understand client goals, blockers, compliance considerations, and service requirements.

  • Present tailored solutions, product overviews, and value propositions to multiple stakeholders.


Solution Design & Pricing

  • Prepare proposals, pricing scenarios, and competitive a/b options in line with commercial guidelines.
  • Guide clients on hiring models (EoR, Contractor of Record, etc.) and explain operational processes.
  • Work cross-functionally to ensure feasibility for legal, product, and finance-related questions.


Negotiation & Closing

  • Manage contract negotiations and commercial discussions through to signature.
  • Navigate procurement timelines, internal approvals, and stakeholder alignment.
  • Close new business and achieve monthly/quarterly revenue targets.


Pipeline Ownership & Forecasting

  • Maintain an up-to-date sales pipeline with accurate stage management and forecasting.
  • Log all activities, updates, and communication history in the CRM.
  • Prioritize high-impact opportunities while balancing follow-ups and nurturing.


Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with Customer Success, Legal, Finance, and Product teams to ensure a smooth client transition post-close.
  • Relay client feedback to internal stakeholders to support product and process improvements.
  • Represent the sales voice in outbound campaigns, ICP targeting, and revenue initiatives.


Market Feedback & Learning

  • Stay informed on industry trends, competitive offerings, and compliance developments.
  • Share insights from the market to improve positioning, messaging, and go-to-market strategy.



Requirements


  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, or related field (preferred, not mandatory).
  • Experience in outbound sales, B2B sales, or full-cycle sales roles.
  • Strong communication and client-facing presentation skills.
  • Confident running discovery calls, demos, and negotiations.
  • Familiarity with CRM systems (e.g., HubSpot) and sales outreach tools.
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple deals in parallel.
  • Ability to navigate ambiguity, work autonomously, and drive outcomes.
  • Fluency in English, written and spoken.



Benefits


  • Dynamic and interesting work in an early-stage, funded startup.
  • Ability to influence the next stages of our growth.
  • Experience working in the ever-changing world of FinTech.
  • Opportunities for professional and personal growth.
  • Flexible work environment.



Join our team at Native Teams, a fast-growing global start-up. We're looking for driven, passionate individuals to join us as we continue to expand our reach and impact.


At Native Teams, we pride ourselves on our dynamic and supportive work environment, where we encourage personal and professional growth. We believe in hiring talented individuals from diverse backgrounds, not only because we should do it but because fresh perspectives improve our team and our decisions. Our multicultural team is made up of young, energetic, and positive people who are passionate about what they do.


As part of our team, you’ll reflect the people we serve and will have the opportunity to work with thousands and impact millions of lives around the world.


If you're looking for a challenging and rewarding career and the chance to be part of a team that's making a real difference in the world, then we want to hear from you.


Apply now to join the Native Teams family and take the first step toward a brighter future!

title: Manager, Corporate Development
description:
Manager, Corporate Development at Healthcare Head Office


Perseus Group is a major Operating Group of Constellation Software (csisoftware.com | TSX:CSU), a Canadian-based publicly held company. Perseus Group has over 6,000 employees, across 70+ software business units, operating in 12+ software industry verticals, located in over 40 offices.


The Role

Perseus is growing the Business Development team within our M&A group. This role will be primarily focused on covering the Brazilian software market. The successful candidate must be based in Brazil.

The role is to build strong strategic business relationships that lead to the sourcing of current and future M&A opportunities for Perseus. Relationships will be formed with decision makers (i.e. CEOs/VPs of Corporate Development/founders/owners) of software companies globally, M&A advisors, and private equity/venture capital professionals. Success is defined by building and maintaining meaningful relationships, having clients sign LOI’s and ultimately, the acquisition of software companies/assets by Perseus/Constellation.

Initiating relationships, maintaining relationships, and ultimately being considered and chosen to be acquired by Perseus/Constellation typically takes multiple years. Measurable outcomes, continuous value-add through many M&A conversations/relationships and high-quality market research is what ultimately generates successful acquisitions through time.


Outcomes:

  • Develop and manage an M&A pipeline through Salesforce CRM and create market maps to build strong relationships in assigned software industry vertical(s)
  • Meet and exceed monthly M&A targets, such as meaningful contacts and other measurable M&A sourcing KPIs.
  • Work both autonomously and with M&A leadership to qualify M&A opportunities with efficiency
  • Ensure the lead database is allocated accurately within portfolio verticals
  • Effectively qualify opportunities at the top-end of the acquisition funnel to maintain focus for the Portfolio Managers of the business units.
  • Have a meaningful impact on Perseus Group over a successful tenure in-role


Relevant Experience & Competencies:

  • Experience in a Business Development/Sales position at a software company or client-facing M&A/finance role within business development, sales, and/or account management. Preference for experience in outbound-focused origination roles.
  • A clear interest in developing a long-term pipeline of meaningful relationships with prospects as a career trajectory within software investing.
  • Previous high-performance in Business Development, winning in an autonomous role or, prior success in other walks of life outside professional BD experience, such as entrepreneurship, will be considered.
  • Advanced verbal and written communication skills, with the confidence and executive presence to speak with CEOs, M&A advisors, corporate development, private equity and venture capital professionals.
  • Organized, detail oriented, and able to work variable hours.
  • Extraordinary work ethic, proactive with a sense of urgency.
  • Full fluency in Portuguese and at least professional-level fluency in English are required, Spanish fluency is a plus.
  • This role will require occasional in-person travel and can be primarily performed either Remotely within Brazil or from a Hybrid-Sao Paolo, Brazil office.

title: Desenvolvedor(a) Java Sênior
description:
Quem somos nós?


Somos um ecossistema de transformação digital que combina tecnologia e visão estratégica para escalar resultados e aumentar o valor entregue aos nossos clientes. Trabalhamos na construção de soluções inovadoras e disruptivas em mais de 300 projetos com grandes empresas nacionais de múltiplos segmentos.


Nosso propósito é impactar positivamente pessoas e negócios , exponencializando cada um para atingir seu máximo potencial. Respeitamos todas as diferenças e criamos um espaço aberto e livre para você ter autonomia, expor suas ideias, aprender com os erros, se conectar com outras pessoas e gerar mudanças ao seu redor .


Se você deseja estar em um ambiente colaborativo, desafiador e que incentiva você a sempre evoluir e ser o protagonista da sua história, aqui é o seu lugar!


Antes de avançarmos, é importante você saber que:

  • Contratação: CLT
  • Modelo de Trabalho: Remoto
  • Horário: das 9h às 12h e das 13h às 18h. A jornada é flexível conforme agendas e entregas. .
  • Etapas do Processo: Composto por 3 a 4 etapas, com um tempo médio de até 03 dias úteis entre uma etapa e outra.
  • Meios de Comunicação: Utilizamos E-mail e WhatsApp. Certifique-se de que essas informações estejam corretas no momento de inscrição para evitar falhas na comunicação.


O que buscamos?


Estamos em busca de um/uma Desenvolvedor(a) Backend Java Sênior para fazer parte do nosso movimento. Quem ocupar esta posição será responsável por implementar e orquestrar microsserviços modernos, arquiteturas orientadas a eventos (Kafka/RabbitMQ) assumindo entregas de ponta a ponta, da implementação ao deploy em produção. Esperamos que você encabece integrações complexas, atue no tuning avançado das aplicações e suas integrações com bancos de dados (SQL/NoSQL) e seja protagonista na adoção de tecnologias emergentes, além de criar ambientes de confiança para revisões de código de alto padrão.


Como será seu dia-a-dia?

  • Implementar e evoluir arquiteturas de aplicações de microsserviços e sistemas orientados a eventos, garantindo escalabilidade, resiliência e manutenibilidade ao longo do tempo;
  • Elaborar templates de arquitetura de aplicação de referência para o time, sempre que demandado;
  • Protagonizar decisões técnicas com visão de impacto, explicitando trade-offs para o time e para produto, mesmo em cenários com informações incompletas;
  • Garantir a estabilidade dos sistemas em produção, realizando a resposta a incidentes, definindo prioridades de correção e propondo melhorias estruturais para evitar recorrência;
  • Implementar e disseminar práticas de observabilidade (OpenTelemetry, APM com Datadog/NewRelic/Dynatrace) e tracing distribuído para aumentar a previsibilidade operacional;
  • Conduzir code reviews de alto padrão, orientando o time em boas práticas de arquitetura, design patterns, testes e segurança;
  • Atuar em integrações complexas com sistemas internos e externos, aplicando padrões de resiliência como Circuit Breaker, Retry, Fallback e SAGA;
  • Identificar gargalos e oportunidades de melhoria em queries SQL, estratégias de cache e configurações de pool de conexões para otimizar a performance das aplicações;
  • Apoiar diretamente líderes técnicos (Tech Leads) em acordos técnicos entre squad, produto e demais áreas, traduzindo complexidade técnica em impacto de negócio de forma clara e rastreável;
  • Explorar e adotar tecnologias emergentes de forma responsável, avaliando custo, benefício e risco antes da incorporação no stack do time.
  • Aprimorar continuamente os processos e práticas de desenvolvimento, aplicando técnicas de uso de Inteligência Artificial para otimizar o desenvolvimento de software, de forma avançada e responsável.


Para cumprir esse desafio, você precisa ter:


  • Profundidade em Java avançado: Multithread, gerenciamento de memória/GC, Virtual Threads (Java 21) e domínio das diferenças entre versões LTS, bem como domínio total de programação funcional;
  • Domínio amplo de Design Patterns com capacidade de reconhecer o momento certo de aplicá-los; entendimento de como a Injeção de Dependência funciona internamente (Reflection/Proxies);
  • Experiência sólida com Spring (Boot, Data, Security) e uso de frameworks reativos;
  • Domínio de estratégias de resiliência em integrações: Circuit Breaker, Retry, Fallback e SAGA (ex: Resilience4j); domínio do conceito de Idempotência;
  • Experiência prática e profunda com Kafka (Partições, Offsets, Consumer Groups) e RabbitMQ avançado (DLQ, Retry Policies, Exchanges);
  • Capacidade de realizar tuning de queries SQL, criação de índices, e estratégias de cache (local vs distribuído, TTL e invalidação);
  • Domínio avançado de pelo menos um banco de dados relacional e um banco NoSQL (MongoDB ou DynamoDB);
  • Domínio de observabilidade avançada com OpenTelemetry, pelo menos uma ferramenta de APM (Datadog/NewRelic/Dynatrace) e tracing distribuído;
  • Experiência prática com Kubernetes. Não irá administrar diretamente, mas é necessária experiência de interpretação do ecossistema;
  • Experiência prática com componentes de pelo menos uma Cloud (AWS ou GCP)
  • Capacidade real e experiência em Documentação como código usando Mermaid ou PlantUML através de arquivos markdown;
  • Domínio sólido de estratégias em pelo menos uma ferramenta de IA assistida (GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Antigravity ou Claude Code), bem como experiência prática de consumo de pelo menos 1 tipo de MCP Server através destas ferramentas.


Você irá se destacar se:


  • Ser committer ativo em repositórios open-source relevantes;
  • Experiência em tuning avançado de integração com bancos de dados usando JPA e pool de conexões (ex: HikariCP);
  • Ter realizado publicações técnicas em canais relevantes (blog, artigos, palestras, conferências);
  • Experiência com frameworks como Apache Camel ou outros de integração de sistemas (ESB/EDA);
  • Experiência em arquitetura orientada a eventos (EDA) de alta complexidade;
  • Conhecimento ou experiência com bancos de dados colunares ou baseados em grafos;
  • Certificações Cloud (AWS ou GCP) ativas;
  • Implementação de API Gateways (Kong, Sensedia, AWS API Gateway) via configuração e/ou código;
  • Experiência em integração arquitetural de APIs de LLM (LangChain, RAG/bancos vetoriais) ou criação de soluções próprias baseadas em IA;
  • Capacidade de liderar migrações de monolitos para microsserviços;
  • Ter implementado mais de dois exemplos de servidores MCP de alta complexidade técnica.


O que oferecemos aos nossos Builders?


  • Auxílio Alimentação (VA/VR) no cartão Caju;
  • Auxílio Home-Office no cartão Caju;
  • Programa de Pontos Flexíveis em seu Caju - um valor fléxivel para você usar como você quiser;

  • Assistência Odontológica pela Porto Seguro (Plano Bronze) com 100% da mensalidade paga pela Builders;
  • Auxílio Creche para crianças de até 72 meses;
  • Auxílio à Saúde Mental - acesso ao aplicativo Vida+;
  • Auxílio à Saúde Física - acesso ao aplicativo Gympass;
  • Seguro de vida.


Todas as nossas vagas são inclusivas e abertas a pessoas de todas as identidades de gênero, orientações sexuais, idades, etnias, culturas, origens, crenças, deficiências e outras diversidades. Acreditamos que a pluralidade enriquece nosso time e promove um ambiente de trabalho mais inovador e colaborativo.

description:

You are proactive and solution-oriented. You identify problems, define solutions, and drive them forward in fast-paced Agile environments. You actively leverage AI tools as part of your daily workflow to improve productivity and delivery outcomes.


You feel comfortable owning a product backlog, onboarding API partners, presenting to a Change Advisory Board, and collaborating directly with clients to troubleshoot issues. You connect teams, drive accountability, and ensure initiatives move forward successfully.

  • Strong product ownership mindset, with the ability to prioritize effectively, champion quality, and drive the Definition of Done.
  • Proven ability to act as a liaison between engineering teams, business stakeholders, and external technology partners.
  • Excellent technical communication skills, translating business requirements into technical language for audiences at all levels.
  • Working knowledge of REST APIs, JSON, and authentication concepts, including error handling, log review, and defect triage.

  • Own and maintain a well-groomed product backlog, writing user stories and acceptance criteria aligned with business needs.
  • Lead cross-functional project delivery and serve as the team’s single point of accountability for quality and progress.
  • Act as the primary coordination point between internal engineering teams and external API or integration partners.
  • Translate business and partner requirements into clear functional and technical specifications.
  • Manage intake, triage, prioritization, and assignment of technical issues, defects, and enhancement requests.
  • Support onboarding of API and integration partners, including requirements gathering, environment setup, testing, and go-live.
  • Facilitate Agile ceremonies and cross-functional working sessions with internal and external teams.
  • Collaborate with engineering teams to analyze logs, error reports, and support tickets to diagnose and resolve issues.
  • Deliver weekly status reports to stakeholders covering milestones, risks, and blockers.
  • Present change requests to the Change Advisory Board (CAB).
  • Coordinate and support UAT and partner validation activities.
  • Track delivery progress, dependencies, and risks across multiple concurrent initiatives.
  • Provide direct user support when required, including troubleshooting, feature walkthroughs, and discovery sessions.
  • Leverage AI tools to improve workflows, documentation quality, and delivery speed.
  • Identify opportunities to improve onboarding, support, and issue management processes through standardization and automation.


Qualifications

  • Hands-on experience with Jira or Azure DevOps for backlog management, sprint planning, and issue tracking.
  • Working knowledge of REST APIs, JSON, and integration concepts, with the ability to support partner onboarding and triage technical issues.
  • Proven ability to write user stories, acceptance criteria, and technical documentation for cross-functional engineering teams.
  • Advanced English proficiency with conversational fluency to collaborate effectively with US-based stakeholders.

As an AI-native organization, we collaborate across design, development, cloud, data, and artificial intelligence to turn ideas into scalable products that transform how companies operate, make decisions, and grow.


We are building a high-performance culture grounded in five values: Empowering Excellence, Collaborative Teamwork, Unsolicited Respect, Consistent Transparency, and Efficient Communication . These define how we work, how we support one another, and how we hold ourselves accountable.


Applaudo is a place for people who want to learn fast, take ownership, and work alongside strong teams they are proud to belong to. Joining us means being part of an organization that is evolving intentionally, investing in modern ways of working, and leading AI-native transformation at scale.

title: Dental Insurance Posting Agent
description:
If you thrive on accuracy, move with urgency, and take pride in making sure every dollar is posted correctly and every discrepancy is resolved, this role was made for you.


As a Dental Insurance Posting Agent, you’ll be at the core of our revenue cycle operations. You’ll ensure that every insurance payment, adjustment, and denial is posted accurately and reconciled promptly, helping protect the financial health of our organization while supporting a smooth experience for patients and providers. Every payment you apply, every discrepancy you investigate, and every balance you resolve directly impacts cash flow, reporting accuracy, and overall client satisfaction.


About iCore


iCore is a dentist-led healthcare company with more than 15 years of experience supporting dental and healthcare practices nationwide. We combine secure, cloud-based technology with hands-on practice management services to help practices run stronger clinical and administrative operations.

We are more than a software company. iCoreConnect partners directly with practices to support revenue cycle management, billing, insurance verification, compliance, analytics, and day-to-day operational workflows. Our approach is built on real-world experience and a deep understanding of how practices actually function.

Behind iCoreConnect is a thriving, collaborative team of clinicians, operational experts, technologists, and customer success professionals who work together to help our clients succeed. We’re proud to be a leading company built by dentists, for dentists — focused on partnership, accountability, and long-term impact.


Mission: To give dental teams one connected platform that lets them focus on exceptional patient care.


Vision: Building the leading technology-enabled dental management platform through excellence in service, automation, and measurable results.


Core Values: Excellence, Accountability, Client Success, Teamwork, Innovation.


Objectives:


  • Review, generate, and explain patient statements, invoices, and outstanding balances
  • Communicate with patients via phone, email, or portal to address billing questions, payment plans, and disputes
  • Post patient payments accurately (credit cards, checks, EFTs) and reconcile accounts
  • Verify insurance payments and apply adjustments, co-pays, deductibles, and write-offs as appropriate
  • Collaborate with insurance billing and posting teams to ensure balances are accurate and up to date
  • Identify and resolve billing discrepancies or misapplied payments
  • Set up and monitor patient payment plans in accordance with office policies
  • Maintain detailed and accurate documentation in the practice management system
  • Ensure compliance with HIPAA and internal billing procedures
  • Provide professional, empathetic service to patients, including handling escalated or sensitive billing concerns


Competencies:

  • Prior experience in dental billing, patient accounts, or dental revenue cycle management
  • Working knowledge of dental insurance plans, EOBs, co-insurance, deductibles, and coordination of benefits
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills with a customer-service mindset
  • High attention to detail and accuracy in financial data entry
  • Ability to manage high call volume and multiple accounts simultaneously
  • Ability to work independently and prioritize tasks effectively.
  • Full English proficiency
  • Proficiency with dental practice management software (e.g., Dentrix, Eaglesoft, Open Dental, or similar)
  • Ability to pass job-specific assessments


Benefits:


Personal:

  • Be a valued leader, not just a trainer

You will be recognized as a core member of our management and administrative team, with a direct impact on how our organization grows and succeeds.


  • Make a real difference at scale

Your work supports more than 15,000 dental offices , and every agent you train helps practices run better every single day.


  • Work with a mission-driven team

You’ll collaborate with experienced professionals who care deeply about quality, structure, and doing things the right way.


  • 100% remote – work from home

Enjoy the freedom of working from home, avoiding traffic, long commutes, and unnecessary daily stress.


  • Better work-life balance

While many companies are pushing employees back into the office, this role continues to offer a remote environment that supports focus, flexibility, and balance.


  • Stability and long-term growth

Join a well-established organization with over 15 years in business and a clear vision for continued growth.


Professional:

  • Grow your training and leadership skills

Strengthen your ability to train, coach, and develop high-performing teams at scale.


  • Work with industry leaders in dental

Collaborate with experienced leaders and professionals across the dental and revenue cycle management space.


  • Exposure to cutting-edge dental RCM technology

Learn and work with modern dental billing, revenue cycle, and automation tools used across thousands of practices.


  • Build and lead teams

Gain the opportunity to lead training cohorts and support the development of future supervisors and managers.


  • Expand your industry network

Meet and work with new people across the dental industry, growing your professional connections.


  • Develop enterprise-level experience

Be part of an organization that supports over 15,000 dental offices, giving you experience at scale that stands out on your resume.


What you can expect from a career with our team!

  • Competitive hourly rate
  • Schedule: 8 hours per day between 8:00 AM and 5:00 PM EST
  • Commitment: Full-time, 40+ hours per week
  • Work Setup: Fully remote position


You will have opportunities to learn new skills from our team of experienced professionals.

If you're ready to take your career to the next level and gain valuable experience, apply today!
