title: Category Manager
description:
We are hiring an analytically elite Category Manager / Category Analyst to serve as the commercial intelligence engine for a fast-growing CPG brand scaling from. This role blends deep category analytics, trade optimization, and retail strategy with storytelling that drives better decisions — internally and with key partners.


You will transform complex datasets — syndicated data (SPINS, Nielsen, IRI), retailer portals (e.g., 84.51°), distributor reporting, and internal systems — into actionable insights that meaningfully improve velocity, trade efficiency, pricing, and distribution performance. This person is the strategic partner to Sales, Marketing, Ops, Finance, and Leadership.


Strategic Importance


  • As we scale nationally and deepen relationships with major retailers and distributors (UNFI, KeHE, C&S, Dot), this role is critical to commercial success by:
  • Elevating category insights as a competitive advantage
  • Strengthening sales pitches with data-backed stories that win distribution
  • Increasing promo ROI through rigorous trade and lift analysis
  • Driving cross-functional alignment on strategy via clear analytics + narratives
  • This role is not just about dashboards — it’s about impact and influence across the business.



Key Responsibilities


  • Syndicated Data + Retailer Insights
  • Own analysis of SPINS, Nielsen/IRI and retailer portal data to understand:
  • Category growth drivers
  • Competitor dynamics
  • Velocity and share trends
  • Translate data into retailer-specific insights for buyers and commercial teams.


Promotion & Trade Effectiveness


  • Measure incremental lift, promo effectiveness, and trade ROI.
  • Partner with Sales and Finance to improve TPM discipline, promotional forecasting and post mortems.
  • Create frameworks to compare promo results vs. baseline and forecast.


Assortment, Pricing, and Space Strategy


  • Recommend SKU rationalization, pricing strategies, and assortment optimization.
  • Partner with Sales/Category buyers on planogram space recommendations.


Distributor & Retail Performance Tracking

Track performance across key channels and distributors (UNFI, KeHE, C&S, Dot), including:


  • Fill rates
  • Retail sell-through
  • Inventory health and void risk


Provide early-warning signals and corrective action recommendations.

Forecasting & Demand Planning Support


  • Improve forecast accuracy and alignment with Supply Chain and Finance.
  • Provide insights that enhance S&OP and promotional planning.


Cross-Functional Analytics & Reporting

Build and maintain executive-ready dashboards in Power BI / Tableau.


Provide cadence reporting (weekly, monthly, quarterly) tailored to:


  • Sales
  • Marketing
  • Finance
  • Operations


Executive Storytelling & Data Communication


  • Translate analytics into structured business narratives that inform strategy and execution.
  • Support pitch materials, competitive heatmaps, and retailer presentations.


Required Experience & Skills


Experience


  • 3–8+ years in CPG analytics, category management, revenue management, or related retail strategy roles.


Proven track record with:


  • Syndicated data platforms (SPINS, Nielsen/IRI)
  • Retailer portals (84.51°, Luminate)
  • Commercial analytics in a growth CPG environment


Technical Skills


  • Advanced Excel (modeling, pivot tables, data transformations)
  • Power BI / Tableau dashboard creation
  • Familiarity with trade spend economics, TPM, and promotional lift frameworks


Capabilities


  • Strong analytical rigor and ability to build structured insights
  • Excellent communication and executive presence
  • Storytelling that transforms data into selling narratives


Preferred Experience


  • Experience in frozen or high-velocity CPG categories
  • Prior work with national retailers and major distributors
  • Startup or high-growth CPG environment

title: Senior API Engineer (NodeJS, TS, SDUI)
description:
About the Company:

Headspace Health is the world’s most accessible and comprehensive digital mental health and wellbeing platform. Headspace Health will democratize mental health and wellbeing so people around the world are supported by a full spectrum of affordable care. In addition to its vast library of mindfulness and meditation content, our behavioral health system offers emotional support, guidance, therapy, and medication from professional coaches, licensed therapists, and psychiatrists, respectively.

Our mission is to create a world where mental health is never an obstacle. By harnessing the power and convenience of a smartphone, Headspace Health is able to provide access to high-quality care to anyone, anywhere, in order to reduce symptoms of stress, anxiety, and depression.


Role summary:

Lead the design and operation of APIs that power Server-Driven UI for Flutter clients while owning backend services across the stack. You’ll design stable UI contracts and compose client payloads, be comfortable diving into other backend codebases to implement features and fix production issues, participate in the on-call rotation to keep services healthy and low-latency, and drive team capability for SDUI.


Key responsibilities:

  • Design and implement robust RESTful APIs for SDUI, auth, and rate limiting.
  • Implement composition/templating logic that returns client-ready UI payloads with capability-aware fallbacks.
  • Champion SDUI capability across the team: coach engineers, run hands-on workshops, create onboarding/docs, and promote SDUI best practices.
  • Work across multiple backend repositories: add features, refactor, and maintain code quality.
  • Operate production services: own SLAs, alerting, runbooks, incident response, and participate in on-call rotation.
  • Improve reliability and performance (caching, CDN strategies, Redis, profiling, autoscaling, and load testing).
  • Build and maintain CI/CD, testing, and observability (metrics, tracing, logs, dashboards).
  • Integrate personalization, experimentation hooks, and feature flags into the delivery flow.
  • Collaborate closely with mobile/web teams to define contracts and client compatibility.
  • Mentor peers, lead design reviews, and drive API and schema governance and backward-compatibility practices.


Required skills & experience:

  • 7+ years building production microservices and APIs.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with active participation in team ceremonies and the ability to work effectively across engineering, product, and design.
  • Strong Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) experience, including effective use of abstraction and dependency injection patterns to build modular, testable, and maintainable backend systems.
  • Hands-on development in TypeScript for backend services.
  • Proven RESTful API design and contract experience.
  • Solid experience with databases and caching technologies, such as PostgreSQL, MySQL, and Redis, with an understanding of data modeling, query performance, and cache strategies.
  • Strong with AWS (API Gateway/Lambda or ECS/EC2, S3, CloudFront, RDS/ElastiCache or equivalents).
  • Experience with containerization using Docker (image build, Docker Compose, registries, running services in containers).
  • Strong testing experience, including automated testing and manual verification.
  • Experience with production support: alerting, runbooks, incident management, and on-call duties.
  • Familiar with CI/CD, automated testing, and observability tooling (Prometheus, OpenTelemetry, etc.).
  • Good spoken English


Nice to have:

  • Terraform or other IaC for managing AWS resources.
  • Experience instrumenting endpoints and surfacing behavior in analytics platforms such as Amplitude (event schemas, dashboards, alerts).
  • Experience using Statsig, Grafana, and Sentry for experimentation, dashboards, error tracking, and incident diagnostics.
  • Protobuf experience (service/event schema management via service-protos).
  • Background in personalization/experimentation systems.
  • Hands-on development in Python for backend services.


Hiring signals:

  • Examples of evolving APIs without breaking clients and measurable reliability/performance improvements.
  • Proven track record of mentoring and up-skilling engineers—especially enabling teams to adopt and own SDUI patterns.
  • Evidence of effective on-call ownership: resolved incidents, improved runbooks/alerts, postmortems.
  • Code that shows strong testing, observability, and cross-repo contributions.


Perks:

  • We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team
  • Health/Sport budget
  • Remote work
  • Flexible PTO
  • Global offices
  • Fun, positive, collaborative environment!



Kindly submit your application and CV in English.

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
We're looking for a DevOps / Cloud Lead who knows how to design, automate, and operate cloud infrastructure.

This role focuses heavily on Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) due to a strategic partnership in that ecosystem. Many of our clients are migrating infrastructure to OCI or need help operating multi-cloud environments.

We need someone who can design solutions, automate processes, and solve infrastructure problems, not just maintain pipelines.



Why this role exists

We have a strategic partnership with Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI). Clients are asking us to migrate infrastructure to OCI, and many of them also need ongoing DevOps operations and architecture support.

We need someone who can own this technically. Not just executing tasks, but executing the task is an important part of the job as well.

Design solutions. Talk to clients. Automate migrations. Coordinate engineers. And when necessary, jump in and fix things yourself.



TL;DR

You will help lead cloud and DevOps initiatives at Quave. Your job is to:

  • Lead cloud migrations to OCI
  • Design cloud architectures
  • Automate migrations and infrastructure
  • Coordinate DevOps engineers
  • Talk directly to clients
  • Help build repeatable DevOps processes

You must be strong in OCI, comfortable with AWS / Azure / GCP, hands-on, obsessed with automation, and comfortable discussing technical architecture with clients.

English is a plus, not required.



This is not a ticket-based DevOps job

If you're looking for a role where you maintain Jenkins pipelines, restart servers, open support tickets, and wait for instructions, this is not the role for you.

This role is about designing and solving infrastructure problems. We want someone who can look at a system and think:


\"We can automate 80% of this.\"

And then actually build the automation.



What you'll actually do

Cloud Architecture Design infrastructure for systems running in OCI, AWS, Azure, and GCP, migrating from one to another.



Cloud Migrations

A lot of our work will be migrations like AWS → OCI, Azure → OCI, GCP → OCI.

Your job is not just to do the migration, but to help us turn migrations into repeatable processes, scripts, templates, automation and tooling so that each migration becomes easier than the last.



Automation

We want to automate everything that can be automated:

  • Automated infrastructure provisioning
  • Migration scripts
  • CI/CD pipelines
  • Environment replication
  • Monitoring setups

If you like writing scripts that replace hours of manual work, you'll enjoy this role.



Client Discussions

You will often join calls with clients to understand infrastructure problems, design migration strategies, estimate effort, and propose solutions. You must be comfortable discussing technical topics clearly.



Leading DevOps Engineers

As the DevOps work grows, you'll coordinate other engineers working on projects, reviewing architecture, guiding implementations, and ensuring quality.



What we're looking for

You probably have many years working with infrastructure. But more importantly, you have good instincts about systems.

You likely:

  • Love automating infrastructure
  • Hate manual processes
  • Can quickly understand unfamiliar systems
  • Are comfortable debugging production environments
  • Enjoy designing architectures
  • Can communicate clearly with both engineers and clients

You should also be comfortable using AI tools to accelerate your work. Tools like ChatGPT, Claude, and Cursor can dramatically increase productivity when used well. We expect you to take advantage of that.



Technical Expectations

Cloud

  • Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) - important
  • AWS
  • Azure
  • GCP

    • DevOps

    • Docker
    • Kubernetes
    • Terraform or other Infrastructure-as-Code tools
    • CI/CD pipelines
    • Linux systems administration
    • Networking fundamentals

    Automation

    Comfortable writing scripts in Bash, Python, Go, or similar.


    Languages

    Portuguese required. English is a plus as some clients are international, so it may eventually become useful in the future, but it's not required.


    Why work with Quave

    We are a small, profitable, independent company. No investors. No corporate bureaucracy. We focus on doing great work for clients and building great software.

    Things we value: Speed. Quality. Pragmatism. Autonomy.

    Quave literally stands for Quality (Qua) and Velocity (Ve).


    Pay and Benefits

    This is a full-time remote position. Compensation will depend on experience.

    • Fully remote work
    • Flexible hours
    • 22 days paid time off per year
    • Quarterly bonus based on company performance
    • AI allowance for productivity tools

    We work as a distributed team of independent contractors.


    Hiring Process

    • Application review
    • Technical conversation
    • Architecture discussion
    • Conversation(s) with one or more partners
    • This is a leadership role and you will coordinate other engineers as the DevOps work grows. But at Quave our leaders are hands-on. You should be comfortable writing automation and infrastructure code yourself when needed.

title: Executivo(A) Comercial | Feira De Santana - Bahia | Liora Energia
description:
Sobre a Liora: Descomplicando a energia no Brasil

Nascemos para simplificar a energia, algo essencial, mas que hoje parece distante e complexo. O brasileiro paga uma das contas de luz mais caras do mundo, muitas vezes sem saber que tem uma escolha. Quando descobre, a complexidade e a falta de transparência do setor geram desconfiança.

A Liora chegou para mudar essa realidade. Nossa missão é provar que é possível ter acesso a uma energia mais barata e limpa com transparência, simplicidade e um atendimento genuinamente humano. Para nós, energia não é um produto técnico, é uma relação de confiança que devolve o poder para quem paga a conta.

Essa transformação é construída por um time obcecado por seus clientes e que busca a excelência em tudo o que faz. Se você busca um propósito, quer construir algo gigante e acredita que o impossível é o nosso ponto de partida, seu lugar é aqui

Você será a peça-chave para:

Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Desbravar o Mercado: Prospectar ativamente e qualificar novos clientes (PMEs e Residenciais), construindo um pipeline de oportunidades sólido e constante.
  • Desenvolver Parcerias Estratégicas: Mapear, negociar e ativar redes de parceiros que nos ajudem a multiplicar nosso alcance e impacto.
  • Realizar Vendas Consultivas: Entender profundamente as dores e necessidades dos clientes para apresentar a solução da Liora de forma personalizada e irresistível.
  • Conduzir o Ciclo de Vendas Completo: Apresentar propostas de valor, negociar com clareza e fechar contratos que gerem valor real para os clientes e para a Liora.
  • Atuar como a Voz do Cliente: Trazer feedbacks valiosos do mercado para colaborar com os times de Produto, Marketing e Pós-venda, nos ajudando a melhorar continuamente.

O que Buscamos em Você:

  • Perfil Hunter: Você tem energia, resiliência e paixão por abrir novas portas e prospectar clientes.
  • Comunicação Excepcional: Habilidade de se comunicar de forma clara, direta e empática, criando conexões genuínas.

E aí, vamos transformar o futuro da energia juntos?

Se você se identificou com a nossa missão e acredita que tem o perfil para este desafio, queremos te conhecer!

#VemPraLiora #EnergiaSimples #Transformação #VendasComPropósito

title: Head De Manutenção
description:
Estamos em busca de um(a) Head de manutenção para uma empresa localizada em Camaçari/BA .

Seu perfil corresponde ao da vaga descrita abaixo? Então, faça sua candidatura!

Objetivo da posição:

Coordenar a manutenção industrial, os projetos de CAPEX Sustaining, a confiabilidade, o planejamento e a gestão de custos, assegurando alta disponibilidade dos ativos, segurança operacional e uso eficiente dos recursos financeiros, com forte controle de OPEX e CAPEX.

Principais responsabilidades:

Gestão de Equipe

  • Liderar equipes próprias e terceirizadas de: Mecânica;
    Elétrica;
    Instrumentação e Facilities
  • Desenvolver competências técnicas e comportamentais.
  • Garantir alocação eficiente de recursos e produtividade das equipes.
  • Assegurar práticas seguras, atendimento as normas e ambiente de trabalho adequado.
  • Promover o alinhamento e a comunicação assertiva com outros departamentos, garantindo que a Unidade de Negócio atinja seus objetivos globais de desempenho.

Gestão de Manutenção

  • Coordenar manutenções preventiva, preditiva e corretiva, garantindo confiabilidade e segurança dos ativos.
  • Assegurar resposta estruturada a falhas críticas e emergências.
  • Promover padronização técnica e disciplina operacional.
  • Realizar as rotinas de PCM (planejamento e programação);
  • Promover análises de falhas (RCA), FMEA e práticas de confiabilidade.
  • Reduzir falhas recorrentes, backlog e manutenções emergenciais.
  • Manter os indicadores de manutenção (KPIs) atualizados, assegurando o cumprimento das metas de desempenho e buscando a melhoria contínua dos processos.
  • Zelar pelo armazenamento técnico e organização de materiais no almoxarifado e pátios de equipamentos.

Gestão de Contratos e Facilities

  • Gerenciar contratos de manutenção industrial e facilities.
  • Controlar escopo, SLAs, custos, desempenho técnico e segurança dos prestadores.
  • Apoiar processos de contratação, renegociação e avaliação de fornecedores.
  • Buscar oportunidades de otimização de contratos e redução de custos totais.

Gestão de Custos (OPEX e CAPEX)

  • Gerir o orçamento anual de manutenção (OPEX) e de CAPEX Sustaining.
  • Elaborar previsões orçamentárias (budget e forecast).
  • Controlar custos de: Materiais e sobressalentes;
    Serviços e contratos
  • Analisar desvios entre planejado × realizado e definir planos de ação.
  • Implementar iniciativas de redução de custo sem aumento de risco operacional.
  • Garantir correta classificação contábil entre OPEX e CAPEX.
  • Projetos de Investimento – CAPEX Sustaining
  • Gerenciar o portfólio de CAPEX Sustaining.
  • Elaborar escopos técnicos, estimativas de investimento e cronogramas.
  • Acompanhar execução física e financeira dos projetos.
  • Garantir comissionamento, entrega técnica e incorporação correta dos ativos ao sistema de gestão.

Requisitos e qualificações:

  • Sólida atuação em planejamento de manutenção industrial;
  • Vivência em gestão de projetos (CAPEX Sustaining);
  • Vivência em gestão de custos;
  • Domínio das ferramentas e metodologias de confiabilidade;
  • Experiência comsistemas de gestão de manutenção (SAP PM);
  • Vivência em projetos de melhoria contínua e confiabilidade.

Sobre a FESA Group:

Fundada em 1995, a FESA Group é uma empresa brasileira que apoia organizações em toda a jornada estratégica de gestão de pessoas: do recrutamento executivo ao desenvolvimento de lideranças e à transformação cultural. Referência em seu setor de atuação, combina inteligência de mercado, especialização setorial e tecnologia, tendo a felicidade corporativa como parte essencial do seu DNA.

Seu portfólio integrado oferece soluções sob medida para aquisição, desenvolvimento, sucessão e retenção de talentos, sempre com foco no cliente e na entrega de resultados que geram impacto real nos negócios e na vida das pessoas. Mais do que autoridade nos setores em que atua — como Agronegócio, Indústria, Energia e Infraestrutura, Mercado Financeiro e Varejo —, conta com consultores especialistas preparados para criar conexões humanas que impulsionam crescimento e transformação.

Com presença em todo o Brasil por meio de escritórios regionais e atuação internacional via IIC Partners, presente em mais de 30 países, a FESA Group alia alcance global à expertise local. No campo social, o Instituto FESA C.R.O.M.A promove programas de voluntariado voltados à educação e qualificação profissional de jovens em situação de vulnerabilidade, reforçando seu compromisso com uma sociedade mais inclusiva e sustentável.

Para mais informações, acesse o site:

title: Head de manutenção
description:
Estamos em busca de um(a) Head de manutenção para uma empresa localizada em Camaçari/BA . Seu perfil corresponde ao da vaga descrita abaixo? Então, faça sua candidatura!
Objetivo da posição: Coordenar a manutenção industrial, os projetos de CAPEX Sustaining, a confiabilidade, o planejamento e a gestão de custos, assegurando alta disponibilidade dos ativos, segurança operacional e uso eficiente dos recursos financeiros, com forte controle de OPEX e CAPEX.
Principais responsabilidades: Gestão de Equipe
Liderar equipes próprias e terceirizadas de: Mecânica; Elétrica; Instrumentação e Facilities
Desenvolver competências técnicas e comportamentais.
Garantir alocação eficiente de recursos e produtividade das equipes.
Assegurar práticas seguras, atendimento as normas e ambiente de trabalho adequado.
Promover o alinhamento e a comunicação assertiva com outros departamentos, garantindo que a Unidade de Negócio atinja seus objetivos globais de desempenho.
Gestão de Manutenção
Coordenar manutenções preventiva, preditiva e corretiva, garantindo confiabilidade e segurança dos ativos.
Assegurar resposta estruturada a falhas críticas e emergências.
Promover padronização técnica e disciplina operacional.
Realizar as rotinas de PCM (planejamento e programação);
Promover análises de falhas (RCA), FMEA e práticas de confiabilidade.
Reduzir falhas recorrentes, backlog e manutenções emergenciais.
Manter os indicadores de manutenção (KPIs) atualizados, assegurando o cumprimento das metas de desempenho e buscando a melhoria contínua dos processos.
Zelar pelo armazenamento técnico e organização de materiais no almoxarifado e pátios de equipamentos.
Gestão de Contratos e Facilities
Gerenciar contratos de manutenção industrial e facilities.
Controlar escopo, SLAs, custos, desempenho técnico e segurança dos prestadores.
Apoiar processos de contratação, renegociação e avaliação de fornecedores.
Buscar oportunidades de otimização de contratos e redução de custos totais.
Gestão de Custos (OPEX e CAPEX)
Gerir o orçamento anual de manutenção (OPEX) e de CAPEX Sustaining.
Elaborar previsões orçamentárias (budget e forecast).
Controlar custos de: Materiais e sobressalentes; Serviços e contratos
Analisar desvios entre planejado × realizado e definir planos de ação.
Implementar iniciativas de redução de custo sem aumento de risco operacional.
Garantir correta classificação contábil entre OPEX e CAPEX.
Projetos de Investimento – CAPEX Sustaining
Gerenciar o portfólio de CAPEX Sustaining.
Elaborar escopos técnicos, estimativas de investimento e cronogramas.
Acompanhar execução física e financeira dos projetos.
Garantir comissionamento, entrega técnica e incorporação correta dos ativos ao sistema de gestão.
Requisitos e qualificações:
Sólida atuação em planejamento de manutenção industrial;
Vivência em gestão de projetos (CAPEX Sustaining);
Vivência em gestão de custos;
Domínio das ferramentas e metodologias de confiabilidade;
Experiência com sistemas de gestão de manutenção (SAP PM);
Vivência em projetos de melhoria contínua e confiabilidade.
Sobre a FESA Group: Fundada em 1995, a FESA Group é uma empresa brasileira que apoia organizações em toda a jornada estratégica de gestão de pessoas: do recrutamento executivo ao desenvolvimento de lideranças e à transformação cultural. Referência em seu setor de atuação, combina inteligência de mercado, especialização setorial e tecnologia, tendo a felicidade corporativa como parte essencial do seu DNA.
Seu portfólio integrado oferece soluções sob medida para aquisição, desenvolvimento, sucessão e retenção de talentos, sempre com foco no cliente e na entrega de resultados que geram impacto real nos negócios e na vida das pessoas. Mais do que autoridade nos setores em que atua — como Agronegócio, Indústria, Energia e Infraestrutura, Mercado Financeiro e Varejo —, conta com consultores especialistas preparados para criar conexões humanas que impulsionam crescimento e transformação.
Com presença em todo o Brasil por meio de escritórios regionais e atuação internacional via IIC Partners, presente em mais de 30 países, a FESA Group alia alcance global à expertise local. No campo social, o Instituto FESA C. R. O. M. A promove programas de voluntariado voltados à educação e qualificação profissional de jovens em situação de vulnerabilidade, reforçando seu compromisso com uma sociedade mais inclusiva e sustentável.

title: Executivo(a) comercial | feira de santana - bahia | liora energia
description:
Sobre a Liora: Descomplicando a energia no Brasil
Nascemos para simplificar a energia, algo essencial, mas que hoje parece distante e complexo. O brasileiro paga uma das contas de luz mais caras do mundo, muitas vezes sem saber que tem uma escolha. Quando descobre, a complexidade e a falta de transparência do setor geram desconfiança.
A Liora chegou para mudar essa realidade. Nossa missão é provar que é possível ter acesso a uma energia mais barata e limpa com transparência, simplicidade e um atendimento genuinamente humano. Para nós, energia não é um produto técnico, é uma relação de confiança que devolve o poder para quem paga a conta.
Essa transformação é construída por um time obcecado por seus clientes e que busca a excelência em tudo o que faz. Se você busca um propósito, quer construir algo gigante e acredita que o impossível é o nosso ponto de partida, seu lugar é aqui

Despertar o mercado para uma nova realidade energética.
Ajudar clientes a tomar decisões com segurança e clareza.
Construir relações de confiança que duram.

Desbravar o Mercado: Prospectar ativamente e qualificar novos clientes (PMEs e Residenciais), construindo um pipeline de oportunidades sólido e constante.
Desenvolver Parcerias Estratégicas: Mapear, negociar e ativar redes de parceiros que nos ajudem a multiplicar nosso alcance e impacto.
Realizar Vendas Consultivas: Entender profundamente as dores e necessidades dos clientes para apresentar a solução da Liora de forma personalizada e irresistível.
Conduzir o Ciclo de Vendas Completo: Apresentar propostas de valor, negociar com clareza e fechar contratos que gerem valor real para os clientes e para a Liora.
Atuar como a Voz do Cliente: Trazer feedbacks valiosos do mercado para colaborar com os times de Produto, Marketing e Pós-venda, nos ajudando a melhorar continuamente.
O que Buscamos em Você:
Perfil Hunter: Você tem energia, resiliência e paixão por abrir novas portas e prospectar clientes.
Comunicação Excepcional: Habilidade de se comunicar de forma clara, direta e empática, criando conexões genuínas.
Foco no Cliente: Uma obsessão por entender, resolver problemas e encantar quem está do outro lado da linha.

Ambição Gigante: O desejo de não apenas bater metas, mas de construir a maior e mais confiável provedora de serviços de energia do Brasil

Nossa operação é guiada por excelência, inovação, sustentabilidade e foco nas pessoas.
O Que Buscamos
Buscamos um(a) Consultor(a) de Vendas com experiência em vendas externas B2 B, forte habilidade em prospecção ativa, negociação e relacionamento com stakeholders. Este(a) profissional atuará de forma estratégica na expansão da base de clientes na região, garantindo aumento de receita, qualidade no atendimento e consistência no processo comercial.
Principais Responsabilidades
• Prospectar e comercializar produtos e serviços da Alsco para novos clientes.
• Participar de eventos da área, identificando oportunidades e promovendo os serviços da empresa.
• Realizar negociações de cross-sell e up-sell em contratos fechados.
• Prestar assistência aos novos clientes durante o período inicial, garantindo acompanhamento comercial e uso adequado dos produtos.
• Acompanhar a implantação dos novos clientes em parceria com as áreas internas.
• Identificar oportunidades de negócios e mapear o mercado local.
• Planejar a agenda semanal de visitas e conduzir reuniões comerciais.
• Implantar e acompanhar amostras de testes de materiais junto a prospects e novos clientes.
• Atingir as metas comerciais estabelecidas.
• Elaborar e apresentar relatórios de produtividade e indicadores da área.
• Elaborar propostas comerciais e realizar follow-up contínuo.
• Gerenciar todas as comunicações de novos clientes, incluindo solicitações, reclamações e sugestões, assegurando soluções adequadas.
• Apresentar resultados das amostras testadas aos prospects.

title: Coordenador de obras - incorporação
description:
Oportunidade: Coordenador de Obras (Incorporação) Estamos em busca de um Coordenador de Obras com perfil dinâmico e visão estratégica para integrar nosso time de Engenharia. Este profissional será o elo entre o planejamento da incorporadora e a execução técnica no canteiro, garantindo que nossos empreendimentos sejam entregues com excelência, dentro do prazo e do orçamento.
Requisitos Fundamentais (Obrigatórios)
Experiência Comprovada: Vivência sólida na coordenação de múltiplas obras simultâneas no segmento de incorporação imobiliária (residencial ou comercial).
Formação: Graduação completa em Engenharia Civil com registro ativo no CREA.
Visão de Incorporação: Entendimento profundo do ciclo de vida do produto imobiliário (do projeto à entrega das chaves/assistência técnica). Responsabilidades e Atribuições Gestão Multiobras: Coordenar simultaneamente o andamento de diferentes canteiros, garantindo a padronização de processos e qualidade. Interface Estratégica: Atuar como facilitador entre as áreas de Projetos, Suprimentos e Financeiro da Incorporadora. Controle de Cronograma: Monitorar o caminho crítico das obras, antecipar riscos e propor planos de ação para desvios de prazo. Gestão de Custos: Acompanhar o fluxo de caixa das obras e o cumprimento do orçamento previsto (VGV/Custos diretos). Liderança de Equipes: Orientar os engenheiros residentes e equipes técnicas, promovendo um ambiente de alta performance e segurança. Qualidade e Normas: Garantir o cumprimento das normas técnicas, PBQP-H e legislações municipais vigentes. Pré-requisitos Adicionais e Diferenciais Softwares de Gestão: Domínio de ferramentas de planejamento ( MS Project ou Primavera) e ERPs de engenharia (Ex: Sienge , UAU ou Totvs). Metodologias Ágeis: Conhecimento em Lean Construction (Construção Enxuta) para otimização de processos. Gestão de Contratos: Habilidade na contratação e gestão de grandes empreiteiras e fornecedores críticos. Pós-Graduação: Especialização em Gestão de Projetos, Gestão de Negócios Imobiliários ou Engenharia de Custos será considerada um diferencial. Perfil Comportamental: Forte capacidade de negociação, resiliência para lidar com prazos desafiadores e excelente comunicação interpessoal.

title: Gerente de negócios
description:
Edenred é uma plataforma digital líder em serviços e pagamentos e a companhia diária para as pessoas no trabalho, conectando mais de 850.000 clientes corporativos, 50 milhões de usuários, 2 milhões de comerciantes parceiros em 44 países por meio de 4 linhas de negócios: • MOVE : Gestão de Combustível e Frota, Frete, Manutenção, Pedágio • EAT & CARE : Refeições e Alimentos, Cultura, Incentivos & Recompensas e Saúde • PAY : Gestão de despesas, pagamento de salários e comissões para trabalhadores independentes e prestadores de serviços • ACQUIRING : soluções para comerciantes Estamos no centro de uma rede virtuosa que agrega valor aos seus clientes: • Empresas e setor público , preocupados em ser empregadores atraentes, motivando suas equipes e otimizando seu desempenho • Funcionários e cidadãos , que apreciam a simplicidade e conveniência de nossas soluções de pagamento para tornar suas vidas mais fáceis • Comerciantes (restaurantes, lojas, postos de gasolina, etc.) que buscam aumentar sua receita, fidelizar seus clientes e tornar suas transações mais seguras Nossos 12.000 funcionários estão comprometidos em tornar o mundo do trabalho um lugar melhor para todos , mais seguro, eficiente e fácil de usar Com 1.500 funcionários, nossa linha de negócios MOVE no Brasil é a maior do grupo . Estamos agora regionalizando nossas operações MOVE em nível LATAM, proporcionando assim exposição internacional e oportunidades para nossos funcionário s. Daqui para frente, nossa linha de negócios continuará a entregar um crescimento sustentável e lucrativo de dois dígitos Procuramos talentos que partilhem a nossa ambição, que queiram representar, desafiem-nos e a si próprios a seguir em frente todos os dias. Procuramos profissionais que vibram conosco e que partilham os nossos valores: paixão pelos clientes, respeito, imaginação, simplicidade e espírito empreendedor Na Edenred, acreditamos que grandes conexões são uma força imparável. Nós os canalizamos para fortalecer negócios e fomentar soluções inclusivas. Criamos ecossistemas locais que criam mais riqueza. E mais saúde. Não só para as pessoas, mas também para o nosso meio ambiente. Melhores laços podem melhorar a vida. Damos a eles um propósito: promover o progresso . Diversidade, Equidade e Inclusão são mais do que adesivos em nossas paredes, são pilares essenciais na gestão de pessoas e um compromisso com nossa sociedade. Portanto, todas as pessoas são bem-vindas, independente de deficiência, raça, cor, religião, gênero, orientação sexual, idade ou qualquer outra diversidade.
Estamos plenamente convencidos de que uma equipe diversificada traz diferentes perspectivas, maior propriedade para resolver desafios e maior capacidade de inovação!
Para todos que procuram esse tipo de VIBE em sua vida profissional, somos o melhor lugar para você! Missão do cargo
Responsável por prospectar novos clientes (empresas), criar e alimentar pipeline de oportunidades e conduzir o processo de venda desde a abordagem inicial até o fechamento, com foco em bater metas comerciais.
Responsabilidades:
Prospecção ativa de clientes (cadastros frios, mapeamento de mercado, cold calls, Linked In, networking).
Identificação de leads qualificados seguindo critérios de perfil ideal (segmento, porte, potencial).
Realização de reuniões presenciais e virtuais com decisores para apresentar soluções da Ticket Log.
Elaboração e negociação de propostas comerciais conforme diretrizes de pricing.
Gestão do funil de vendas (pipeline) e uso de CRM para registro de todas as interações, status de oportunidades, follow-ups etc.
Acompanhamento de todo o ciclo de venda: desde prospecção até a assinatura de contrato, entrega de documentação e ativação.
Atuação colaborativa com equipes internas (marketing, operações, implementação) para garantir o cumprimento de expectativas do cliente.
Monitoramento de indicadores de desempenho (KPIs) e participação no planejamento de metas comerciais.
Requisitos:
Formação superior completa (Administração, Marketing, Engenharia, Relações Internacionais, Negócios ou áreas afins).
Experiência prévia comprovada em vendas B2 B, preferencialmente com perfil “hunter” (prospecção ativa).
Conhecimento de técnicas de vendas consultivas (ex: SPIN, Challenger, venda por valor).
Habilidade de negociação e comunicação com stakeholders de diferentes níveis.
Experiência com CRM (Salesforce, Pipedrive ou similares).
Capacidade de trabalhar com metas agressivas e foco em resultados.
Disponibilidade para deslocamentos, reuniões em campo e viagens constantes.
Desejável conhecimento no segmento de frotas, mobilidade ou cartões corporativos.
Inglês /intermediário será diferencial
O que esperamos?
Buscamos um profissional com perfil proativo, resiliente, orientado a resultados e com habilidade para trabalhar autonomamente. Que goste de desafios, tenha boa capacidade analítica e saiba lidar com pressão e metas agressivas.
Local - Salvador - Bahia

title: Assistente administrativo
description:
Você está em uma jornada para ingressar em uma empresa emocionante e fazer parte de nossa história de sucesso. Aqui vamos equipá-lo com o know-how e a experiência que definirão seu crescimento. Nesta função em que você está prestes a embarcar, você deve cumprir as seguintes responsabilidades:

Atender às ocorrências operacionais relacionadas a ambientes da empresa, como vazamentos, falhas elétricas, problemas em vestiários, refeitório, banheiros, entre outros.
Acionar fornecedores de manutenção corretiva e acompanhar a execução dos serviços contratados.
Verificar no local a natureza do problema e registrar a ocorrência de forma adequada.
Conferir se os serviços foram realizados conforme combinado, observando prazos, qualidade e emissão da nota fiscal.
Utilizar o sistema de gestão de viagens corporativas para registrar, acompanhar e controlar solicitações, aprovações, reservas e prestação de contas.
Apoiar o controle das rotinas operacionais de Facilities, em interface com a equipe.
Auxiliar no acompanhamento do transporte fretado, consumo no restaurante e funcionamento dos equipamentos e estruturas da unidade.
Manter registros atualizados em planilhas e relatórios simples de ocorrências e atendimentos realizados.
Apoiar o controle orçamentário da área, acompanhando os gastos mensais com serviços de Facilities e viagens, e comparando com o previsto.
Sinalizar ao Supervisor e a equipe, eventuais falhas ou desvios operacionais.
Requisitos:
Ensino Médio Completo, desejável cursando Ensino Superior em Administração ou áreas correlatas;
Conhecimento em Pacote Office, principalmente Excel e Power Point;
Disponibilidade para atuação 100% presencial em Feira de Santana-BA.
Desejável conhecimento na execução de atividades operacionais relacionadas aos serviços de Facilities como: viagens, hospedagens, combustíveis, táxi, locações de veículos (Frota), apoio quanto a solicitação dos materiais de limpeza e fardamentos, cadastros de fornecedores internos;
Vivência com o sistema SAP será considerado um diferencial.
Aviso Legal:
Ao nos enviar seu currículo e dados pessoais, considera-se que você deu seu consentimento para que mantenhamos suas informações em nosso banco de dados de recrutamento de talentos. Todas as informações fornecidas serão usadas exclusivamente para o processo seletivo. A RGE somente coletará, utilizará, processará ou divulgará informações pessoais quando e onde for permitido pelas leis aplicáveis.
Somente os candidatos pré-selecionados serão contatados para entrevista. Nos empenhamos em responder a todos os candidatos. No entanto, se você não receber uma resposta nossa em até 60 dias, por favor, considere sua candidatura para esta vaga como não aprovada. Podemos entrar em contato futuramente para oportunidades que correspondam às suas qualificações e experiência.
Obrigado por considerar uma carreira na RGE.

title: Elite customer support specialist – french & english (remote)
description:
About the Company
On Spot is a travel technology group focused on improving traveler experience and building long-term loyalty for travel brands.
Our support team plays a critical role in the customer experience. We believe that great support is not just about answering questions — it is about solving problems, building trust, and creating long-term customer relationships.
You will act as a dedicated point of contact, ensuring a seamless experience from confirmation to completion — anticipating needs, coordinating services, and resolving situations with excellence and efficiency.About the Role
We are looking for an Elite Customer Support Specialist with fluent French and English who thrives in a fast-paced, international environment.
In this role, you will go beyond traditional customer service. You will investigate complex issues, collaborate with technical teams, and deliver clear, thoughtful solutions to customers around the world.
This is not a standard support role. It is a high-impact position for professionals experienced in high-end, demanding service environments, capable of handling complex, high-value requests with autonomy, precision, and care.What Makes You a Great Fit
Proven experience in high-end or demanding customer service environments (luxury hospitality, 4–5 stars hotels, concierge services, aviation, premium retail, etc.)
Experience in travel or hospitality industries (travel agencies, tour operators, hotels, etc.)
Experience organizing tailor-made services or customized client experiences
Strong ability to manage multiple requests simultaneously with efficiency and attention to detail
High level of autonomy, organization, and problem-solving skills
A natural client-first mindset, with a strong focus on personalization and service excellence
Ability to remain calm and solution-oriented under pressure
Fluent English and French (written and spoken) are required (a third language is a plus)
Good knowledge of destinations and personal travel experience
Nice to Have
Experience supporting international customers
Experience with Saa S products or technology platforms
Experience using tools such as Zendesk, Intercom, or Freshdesk
Experience working with cross-functional teams (engineering or product)
Advantages
Competitive compensation
Fully remote work environment
International and collaborative team
Professional development opportunities
Working environment
Fully remote position
Requires flexibility in working hours, depending on operational needs
Fast-paced and international environment with high service standards
Compensation
R$6,000 a R$10,000 Reais per month.
This role is ideal for professionals who thrive in high standards, ownership, and premium service environments, and who are motivated by delivering truly exceptional experiences.If this sounds like you, we would love to hear from you.

title: Senior business analyst – supply chain
description:
Who We Are
We are an IFS integrator, providing end-to-end ERP implementation projects and exceptional support services. As strategic business partners, we collaborate with clients across key industries, helping them drive digital transformation.
Our global team of 200+ members brings extensive expertise, including former IFS customers who understand real-world operational challenges and dedicated IFS specialists with deep functional and technical knowledge. Together, we deliver outstanding services to reshape businesses and optimize supply chain operations.Who We Are Looking For
We are currently seeking aSenior Business Analyst – Supply Chain , a client-facing leadership role responsible for driving complex ERP implementations within supply chain domains (procurement, inventory, logistics, planning, and distribution).
This role requires a strong functional expert who can lead requirement gathering, solution design, and implementation while acting as a key advisor to clients and an escalation point for junior analysts.
If you are passionate about supply chain optimization, ERP transformation, and leading cross-functional collaboration in global projects, we encourage you to apply.Key Responsibilities
Business Requirements & Client Engagement
• Lead requirement gathering sessions with stakeholders across supply chain functions.
• Analyze business processes (procurement, inventory, warehousing, logistics) to identify improvements and optimization opportunities.
• Translate complex supply chain and technical concepts into clear language for non-technical stakeholders.
• Perform gap analysis between current operations and ERP capabilities, ensuring scalable and efficient solutions.
• Advise clients on best practices aligned with industry standards and digital transformation strategies.Solution Design, Implementation & Testing
• Lead supply chain module implementation within ERP (IFS or similar).
• Supervise and mentor Business Analysts and Junior Analysts within the domain.
• Collaborate with Project Managers on planning, estimations, and risk mitigation.
• Work closely with development and technical teams to ensure accurate solution delivery.
• Lead design discussions to align system architecture with business objectives.
• Ensure quality assurance testing and validation of supply chain functionalities.
• Support cross-functional alignment with Solution Architects and other domains.
• Deliver user training sessions and create functional documentation to ensure adoption.Training, Expertise & Continuous Improvement (20%)
• Act as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) in supply chain processes and ERP functionalities.
• Stay up to date with industry trends, including digital supply chain, automation, and best practices.
• Maintain relevant certifications (IFS or equivalent ERP modules).
• Drive continuous improvement initiatives across projects and internal practices.Must Have
• Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Industrial Engineering, Business, or related field.
• Minimum 5 years of experience in supply chain processes (procurement, logistics, inventory, planning).
• Minimum 3 years in client-facing roles.
• Experience in ERP implementation projects (IFS preferred).
• Strong understanding of supply chain operations across industries such as Manufacturing, Energy, Construction, or Services.
• Fluent in Portuguese and English (Spanish or French is a plus).
• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
• Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving capabilities.
• Experience with project management and collaboration tools.
• Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office.
• Availability to travel.
• Legally authorized to work in Brazil.What We Offer
• Competitive salary and benefits package.
• Career growth opportunities with certifications and professional development.
• A collaborative and international work environment.
• Involvement in high-impact global supply chain transformation projects.Why Hoist?
If you are looking for an opportunity to lead impactful supply chain transformations and grow your career in a dynamic and global environment, Hoist is the place for you.
Join our team and be part of a people-first culture that values collaboration, innovation, and professional growth.

title: Business development manager – advertisers & agencies (latam)
description:
Company Description
Orange Storm is a leading venture-backed Ad Tech and AI Saa S company with dual headquarters in California, USA, and Barcelona, Spain. Our integrated ecosystem includes a DSP, SSP, Creative Studio, and an AI-driven analytics platform, empowering publishers and advertisers to make smarter decisions and drive revenue growth. Our global and diverse team thrives in a culture of trust, ownership, and continuous learning. We prioritize collaboration, agile execution, and innovation to deliver scalable, high-performance technologies that adapt to the dynamic Ad Tech industry.Role Description
We are looking for a proactive Business Development Manager based in Argentina to help expand our partnerships with advertisers and performance agencies in LATAM.
This role focuses on building a strong pipeline through outbound outreach and industry networking. The ideal candidate is someone who enjoys identifying new partners, starting conversations, and turning connections into long-term collaborations.
You will work closely with internal teams to introduce our advertising solutions and onboard new partners.Responsibilities
Proactively identify and connect with advertisers and performance agencies in LATAM
Conduct daily outreach through Linked In, email, Telegram communities, and other networking channels
Build and manage a strong sales pipeline
Schedule meetings and introduce our advertising solutions to potential partners
Develop relationships with media buyers, agencies, and advertiser teams
Support the onboarding process for new partners and coordinate internally with operations teams
Maintain long-term relationships and help grow advertiser spend over time
Explore creative ways to find partners, including industry communities, social platforms, and events
Requirements
1–3 years of experience in Ad Tech, performance marketing, affiliate marketing, or digital advertising
Strong outbound sales or partnership development mindset
Comfortable doing high-volume outreach and networking
Excellent English communication skills
Based in Argentina
Self-motivated and comfortable working in a fast-moving startup environment
Nice to Have

title: Software engineering manager
description:
ABOUT US
Syniti, part of Capgemini, tackles the hardest work in data for the world’s largest organizations. We combine intelligent software with deep data expertise to help the Fortune2000 tackle complex data challenges and drive measurable business outcomes with business-ready data.Syniti’s Data First strategy transforms data from an afterthought into a strategic asset—unlocking insights, reducing risk, and fueling growth. With over 5,000 successful projects, we support the full data lifecycle through a unified platform for migration, quality, replication, matching, master data management, analytics, governance, and strategy. Operating globally across industries, Syniti’s award-winning software, expert consultants give enterprises a unique edge in managing and maximizing their data.Syniti’s cloud-native platform sets new standards in enterprise data management, combining powerful Saa S solutions with deep domain expertise. Designed for agility and scale, our technology helps customers accelerate digital transformation, drive innovation, and make confident decisions with trusted data. Every product enhancement is built to solve real business challenges—empowering organizations to unlock value from their data faster and more effectively.THE ROLE
The Manager I of Engineering plays a key leadership role, directly managing a small team of software engineers. This role is responsible for ensuring timely delivery of high-quality software projects, fostering a collaborative and inclusive team culture, and supporting the professional growth of engineers.
In addition to leading day-to-day execution, this manager contributes to tactical decision-making, participates in architectural discussions, and ensures engineering efforts are aligned with project goals. They collaborate closely with product, design, and cross-functional stakeholders to deliver solutions that support Syniti’s broader mission.WHAT YOU WILL DO
• Manage and support a team of software engineers, ensuring projects are delivered on time and within scope.
• Provide coaching, mentorship, and regular performance feedback to support individual growth.
• Guide the team in applying engineering best practices, including code reviews, testing, and secure development.
• Participate in architectural and technical design discussions, ensuring sound engineering decisions.
• Collaborate closely with product and cross-functional teams to align priorities and deliver value.
• Help shape a positive and inclusive team culture that fosters engagement, learning, and innovation.
• Identify and address delivery risks, blockers, or process gaps within the team’s scope.
• Contribute to hiring and onboarding of new engineers, and support team scaling efforts.WHAT IT TAKES
• Proven experience as a team lead or first-line engineering manager in a software development environment.
• Strong technical foundation in modern software development (e.g., C#, Go, React, Type Script, AWS).
• Familiarity with agile development methodologies, Dev Ops practices, and software delivery processes.
• Excellent communication and collaboration skills across technical and non-technical stakeholders.
• Demonstrated ability to coach, mentor, and support the growth of engineering team members.
• Experience participating in technical design, architecture reviews, and secure development practices.
• Comfortable working in a fast-paced, distributed, and cross-functional environment.Be fully aligned to our core values:
• Think Big - Be courageous and bold. Aspire to greatness. Relentlessly pursue market innovation. Set the standard by which others follow. Create solutions that have a meaningful impact. Solve the challenges our customers don’t know they have.
• Be Curious - Be a lifelong learner. Seek out new ideas to serve customers. Understand our competition and the world. Be permanently dissatisfied with the status quo. Challenge preconceptions. Focus on the future rather than yesterday.
• Take Action - Be the first. Don’t wait. Take accountability. Inspire others by doing. Fail fast and learn from mistakes. Make a difference every day.
• Stronger Together - Respect, trust and look out for each other. Celebrate diverse perspectives. Listen. Build connections and belonging. Act with integrity. Give back. One Syniti family.WHAT WE OFFER
• Trust in your talent. At Syniti you will find a supportive environment and access to learning tools, but micromanagement is not our style.
• Growth. We are growing rapidly and steadily solving the biggest challenges enterprise companies are faced with today. There was never a better time to join and grow with us. Most importantly you will have the chance to shape our journey and share in our success story.
• Support. We all rely on each other and enable each other to be successful. You won’t stand alone.
• Curiosity and genuine interest in you. We all have our different stories, all equally fascinating with each depicting a different journey and we want to hear them all.
• Recognition. We are the sum of individual achievements, and we always take the time to celebrate them.
• An open organisation. Titles don’t define access at Syniti. We stay humble regardless of where we sit in the organisation. We want to hear every voice, listen to all the ideas and make sure everyone’s work is seen and valued.

title: Landholder and reforestation delivery manager
description:
About Nature CoNature Co delivers nature-based solutions (Nb S) for investors, corporates and other purpose driven organisations to scale up action on climate change and biodiversity loss. We specialise in nature-based project development including reforestation, agroforestry, farmer managed natural regeneration and mangrove restoration. Nature Co has extensive expertise in working with local communities to protect and restore natural ecosystems through participation in the global voluntary carbon market.
Nature Co is currently implementing a large-scale reforestation project in Brazil for the generation of verified carbon credits.
We are a diverse, mission-driven team that values inclusion, integrity, and innovation. Nature Co is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to building an equitable and inclusive workplace for all.Role and responsibilities
The Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager is the primary field-based interface with landholders, communities, reforestation contractors, and other local stakeholders for Nature Co’s projects in Brazil. This position will build and manage a pipeline of landholders interested in reforestation, lead outreach and onboarding, coordinate site inspections, lead the collection of relevant data required for carbon standard checks, and lead signature of landholder agreements. The role will also play a key role in ensuring compliance (contracts and carbon standards) as well as coordinate schedules between landholders and contractors for the implementation of reforestation activities. This will include confirming site readiness, conducting periodic field quality audits, documenting and tracking progress, and resolving issues that could delay delivery or degrade quality.
The role requires a strong combination stakeholder engagement and management experience, and a commitment to quality and impact. The role requires extensive travel and field work across Minas Gerais, Bahia and Espírito Santo.Primary roles and responsibilities include:
Landholder engagement, onboarding, and pipeline management
Map priority municipalities and referral partner networks (city governments, co-ops, farmer associations, NGOs); plan and run outreach activities, events and information sessions.
Manage the landholder onboarding process (identify → qualify → onboard → contract), using CRM/trackers to keep status, documents and next actions current.
Prepare clear information packs (benefits, obligations, timelines) and respond to inquiries in a timely, professional manner.
Maintain ongoing landholder relationship management to support retention, satisfaction, and smooth site access throughout implementation.
Eligibility, due diligence & agreements
Coordinate site inspections and initial diagnostics in consultation with other team members (parcel boundaries, vegetation status, access, water, risks).
Support land tenure verification and FPIC documentation
Lead closure of contract signatures.
Maintain organized repository of all landholder records within Nature Co’s data management system
(land titles, eligibility documents, contracts, site maps, inspection notes, photos, consultation records).
Reforestation delivery enablement
Translate signed landholder agreements into implementation-ready site plans (site-specific scope, access instructions, constraints, schedule windows).
Align field schedules with landholders and contractors to ensure access, minimize disruption to farm activities, and maintain trust and cooperation.
Support in the delivery of field delivery progress from contractors by site (start/finish dates, activities completed, challenges, next steps), and escalate issues early (access, weather delays, input shortages, labor constraints).
Support in monitoring reforestation activities (during and post planting) and coordinate, where required, rapid response with contractors/landholders (grazing, fire risk, pests, drought stress).
Stakeholder engagement and safeguards
Plan and document stakeholder consultations and community meetings in accordance with Nature Co policies and procedures (agendas, attendance lists, minutes, photos).
Support the team in the operation of the grievance mechanism: receiving grievances and responding in accordance with the Nature Co grievance mechanism.
Maintain landholder contact and ensure landholder information is kept up to date.
Coordinate access, for other project staff and contractors as required.
Reporting
Lead or assist the development of formal monthly, quarterly, and annual project implementation reports for internal and external stakeholders in line with contract and/or carbon standard requirements.
Prepare ad hoc reports, documents, and presentations for internal and external stakeholders.
Teamwork and culture
Support the management of a cross-functional, international team, fostering collaboration and ensuring that project milestones and goals are met.
Stay current on emerging best practices in Nb S and carbon projects; proactively share insights across the organisation and with partners.Skills and attributes
To perform successfully in this role, you will have:
A minimum of five (5) years of experience in reforestation projects with direct contact with rural landholders and reforestation planting service providers.
Degree in forest engineering, agronomy, ecology, or environmental science.

title: Landholder and reforestation delivery manager
description:
About Nature CoNature Co delivers nature-based solutions (Nb S) for investors, corporates and other purpose driven organisations to scale up action on climate change and biodiversity loss. We specialise in nature-based project development including reforestation, agroforestry, farmer managed natural regeneration and mangrove restoration. Nature Co has extensive expertise in working with local communities to protect and restore natural ecosystems through participation in the global voluntary carbon market.
Nature Co is currently implementing a large-scale reforestation project in Brazil for the generation of verified carbon credits.
We are a diverse, mission-driven team that values inclusion, integrity, and innovation. Nature Co is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to building an equitable and inclusive workplace for all.Role and responsibilities
The Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager is the primary field-based interface with landholders, communities, reforestation contractors, and other local stakeholders for Nature Co’s projects in Brazil. This position will build and manage a pipeline of landholders interested in reforestation, lead outreach and onboarding, coordinate site inspections, lead the collection of relevant data required for carbon standard checks, and lead signature of landholder agreements. The role will also play a key role in ensuring compliance (contracts and carbon standards) as well as coordinate schedules between landholders and contractors for the implementation of reforestation activities. This will include confirming site readiness, conducting periodic field quality audits, documenting and tracking progress, and resolving issues that could delay delivery or degrade quality.
The role requires a strong combination stakeholder engagement and management experience, and a commitment to quality and impact. The role requires extensive travel and field work across Minas Gerais, Bahia and Espírito Santo.Primary roles and responsibilities include:
Landholder engagement, onboarding, and pipeline management
Map priority municipalities and referral partner networks (city governments, co-ops, farmer associations, NGOs); plan and run outreach activities, events and information sessions.
Manage the landholder onboarding process (identify → qualify → onboard → contract), using CRM/trackers to keep status, documents and next actions current.
Prepare clear information packs (benefits, obligations, timelines) and respond to inquiries in a timely, professional manner.
Maintain ongoing landholder relationship management to support retention, satisfaction, and smooth site access throughout implementation.
Eligibility, due diligence & agreements
Coordinate site inspections and initial diagnostics in consultation with other team members (parcel boundaries, vegetation status, access, water, risks).
Support land tenure verification and FPIC documentation
Lead closure of contract signatures.
Maintain organized repository of all landholder records within Nature Co’s data management system
(land titles, eligibility documents, contracts, site maps, inspection notes, photos, consultation records).
Reforestation delivery enablement
Translate signed landholder agreements into implementation-ready site plans (site-specific scope, access instructions, constraints, schedule windows).
Align field schedules with landholders and contractors to ensure access, minimize disruption to farm activities, and maintain trust and cooperation.
Support in the delivery of field delivery progress from contractors by site (start/finish dates, activities completed, challenges, next steps), and escalate issues early (access, weather delays, input shortages, labor constraints).
Support in monitoring reforestation activities (during and post planting) and coordinate, where required, rapid response with contractors/landholders (grazing, fire risk, pests, drought stress).
Stakeholder engagement and safeguards
Plan and document stakeholder consultations and community meetings in accordance with Nature Co policies and procedures (agendas, attendance lists, minutes, photos).
Support the team in the operation of the grievance mechanism: receiving grievances and responding in accordance with the Nature Co grievance mechanism.
Maintain landholder contact and ensure landholder information is kept up to date.
Coordinate access, for other project staff and contractors as required.
Reporting
Lead or assist the development of formal monthly, quarterly, and annual project implementation reports for internal and external stakeholders in line with contract and/or carbon standard requirements.
Prepare ad hoc reports, documents, and presentations for internal and external stakeholders.
Teamwork and culture
Support the management of a cross-functional, international team, fostering collaboration and ensuring that project milestones and goals are met.
Stay current on emerging best practices in Nb S and carbon projects; proactively share insights across the organisation and with partners.Skills and attributes
To perform successfully in this role, you will have:
A minimum of five (5) years of experience in reforestation projects with direct contact with rural landholders and reforestation planting service providers.
Degree in forest engineering, agronomy, ecology, or environmental science.
Intermediate English and native Portuguese language skills
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage confidently across cultures and stakeholder groups.
Strong project management skills, including experience managing timelines, deliverables, and working across multidisciplinary teams.
A proactive, self-starting approach with the ability to anticipate problems, adapt quickly, and take initiative under limited supervision.
A collaborative mindset and ability to lead and motivate internal teams and external partners
Ability to provide strategic and technical guidance across complex, multi-stakeholder projects.
Strong organisational skills and attention to detail in documentation and reporting.

title: Subject matter expert – chartered & certified accountants (remote)
description:
Start Date:Ongoing
Screener Criteria:Active professional certification (CPA, ACCA, ACA, etc.)
Eligible Locations: Requirement:Fluent English
Type of contract:Freelance / On-Call Advisory
Hourly Rate:$60.00
Minimum Hours:No minimum
Maximum Hours:Ad hoc / Subject to project availabilityAbout Prolific
Prolific is not just another player in the AI space. We are building the biggest pool of quality human data in the world.
Over 35,000 AI developers, researchers, and organisations use Prolific to gather data from paid study participants with a wide variety of experiences, knowledge, and skills.The Opportunity
We are invitingCertified Accountantsto join our global network of Subject Matter Experts (SMEs). This is not a traditional accounting role; instead, you will be providing expert-level analysis forB2 B and AI Researchprojects that require a deep understanding of fiscal regulations, reporting standards, and financial logic.
Please note:This is a \"bench\" model. By verifying your credentials, you gain eligibility for high-level research tasks as they become available. Access is based on project demand and professional profile matching.What you’ll be doing
When selected for an active project, your tasks will involve:
Professional document analysis:Reviewing complex financial statements, audit reports, and regulatory filings to ensure data integrity.
Domain-specific validation:Answering knowledge-based questions that require an active understanding of international or local accounting standards.
Business logic synthesis:Providing the professional \"human-in-the-loop\" oversight that ensures B2 B research is accurate and enterprise-ready.What you’ll bring
Active certification:You must hold a valid, verifiable professional license (e.g.,CPA, ACCA, ACA, CIMA,or regional equivalent).
Technical rigor:The ability to navigate long-form financial documents and extract precise information under research conditions.
Global perspective:We welcome qualified accountants from around the world who can apply their local or international standards to complex datasets.
Integrity:All participants must undergo a verification process to confirm their active professional standing.Why join this project?
This is a flexible, high-rate opportunity to apply your specialised certification to the forefront of global business research. At$60 per hour , you can contribute your expertise on an ad hoc basis that fits perfectly around your existing clients or firm commitments.Why Prolific is a great platform to join as an expert participant
Joining our platform as a participant will give you the chance to influence the AI models of the future. Once you pass our assessment, you can join Prolific in just 15 minutes and start enjoying competitive pay rates, flexible hours, and the ability to work from home.We've built a unique platform that connects researchers and companies with a global pool of participants, enabling the collection of high-quality, ethically sourced human behavioral data and feedback. This data is the cornerstone of developing more accurate, nuanced, and aligned AI systems.We believe that the next leap in AI capabilities won't come solely from scaling existing models, but from integrating diverse human perspectives and behaviors into AI development. By providing this crucial human data infrastructure, Prolific is positioning itself at the forefront of the next wave of AI innovation – one that reflects the breadth and the best of humanity.Links to more information on Prolific
Website
YoutubePrivacy Statement
By submitting your application, you agree that Prolific may collect your personal data for recruiting and global organization planning. Prolific's Candidate Privacy Notice explains what personal information Prolific may process, where Prolific may process your personal information, its purposes for processing your personal information, and the rights you can exercise over Prolific's use of your personal information.

title: English teacher
description:
Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you!Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good Wi Fi, a webcam, and a microphone.If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach!
Whether you’re looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we’ve got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week.What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at Latin Hire?
You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts.
If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out.
When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that!In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with Latin Hire:Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week!
You be your own boss and set your own schedule
Work from anywhere (as long as you have good Wi Fi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone).
Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month.Minimum Requirements:Portuguese as a first language.
C1 or C2 Level English Speaker
University degree in English Teaching or related area.
One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language.
Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2 MB) internet connection.
Must pass a criminal background check.
Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability.

Marketing service:
Delivery & after-sales: responsible for leveraging internal capability and external resources to deliver marketing service and after-salesMain ResponsibilitiesAlthough the position is a management role the candidate also expected to be hands on and involved wherever required for the regional team to carry out the following responsibilities:Market Research

Market Research/Business Intelligence
Receipe support
`z Sales distributionAccount Based Marketing

They will ensure marketing activities line up with strategies developed and ultimately translate plans to the sales team for execution. They need to ensure the follow steps are covered:
Identify high-value target accounts –Identify key accounts that have the potential to contribute the most to the revenue of your company.
Conduct research on those accounts- Get a good snapshot of customer needs and pain points, as well as where they are in their customer journey.
Develop customized marketing campaigns- Using information you learned in the research phase to inform your strategy, develop creative assets that will resonate with the target account.
Run customized marketing campaigns- Launch your campaigns to the target account.
Measure customized marketing campaigns- Analyze the data to see how your campaigns are performing.Online Marketing

Exhibitions

Build up media relations and ‘Distribution Media List’ for future press release distribution in their assigned region.
Ensure appearance on at least one reputable news website in their assigned region.Qualifications (Education/Knowledge/Working Experience)Master’s degree in a Marketing related discipline.
Around 10 years of experience

Strategic Planning:Regional Marketing Managers must be adept at developing and executing marketing strategies that align with overall business objectives. This includes setting clear goals, defining KPIs, and creating actionable plans.
Team Leadership and Management:Effective leadership skills are important for managing and motivating a team of marketing professionals. This includes providing guidance, setting expectations, and facilitating collaboration.
Cross-Functional Collaboration:Regional Marketing Managers need to work closely with various departments like sales, product development, and supply chain to ensure that marketing initiatives are aligned with overall business operations.
Brand Management:They should have the ability to maintain and enhance the brand image in the specified region. This involves ensuring consistency in messaging, visual identity, and customer experience.
Campaign Management:This skill involves planning, executing, and optimizing marketing campaigns. It requires the ability to set clear objectives, target the right audience, and measure the effectiveness of campaigns.
Budget Management:Effective allocation and management of marketing budgets are essential for maximizing return on investment (ROI) and ensuring that resources are used efficiently.
Data Analysis and Interpretation:Proficiency in using data analytics tools to measure campaign performance, track key metrics, and derive actionable insights is crucial for making informed marketing decisions.
Communication Skills:Strong written and verbal communication skills are necessary for conveying marketing messages effectively to various stakeholders, including team members, executives, and external partners.
Adaptability and Flexibility:The ability to adapt to changing market conditions, consumer preferences, and industry trends is vital for staying competitive and achieving long-term success.
Problem-Solving Skills:Regional Marketing Managers should be able to identify challenges and develop creative solutions to overcome them. This includes being resourceful and thinking critically.
Cultural Awareness and Sensitivity:Especially in a regional role, understanding and respecting cultural nuances and preferences is important for tailoring marketing strategies to specific markets.
