title: Devops engineer
description:
We're looking for a Dev Ops / Cloud Lead who knows how to design, automate, and operate cloud infrastructure.This role focuses heavily on Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) due to a strategic partnership in that ecosystem. Many of our clients are migrating infrastructure to OCI or need help operating multi-cloud environments.
We need someone who can design solutions, automate processes, and solve infrastructure problems, not just maintain pipelines.Why this role exists
We have a strategic partnership with Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI). Clients are asking us to migrate infrastructure to OCI, and many of them also need ongoing Dev Ops operations and architecture support.
We need someone who can own this technically. Not just executing tasks, but executing the task is an important part of the job as well.
Design solutions. Talk to clients. Automate migrations. Coordinate engineers. And when necessary, jump in and fix things yourself.TL; DR
You will help lead cloud and Dev Ops initiatives at Quave. Your job is to:
Lead cloud migrations to OCI
Design cloud architectures
Automate migrations and infrastructure
Coordinate Dev Ops engineers
Talk directly to clients
Help build repeatable Dev Ops processes
You must be strong in OCI, comfortable with AWS / Azure / GCP, hands-on, obsessed with automation, and comfortable discussing technical architecture with clients.
English is a plus, not required.This is not a ticket-based Dev Ops job
If you're looking for a role where you maintain Jenkins pipelines, restart servers, open support tickets, and wait for instructions, this is not the role for you.
This role is about designing and solving infrastructure problems. We want someone who can look at a system and think:\"We can automate 80% of this.\"
And then actually build the automation.What you'll actually do
Cloud Architecture Design infrastructure for systems running in OCI, AWS, Azure, and GCP, migrating from one to another.Cloud Migrations
A lot of our work will be migrations like AWS → OCI, Azure → OCI, GCP → OCI.
Your job is not just to do the migration, but to help us turn migrations into repeatable processes, scripts, templates, automation and tooling so that each migration becomes easier than the last.Automation
We want to automate everything that can be automated:
Automated infrastructure provisioning
Migration scripts
CI/CD pipelines
Environment replication
Monitoring setups
If you like writing scripts that replace hours of manual work, you'll enjoy this role.Client Discussions
You will often join calls with clients to understand infrastructure problems, design migration strategies, estimate effort, and propose solutions. You must be comfortable discussing technical topics clearly.Leading Dev Ops Engineers
As the Dev Ops work grows, you'll coordinate other engineers working on projects, reviewing architecture, guiding implementations, and ensuring quality.What we're looking for
You probably have many years working with infrastructure. But more importantly, you have good instincts about systems.
You likely:
Love automating infrastructure
Hate manual processes
Can quickly understand unfamiliar systems
Are comfortable debugging production environments
Enjoy designing architectures
Can communicate clearly with both engineers and clients
You should also be comfortable using AI tools to accelerate your work. Tools like Chat GPT, Claude, and Cursor can dramatically increase productivity when used well. We expect you to take advantage of that.Technical Expectations
Cloud
Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) - important
AWS
Azure
GCP
Dev Ops
Docker
Kubernetes
Terraform or other Infrastructure-as-Code tools
CI/CD pipelines
Linux systems administration
Networking fundamentals
Automation
Comfortable writing scripts in Bash, Python, Go, or similar.Languages
Portuguese required. English is a plus as some clients are international, so it may eventually become useful in the future, but it's not required.Why work with Quave
We are a small, profitable, independent company. No investors. No corporate bureaucracy. We focus on doing great work for clients and building great software.
Things we value: Speed. Quality. Pragmatism. Autonomy.
Quave literally stands for Quality (Qua) and Velocity (Ve).Pay and Benefits
This is a full-time remote position. Compensation will depend on experience.
Fully remote work
Flexible hours
22 days paid time off per year
Quarterly bonus based on company performance
AI allowance for productivity tools
We work as a distributed team of independent contractors.Hiring Process
Application review
Technical conversation
Architecture discussion
Conversation(s) with one or more partners
This is a leadership role and you will coordinate other engineers as the Dev Ops work grows. But at Quave our leaders are hands-on. You should be comfortable writing automation and infrastructure code yourself when needed.

title: Software engineering manager
description:
ABOUT US
Syniti, part of Capgemini, tackles the hardest work in data for the world’s largest organizations. We combine intelligent software with deep data expertise to help the Fortune2000 tackle complex data challenges and drive measurable business outcomes with business-ready data.Syniti’s Data First strategy transforms data from an afterthought into a strategic asset—unlocking insights, reducing risk, and fueling growth. With over 5,000 successful projects, we support the full data lifecycle through a unified platform for migration, quality, replication, matching, master data management, analytics, governance, and strategy. Operating globally across industries, Syniti’s award-winning software, expert consultants give enterprises a unique edge in managing and maximizing their data.Syniti’s cloud-native platform sets new standards in enterprise data management, combining powerful Saa S solutions with deep domain expertise. Designed for agility and scale, our technology helps customers accelerate digital transformation, drive innovation, and make confident decisions with trusted data. Every product enhancement is built to solve real business challenges—empowering organizations to unlock value from their data faster and more effectively.THE ROLE
The Manager I of Engineering plays a key leadership role, directly managing a small team of software engineers. This role is responsible for ensuring timely delivery of high-quality software projects, fostering a collaborative and inclusive team culture, and supporting the professional growth of engineers.
In addition to leading day-to-day execution, this manager contributes to tactical decision-making, participates in architectural discussions, and ensures engineering efforts are aligned with project goals. They collaborate closely with product, design, and cross-functional stakeholders to deliver solutions that support Syniti’s broader mission.WHAT YOU WILL DO
• Manage and support a team of software engineers, ensuring projects are delivered on time and within scope.
• Provide coaching, mentorship, and regular performance feedback to support individual growth.
• Guide the team in applying engineering best practices, including code reviews, testing, and secure development.
• Participate in architectural and technical design discussions, ensuring sound engineering decisions.
• Collaborate closely with product and cross-functional teams to align priorities and deliver value.
• Help shape a positive and inclusive team culture that fosters engagement, learning, and innovation.
• Identify and address delivery risks, blockers, or process gaps within the team’s scope.
• Contribute to hiring and onboarding of new engineers, and support team scaling efforts.WHAT IT TAKES
• Proven experience as a team lead or first-line engineering manager in a software development environment.
• Strong technical foundation in modern software development (e.g., C#, Go, React, Type Script, AWS).
• Familiarity with agile development methodologies, Dev Ops practices, and software delivery processes.
• Excellent communication and collaboration skills across technical and non-technical stakeholders.
• Demonstrated ability to coach, mentor, and support the growth of engineering team members.
• Experience participating in technical design, architecture reviews, and secure development practices.
• Comfortable working in a fast-paced, distributed, and cross-functional environment.Be fully aligned to our core values:
• Think Big - Be courageous and bold. Aspire to greatness. Relentlessly pursue market innovation. Set the standard by which others follow. Create solutions that have a meaningful impact. Solve the challenges our customers don’t know they have.
• Be Curious - Be a lifelong learner. Seek out new ideas to serve customers. Understand our competition and the world. Be permanently dissatisfied with the status quo. Challenge preconceptions. Focus on the future rather than yesterday.
• Take Action - Be the first. Don’t wait. Take accountability. Inspire others by doing. Fail fast and learn from mistakes. Make a difference every day.
• Stronger Together - Respect, trust and look out for each other. Celebrate diverse perspectives. Listen. Build connections and belonging. Act with integrity. Give back. One Syniti family.WHAT WE OFFER
• Trust in your talent. At Syniti you will find a supportive environment and access to learning tools, but micromanagement is not our style.
• Growth. We are growing rapidly and steadily solving the biggest challenges enterprise companies are faced with today. There was never a better time to join and grow with us. Most importantly you will have the chance to shape our journey and share in our success story.
• Support. We all rely on each other and enable each other to be successful. You won’t stand alone.
• Curiosity and genuine interest in you. We all have our different stories, all equally fascinating with each depicting a different journey and we want to hear them all.
• Recognition. We are the sum of individual achievements, and we always take the time to celebrate them.
• An open organisation. Titles don’t define access at Syniti. We stay humble regardless of where we sit in the organisation. We want to hear every voice, listen to all the ideas and make sure everyone’s work is seen and valued.

description:

Language:Native or professional fluency in bothEnglish and Portugueseis mandatory.
Mainframe DB2 LUW

title: Engenheiro de software sênior (remoto)
description:
Ola!A Aggrandize nasceu em 2015 com a missão deengrandecer pessoas e negócios. Guiados por valores como adaptabilidade, colaboração, foco no cliente e visão de dono, oferecemos soluções que transformam desafios em oportunidades.Somos especialistas emPlatform Engineering ,Data Analytics ,Modern ApplicationseCybersecurity , sempre com o compromisso de impulsionar o crescimento e a inovação de nossos parceiros.Nosso trabalho é mais do que tecnologia; é sobre potencializar resultados.Increase the power of your business.Agora que você conhece a cultura Aggrandize, saiba mais sobre a oportunidade:Estamos em busca de um (a) Engenheiro (a) de Software com IA para projetar, desenvolver e evoluir soluções que utilizam Inteligência Artificial e Machine Learning, atuando de ponta a ponta, da concepção técnica até a implementação em produção.
Essa pessoa trabalhará em conjunto com times de produto, dados e negócios para transformar desafios reais em soluções escaláveis, seguras e de alto impacto.❇️ O seu papel no time:
Projetar e desenvolver aplicações de software que incorporem modelos de IA e Machine Learning;
Integrar modelos de IA a sistemas existentes, APIs, pipelines de dados e arquiteturas distribuídas;
Colaborar com cientistas de dados e engenheiros de dados na construção, treinamento, versionamento e deploy de modelos;
Implementar práticas de MLOps, garantindo automação, monitoramento, rastreabilidade e escalabilidade dos modelos em produção;
Desenvolver soluções baseadas em LLMs (Large Language Models) como chatbots, sistemas de recomendação, classificação, busca semântica e automação inteligente;
Garantir qualidade de código, segurança, performance e boas práticas de engenharia de software;
Participar de decisões de arquitetura, revisões técnicas e definição de padrões;
Atuar na melhoria contínua das soluções, avaliando métricas de performance dos modelos e do software;
Documentar soluções técnicas e compartilhar conhecimento com o time.❇️ O que esperamos de você - Hard Skills:
Sólida experiência em engenharia de software (backend e/ou full stack);
Proficiência em linguagens como Python, Java, Go, Java Script ou Type Script;
Experiência com frameworks e bibliotecas de IA e Machine Learning (Tensor Flow, Py Torch, Scikit-learn, Lang Chain ou Hugging Face);
Conhecimento em APIs, microserviços e arquiteturas orientadas a eventos;
Experiência com cloud computing (Google Cloud ou Azure);
Familiaridade com containers e orquestração (Docker, Kubernetes);
Conhecimento em bancos de dados relacionais e não relacionais;
Experiência com versionamento de código (Git) e práticas de CI/CD.❇️ Diferenciais:
Experiência prática com LLMs, Gen AI, RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) e fine-tuning de modelos;
Conhecimento em ferramentas de dados como Databricks, Big Query ou Spark;
Experiência com MLOps (MLflow, Kubeflow ou Vertex AI);
Vivência em ambientes de alta escala ou sistemas críticos;
Conhecimento em segurança aplicada à IA e governança de dados;
Experiência prévia em produtos digitais orientados a dados.❇️ O que esperamos de você - Soft Skills:
Adaptabilidade;
Colaboração;
Visão de dono;
Foco no cliente;
Pensamento analítico e capacidade de resolução de problemas complexos;
Capacidade de traduzir necessidades de negócio em soluções técnicas;
Comunicação clara e colaboração com times multidisciplinares;
Proatividade e senso de responsabilidade técnica;
Curiosidade e atualização constante sobre novas tecnologias de IA.

title: Analista de relações com investidores e esg iii
description:
Descrição da vaga
AHelbor Empreendimentos S. A.é uma das incorporadoras mais tradicionais do mercado imobiliário brasileiro, com mais de quatro décadas de atuação. Companhia aberta listada no Novo Mercado daB3 , a Helbor tem como compromisso a transparência, a ética e a criação de valor sustentável para seus acionistas e para a sociedade.
Estamos em busca de um(a)Analista Sênior de Relações com Investidores e ESGpara integrar nossa área de RI, atuando diretamente no suporte às atividades de comunicação com o mercado de capitais e no fortalecimento da agenda de sustentabilidade da companhia.
A área de Relações com Investidores possui papel estratégico na companhia, sendo responsável pela interface com investidores, analistas de mercado, órgãos reguladores e demais stakeholders, garantindo a qualidade, consistência e transparência das informações divulgadas ao mercado.
Buscamos um(a) profissional com perfil analítico, organizado(a), com excelente capacidade de comunicação e interesse em mercado de capitais e temas relacionados a ESG. A pessoa selecionada terá a oportunidade de atuar em um ambiente dinâmico, com alto nível de exposição a temas estratégicos da companhia e contato direto com diferentes áreas internas e participantes do mercado.
Responsabilidades e atribuiçõesApoiar a elaboração e revisão de materiais de divulgação ao mercado, como Release de Resultados, Apresentações Institucionais, Formulário de Referência e Relatórios Anuais;
Apoiar a preparação e organização de conference calls, reuniões com investidores, analistas e roadshows;
Interagir com diversas áreas internas (Contabilidade, Controladoria, Jurídico, Planejamento e Operações) para coleta e consolidação de informações para divulgação ao mercado;
Auxiliar no monitoramento de indicadores operacionais e financeiros da companhia e de seus pares;
Apoiar o acompanhamento de temas regulatórios relacionados ao mercado de capitais;
Participar da elaboração e acompanhamento de iniciativas relacionadas à agenda ESG;
Apoiar na elaboração de relatórios e questionários de sustentabilidade, bem como no relacionamento com agências de rating ESG;
Auxiliar no acompanhamento da percepção do mercado sobre a companhia e na elaboração de análises de mercado e benchmarking com empresas do setor;
Contribuir para o aprimoramento contínuo das práticas de transparência e governança da companhia.Requisitos e qualificaçõesFormação superior em Administração, Economia, Engenharia, Contabilidade ou áreas correlatas;
Experiência prévia em Relações com Investidores, mercado de capitais, equity research, consultorias ou áreas financeiras;
Conhecimento sobre demonstrações financeiras e indicadores econômico-financeiros;
Familiaridade com rotinas de companhias abertas e regulamentação aplicável;
Interesse ou experiência com temas relacionados a ESG e sustentabilidade corporativa;
Inglês avançado (especialmente para leitura e comunicação escrita);
Excel e Power Point em nível avançado;
Perfil analítico, organizado, com atenção a detalhes e boa capacidade de comunicação escrita e verbal.Informações adicionais

title: Senior technical business analyst
description:
Elastacloud (An Acora Group Company) OverviewElastacloud (An Acoura Group Company) are a progressive full-stack full-service business technology services partner, built for the AI era. Combining the capabilities of a Managed Service Provider (MSP), Managed Security Service Provider (MSSP), IT Consulting, Professional Services and Development company, Acora helps customers achieve breakthrough results - often quicker and at lower risk than they thought possible.We believe in a better working world, where our customers are confident to fully embrace the AI opportunity and generate economic impact.Role Overview
We are looking for a Senior Technical Business Analyst with strong hands-on experience in data, AI-driven projects and software, particularly in Data Transformation initiatives.This professional will act as a bridge between business stakeholders and technical teams, translating complex business needs into well-structured technical requirements and user stories. The role requires someone highly technical, delivery-oriented, and comfortable operating in Agile environments, including leading Scrum ceremonies and acting as Project Manager when required.The position involves daily interaction with teams in Australia and regular contact with the UK, so strong English communication skills and time zone flexibility are essential.Role Responsibilities
Lead requirement gathering sessions with business stakeholders (Australia & UK).
Translate business needs into clear, structured, and technically detailed user stories.
Define functional and non-functional requirements for data and AI solutions.
Work closely with data engineers, software engineers, architects, and AI specialists.
Design and document data flows, process maps, integration points, and system dependencies.
Support Data Transformation initiatives (data migration, data modelling, governance, pipelines).
Define acceptance criteria and validation rules.
Conduct backlog refinement sessions and prioritisation workshops.
Lead Scrum ceremonies (planning, refinement, daily, review, retrospective).
Act as Project Manager when needed (timeline tracking, risk management, stakeholder reporting).
Support UAT coordination and solution validation.
Ensure alignment between business objectives and technical delivery.
Manage documentation in tools such as Dev Ops, Jira or similar.Key Skills, Knowledge & Experience
5+ years of experience as Business Analyst in technical/software projects.
Proven experience in Data projects.
Technical background in:
Data architecture concepts
APIs & system integrations
Cloud environments (Azure, AWS or GCP)
Data modelling methodologies (BEAM, Kimbal, etc.)
Experience working in AI-related initiatives (ML models, automation, data pipelines, or analytics projects).
Experience writing detailed technical user stories for engineering teams.
Hands-on experience working with Agile/Scrum methodology.
Experience leading Scrum ceremonies.
Previous experience as a Project Manager would be beneficial but is not required. The core skills we are looking for are related to a Business Analyst with a focus on Data.
Strong stakeholder management skills.
Excellent written and verbal English (mandatory).
Availability to work overlapping with Australia (preferably 13:00–22:00 BRT).Our Values
We’re proud to share the values we live by. They’re not dusty abstract concepts. Our values define our culture: they act as a promise to our customers and a constant challenge to ourselves, both as individuals and as a team, to be Game-Changers.#1 Be the best you can be
We challenge ourselves to raise our game each day. By embracing a mindset of growth, we continuously strive to improve ourselves, our ways of working, and the service we deliver to our customers.#2 We do what we say.
When we make a promise, we follow-through - no excuses. We don’t leave anyone hanging or walk away from challenges. Reliable and focused, we value clear communication to build trust and give customers, and colleagues, the confidence they can count on us every time.#3 Together we win.
Business is the biggest team sport of them all. By communicating well, breaking down silos and staying aligned, we create clarity and focus. Strong relationships, shared goals and commitment make us a winning team – for each other and for our customers.Equal Opportunities at Acora
Acora is an equal opportunity employer, committed to providing equal opportunities regardless of race or ethnic origin, gender identity, family situation, sexual orientation, disability, religion or age. We hire our people on the basis of qualifications, merit, skills, and business need.Acora is a Level 1 Disability Confident Committed Employer and will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, perform essential job functions, and receive equitable benefits and all privileges of employment. Please contact us to request any reasonable adjustments.

title: Senior business analyst – supply chain
description:
Who We Are
We are an IFS integrator, providing end-to-end ERP implementation projects and exceptional support services. As strategic business partners, we collaborate with clients across key industries, helping them drive digital transformation.
Our global team of 200+ members brings extensive expertise, including former IFS customers who understand real-world operational challenges and dedicated IFS specialists with deep functional and technical knowledge. Together, we deliver outstanding services to reshape businesses and optimize supply chain operations.Who We Are Looking For
We are currently seeking aSenior Business Analyst – Supply Chain , a client-facing leadership role responsible for driving complex ERP implementations within supply chain domains (procurement, inventory, logistics, planning, and distribution).
This role requires a strong functional expert who can lead requirement gathering, solution design, and implementation while acting as a key advisor to clients and an escalation point for junior analysts.
If you are passionate about supply chain optimization, ERP transformation, and leading cross-functional collaboration in global projects, we encourage you to apply.Key Responsibilities
Business Requirements & Client Engagement
• Lead requirement gathering sessions with stakeholders across supply chain functions.
• Analyze business processes (procurement, inventory, warehousing, logistics) to identify improvements and optimization opportunities.
• Translate complex supply chain and technical concepts into clear language for non-technical stakeholders.
• Perform gap analysis between current operations and ERP capabilities, ensuring scalable and efficient solutions.
• Advise clients on best practices aligned with industry standards and digital transformation strategies.Solution Design, Implementation & Testing
• Lead supply chain module implementation within ERP (IFS or similar).
• Supervise and mentor Business Analysts and Junior Analysts within the domain.
• Collaborate with Project Managers on planning, estimations, and risk mitigation.
• Work closely with development and technical teams to ensure accurate solution delivery.
• Lead design discussions to align system architecture with business objectives.
• Ensure quality assurance testing and validation of supply chain functionalities.
• Support cross-functional alignment with Solution Architects and other domains.
• Deliver user training sessions and create functional documentation to ensure adoption.Training, Expertise & Continuous Improvement (20%)
• Act as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) in supply chain processes and ERP functionalities.
• Stay up to date with industry trends, including digital supply chain, automation, and best practices.
• Maintain relevant certifications (IFS or equivalent ERP modules).
• Drive continuous improvement initiatives across projects and internal practices.Must Have
• Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Industrial Engineering, Business, or related field.
• Minimum 5 years of experience in supply chain processes (procurement, logistics, inventory, planning).
• Minimum 3 years in client-facing roles.
• Experience in ERP implementation projects (IFS preferred).
• Strong understanding of supply chain operations across industries such as Manufacturing, Energy, Construction, or Services.
• Fluent in Portuguese and English (Spanish or French is a plus).
• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
• Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving capabilities.
• Experience with project management and collaboration tools.
• Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office.
• Availability to travel.
• Legally authorized to work in Brazil.What We Offer
• Competitive salary and benefits package.
• Career growth opportunities with certifications and professional development.
• A collaborative and international work environment.
• Involvement in high-impact global supply chain transformation projects.Why Hoist?
If you are looking for an opportunity to lead impactful supply chain transformations and grow your career in a dynamic and global environment, Hoist is the place for you.
Join our team and be part of a people-first culture that values collaboration, innovation, and professional growth.

title: Marketing specialist
description:
About Mosaic PuzzlesMosaic Puzzles is a jigsaw puzzle company based in Alpharetta, Georgia. We design and build unique wooden puzzles where every piece is part of the story. Our collections blend intricate art, clever cut designs, and premium craftsmanship.We’re a fast-paced, growing startup led by former Uber and Amazon team members, and we’re looking for someone excited to move quickly and contribute ideas that make a real impact.Check our website for more information:Position Overview
We’re looking for a creative, detail-oriented, and results-drivenMarketing Specialistto join our team. This role combines strong execution skills with analytical thinking and excellent project management.This role supports the planning and execution of marketing initiatives across multiple channels including email, SMS, social media, and website content. The ideal candidate is highly organized, comfortable working with data, and able to manage multiple marketing projects simultaneously.You will work closely with other company departments to execute campaigns, analyze performance, and continuously improve how customers discover and engage with our products.Key ResponsibilitiesMarketing Strategy & Campaign Execution
Assist in the planning and execution of marketing campaigns across email, SMS, social media, website content, and seasonal promotions.
Coordinate campaign timelines and marketing calendars to support product launches, seasonal initiatives, and brand campaigns.
Support lifecycle marketing initiatives including newsletters, SMS campaigns, product launches, and promotional moments.
Collaborate with the team to identify marketing opportunities and propose ideas that improve campaign performance.Content & Brand Communication
Write clear, engaging copy for newsletters, SMS campaigns, social media, blog posts, and other marketing materials.
Maintain a consistent brand voice across all marketing channels.
Coordinate content calendars aligned with seasonal themes, product launches, and marketing priorities.
Monitor social media conversations and user-generated content to identify engagement opportunities.Digital Marketing & Analytics
Track and analyze campaign performance across email, SMS, social media, and website channels.
Interpret marketing data and provide actionable insights to improve campaign performance.
Assist with SEO initiatives including keyword research, content optimization, and website improvements.
Support customer surveys and feedback analysis to help inform product and marketing decisions.Project Management & Cross-Functional Collaboration
Manage multiple marketing projects and deadlines simultaneously.
Work with designers, photographers, videographers, and other cross-functional partners to prepare creative briefs and campaign assets.
Ensure marketing initiatives are delivered on time and aligned with campaign goals.
Maintain a high level of organization and attention to detail across all marketing initiatives.Requirements
Fluent in English (C1 level or higher). Exceptional written and spoken communication is essential.
Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, or a related field.
3+ years of experience in marketing, digital marketing, or content marketing.
Solid understanding ofdigital marketing analytics and performance tracking.
Strong organizational and project management skills.
Experience working with email and SMS marketing platforms such as Mailchimp, Attentive, or similar tools.
Ability to manage multiple projects and shifting priorities in a fast-paced environment.
Proactive mindset with the ability to suggest ideas and take initiative.
Strong copywriting skills with a knack for storytelling and brand voice.
Experience managing social media accounts and understanding platform best practices.
Solid understanding of digital marketing principles, including email marketing and social content strategy.
Knowledge of SEO is a plus.How to Apply
Candidates must submit their resumes in English. Applications submitted in other languages will not be considered.Mosaic Cultural Values Alignment
The ideal candidate will embody Mosaic’s cultural values, including:
Owner’s Mindset: Working hard, helping others, and proactively contributing.
Process Orientation: Showing your work and thinking ahead.
Moving Quickly: Taking initiative and being proactive.
Taking Responsibility: Owning your actions.
Valuing Ideas Over Hierarchy: Contributing creatively and openly.
Continuous Improvement: Always seeking better ways to work.
Doing the Right Thing: Acting with integrity.
Believing in Meritocracy: Recognizing and rewarding performance.
Resourcefulness: Finding cost-effective and practical solutions.

title: Senior database engineer / lead dba (db2 luw & cloud migration) – bilingual (en/pt)
description:
We are hiring for a USA company:Senior Database Engineer / Lead DBA (DB2 LUW & Cloud Migration) – Bilingual (EN/PT)About the Role:
We are seeking a highly skilledSenior Database Administrator (DBA)to join our GlobalMainframe DB2 LUWteam. This is not a typical application development role; we are looking for a "under-the-hood" expert who understands database internals, performance optimization, and the complexities of migrating data between No SQL and Relational environments.
As a technical lead, you will manage high-stakes backend operations, automate audit compliance, and guide the team through complex data mapping and environment refreshes.
What You Will Do
Core Administration:Perform deep-dive backend management ofDB2 LUW(Linux, Unix, Windows) environments.
Environment Management:Execute test environment refreshes and manage data flow from Archive (AR) environments into active test streams.
Modernization & Migration:Lead the charge in migrating data fromNo SQL to Relationaldatabases, focusing on complex data mapping, relationship building, and schema design.
Cloud & No SQL:Manage tasks related toAWS RDSandNo SQLplatforms, ensuring high availability and performance.
Automation & Compliance:Develop automation scripts for audit compliance and security protocols.
Performance Tuning:Act as the subject matter expert for advancedSQL tuningand database optimization.
Mentorship:Provide technical guidance and leadership to junior and mid-level engineers.
Required Qualifications
Language:Native or professional fluency in bothEnglish and Portugueseis mandatory.
Mainframe DB2 LUW
Expertise in DB2 LUW:Extensive experience in backend DB2 LUW administration (not just interfacing via apps).
Migration Experience:Proven track record of migrating data between different architectures (Relational vs. No SQL).
Cloud Infrastructure:Hands-on experience withAmazon RDSandNo SQLdatabases.
Advanced Tuning:Expert-level ability to diagnose and resolve complex SQL performance issues.
Location:Remote friendly—we value your skillset over your physical location.

title: Devops engineer
description:
We're looking for a Dev Ops / Cloud Lead who knows how to design, automate, and operate cloud infrastructure.This role focuses heavily on Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) due to a strategic partnership in that ecosystem. Many of our clients are migrating infrastructure to OCI or need help operating multi-cloud environments.
We need someone who can design solutions, automate processes, and solve infrastructure problems, not just maintain pipelines.Why this role exists
We have a strategic partnership with Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI). Clients are asking us to migrate infrastructure to OCI, and many of them also need ongoing Dev Ops operations and architecture support.
We need someone who can own this technically. Not just executing tasks, but executing the task is an important part of the job as well.
Design solutions. Talk to clients. Automate migrations. Coordinate engineers. And when necessary, jump in and fix things yourself.TL; DR
You will help lead cloud and Dev Ops initiatives at Quave. Your job is to:
Lead cloud migrations to OCI
Design cloud architectures
Automate migrations and infrastructure
Coordinate Dev Ops engineers
Talk directly to clients
Help build repeatable Dev Ops processes
You must be strong in OCI, comfortable with AWS / Azure / GCP, hands-on, obsessed with automation, and comfortable discussing technical architecture with clients.
English is a plus, not required.This is not a ticket-based Dev Ops job
If you're looking for a role where you maintain Jenkins pipelines, restart servers, open support tickets, and wait for instructions, this is not the role for you.
This role is about designing and solving infrastructure problems. We want someone who can look at a system and think:\"We can automate 80% of this.\"
And then actually build the automation.What you'll actually do
Cloud Architecture Design infrastructure for systems running in OCI, AWS, Azure, and GCP, migrating from one to another.Cloud Migrations
A lot of our work will be migrations like AWS → OCI, Azure → OCI, GCP → OCI.
Your job is not just to do the migration, but to help us turn migrations into repeatable processes, scripts, templates, automation and tooling so that each migration becomes easier than the last.Automation
We want to automate everything that can be automated:
Automated infrastructure provisioning
Migration scripts
CI/CD pipelines
Environment replication
Monitoring setups
If you like writing scripts that replace hours of manual work, you'll enjoy this role.Client Discussions
You will often join calls with clients to understand infrastructure problems, design migration strategies, estimate effort, and propose solutions. You must be comfortable discussing technical topics clearly.Leading Dev Ops Engineers
As the Dev Ops work grows, you'll coordinate other engineers working on projects, reviewing architecture, guiding implementations, and ensuring quality.What we're looking for
You probably have many years working with infrastructure. But more importantly, you have good instincts about systems.
You likely:
Love automating infrastructure
Hate manual processes
Can quickly understand unfamiliar systems
Are comfortable debugging production environments
Enjoy designing architectures
Can communicate clearly with both engineers and clients
You should also be comfortable using AI tools to accelerate your work. Tools like Chat GPT, Claude, and Cursor can dramatically increase productivity when used well. We expect you to take advantage of that.Technical Expectations
Cloud
Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) - important
AWS
Azure
GCP
Dev Ops
Docker
Kubernetes
Terraform or other Infrastructure-as-Code tools
CI/CD pipelines
Linux systems administration
Networking fundamentals
Automation
Comfortable writing scripts in Bash, Python, Go, or similar.Languages
Portuguese required. English is a plus as some clients are international, so it may eventually become useful in the future, but it's not required.Why work with Quave
We are a small, profitable, independent company. No investors. No corporate bureaucracy. We focus on doing great work for clients and building great software.
Things we value: Speed. Quality. Pragmatism. Autonomy.
Quave literally stands for Quality (Qua) and Velocity (Ve).Pay and Benefits
This is a full-time remote position. Compensation will depend on experience.
Fully remote work
Flexible hours
22 days paid time off per year
Quarterly bonus based on company performance
AI allowance for productivity tools
We work as a distributed team of independent contractors.Hiring Process
Application review
Technical conversation
Architecture discussion
Conversation(s) with one or more partners
This is a leadership role and you will coordinate other engineers as the Dev Ops work grows. But at Quave our leaders are hands-on. You should be comfortable writing automation and infrastructure code yourself when needed.

title: Software engineering manager
description:
ABOUT US
Syniti, part of Capgemini, tackles the hardest work in data for the world’s largest organizations. We combine intelligent software with deep data expertise to help the Fortune2000 tackle complex data challenges and drive measurable business outcomes with business-ready data.Syniti’s Data First strategy transforms data from an afterthought into a strategic asset—unlocking insights, reducing risk, and fueling growth. With over 5,000 successful projects, we support the full data lifecycle through a unified platform for migration, quality, replication, matching, master data management, analytics, governance, and strategy. Operating globally across industries, Syniti’s award-winning software, expert consultants give enterprises a unique edge in managing and maximizing their data.Syniti’s cloud-native platform sets new standards in enterprise data management, combining powerful Saa S solutions with deep domain expertise. Designed for agility and scale, our technology helps customers accelerate digital transformation, drive innovation, and make confident decisions with trusted data. Every product enhancement is built to solve real business challenges—empowering organizations to unlock value from their data faster and more effectively.THE ROLE
The Manager I of Engineering plays a key leadership role, directly managing a small team of software engineers. This role is responsible for ensuring timely delivery of high-quality software projects, fostering a collaborative and inclusive team culture, and supporting the professional growth of engineers.
In addition to leading day-to-day execution, this manager contributes to tactical decision-making, participates in architectural discussions, and ensures engineering efforts are aligned with project goals. They collaborate closely with product, design, and cross-functional stakeholders to deliver solutions that support Syniti’s broader mission.WHAT YOU WILL DO
• Manage and support a team of software engineers, ensuring projects are delivered on time and within scope.
• Provide coaching, mentorship, and regular performance feedback to support individual growth.
• Guide the team in applying engineering best practices, including code reviews, testing, and secure development.
• Participate in architectural and technical design discussions, ensuring sound engineering decisions.
• Collaborate closely with product and cross-functional teams to align priorities and deliver value.
• Help shape a positive and inclusive team culture that fosters engagement, learning, and innovation.
• Identify and address delivery risks, blockers, or process gaps within the team’s scope.
• Contribute to hiring and onboarding of new engineers, and support team scaling efforts.WHAT IT TAKES
• Proven experience as a team lead or first-line engineering manager in a software development environment.
• Strong technical foundation in modern software development (e.g., C#, Go, React, Type Script, AWS).
• Familiarity with agile development methodologies, Dev Ops practices, and software delivery processes.
• Excellent communication and collaboration skills across technical and non-technical stakeholders.
• Demonstrated ability to coach, mentor, and support the growth of engineering team members.
• Experience participating in technical design, architecture reviews, and secure development practices.
• Comfortable working in a fast-paced, distributed, and cross-functional environment.Be fully aligned to our core values:
• Think Big - Be courageous and bold. Aspire to greatness. Relentlessly pursue market innovation. Set the standard by which others follow. Create solutions that have a meaningful impact. Solve the challenges our customers don’t know they have.
• Be Curious - Be a lifelong learner. Seek out new ideas to serve customers. Understand our competition and the world. Be permanently dissatisfied with the status quo. Challenge preconceptions. Focus on the future rather than yesterday.
• Take Action - Be the first. Don’t wait. Take accountability. Inspire others by doing. Fail fast and learn from mistakes. Make a difference every day.
• Stronger Together - Respect, trust and look out for each other. Celebrate diverse perspectives. Listen. Build connections and belonging. Act with integrity. Give back. One Syniti family.WHAT WE OFFER
• Trust in your talent. At Syniti you will find a supportive environment and access to learning tools, but micromanagement is not our style.
• Growth. We are growing rapidly and steadily solving the biggest challenges enterprise companies are faced with today. There was never a better time to join and grow with us. Most importantly you will have the chance to shape our journey and share in our success story.
• Support. We all rely on each other and enable each other to be successful. You won’t stand alone.
• Curiosity and genuine interest in you. We all have our different stories, all equally fascinating with each depicting a different journey and we want to hear them all.
• Recognition. We are the sum of individual achievements, and we always take the time to celebrate them.
• An open organisation. Titles don’t define access at Syniti. We stay humble regardless of where we sit in the organisation. We want to hear every voice, listen to all the ideas and make sure everyone’s work is seen and valued.

title: Landholder and reforestation delivery manager
description:
About Nature CoNature Co delivers nature-based solutions (Nb S) for investors, corporates and other purpose driven organisations to scale up action on climate change and biodiversity loss. We specialise in nature-based project development including reforestation, agroforestry, farmer managed natural regeneration and mangrove restoration. Nature Co has extensive expertise in working with local communities to protect and restore natural ecosystems through participation in the global voluntary carbon market.
Nature Co is currently implementing a large-scale reforestation project in Brazil for the generation of verified carbon credits.
We are a diverse, mission-driven team that values inclusion, integrity, and innovation. Nature Co is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to building an equitable and inclusive workplace for all.Role and responsibilities
The Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager is the primary field-based interface with landholders, communities, reforestation contractors, and other local stakeholders for Nature Co’s projects in Brazil. This position will build and manage a pipeline of landholders interested in reforestation, lead outreach and onboarding, coordinate site inspections, lead the collection of relevant data required for carbon standard checks, and lead signature of landholder agreements. The role will also play a key role in ensuring compliance (contracts and carbon standards) as well as coordinate schedules between landholders and contractors for the implementation of reforestation activities. This will include confirming site readiness, conducting periodic field quality audits, documenting and tracking progress, and resolving issues that could delay delivery or degrade quality.
The role requires a strong combination stakeholder engagement and management experience, and a commitment to quality and impact. The role requires extensive travel and field work across Minas Gerais, Bahia and Espírito Santo.Primary roles and responsibilities include:
Landholder engagement, onboarding, and pipeline management
Map priority municipalities and referral partner networks (city governments, co-ops, farmer associations, NGOs); plan and run outreach activities, events and information sessions.
Manage the landholder onboarding process (identify → qualify → onboard → contract), using CRM/trackers to keep status, documents and next actions current.
Prepare clear information packs (benefits, obligations, timelines) and respond to inquiries in a timely, professional manner.
Maintain ongoing landholder relationship management to support retention, satisfaction, and smooth site access throughout implementation.
Eligibility, due diligence & agreements
Coordinate site inspections and initial diagnostics in consultation with other team members (parcel boundaries, vegetation status, access, water, risks).
Support land tenure verification and FPIC documentation
Lead closure of contract signatures.
Maintain organized repository of all landholder records within Nature Co’s data management system
(land titles, eligibility documents, contracts, site maps, inspection notes, photos, consultation records).
Reforestation delivery enablement
Translate signed landholder agreements into implementation-ready site plans (site-specific scope, access instructions, constraints, schedule windows).
Align field schedules with landholders and contractors to ensure access, minimize disruption to farm activities, and maintain trust and cooperation.
Support in the delivery of field delivery progress from contractors by site (start/finish dates, activities completed, challenges, next steps), and escalate issues early (access, weather delays, input shortages, labor constraints).
Support in monitoring reforestation activities (during and post planting) and coordinate, where required, rapid response with contractors/landholders (grazing, fire risk, pests, drought stress).
Stakeholder engagement and safeguards
Plan and document stakeholder consultations and community meetings in accordance with Nature Co policies and procedures (agendas, attendance lists, minutes, photos).
Support the team in the operation of the grievance mechanism: receiving grievances and responding in accordance with the Nature Co grievance mechanism.
Maintain landholder contact and ensure landholder information is kept up to date.
Coordinate access, for other project staff and contractors as required.
Reporting
Lead or assist the development of formal monthly, quarterly, and annual project implementation reports for internal and external stakeholders in line with contract and/or carbon standard requirements.
Prepare ad hoc reports, documents, and presentations for internal and external stakeholders.
Teamwork and culture
Support the management of a cross-functional, international team, fostering collaboration and ensuring that project milestones and goals are met.
Stay current on emerging best practices in Nb S and carbon projects; proactively share insights across the organisation and with partners.Skills and attributes
To perform successfully in this role, you will have:
A minimum of five (5) years of experience in reforestation projects with direct contact with rural landholders and reforestation planting service providers.
Degree in forest engineering, agronomy, ecology, or environmental science.
Intermediate English and native Portuguese language skills
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage confidently across cultures and stakeholder groups.
Strong project management skills, including experience managing timelines, deliverables, and working across multidisciplinary teams.
A proactive, self-starting approach with the ability to anticipate problems, adapt quickly, and take initiative under limited supervision.
A collaborative mindset and ability to lead and motivate internal teams and external partners
Ability to provide strategic and technical guidance across complex, multi-stakeholder projects.
Strong organisational skills and attention to detail in documentation and reporting.
A positive, energetic personality with resilience and drive to see projects through to delivery.Extensive travel within Brazil is a requirement to perform this position.Location
Remote, with residence in Minas Gerais, Espirito Santo, or BahiaSubmission instructions
Email CV and brief cover letter to with subject: Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager
Submission deadline: 30 March 2026

title: Devops engineer
description:
We're looking for a Dev Ops / Cloud Lead who knows how to design, automate, and operate cloud infrastructure.This role focuses heavily on Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) due to a strategic partnership in that ecosystem. Many of our clients are migrating infrastructure to OCI or need help operating multi-cloud environments.
We need someone who can design solutions, automate processes, and solve infrastructure problems, not just maintain pipelines.Why this role exists
We have a strategic partnership with Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI). Clients are asking us to migrate infrastructure to OCI, and many of them also need ongoing Dev Ops operations and architecture support.
We need someone who can own this technically. Not just executing tasks, but executing the task is an important part of the job as well.
Design solutions. Talk to clients. Automate migrations. Coordinate engineers. And when necessary, jump in and fix things yourself.TL; DR
You will help lead cloud and Dev Ops initiatives at Quave. Your job is to:
Lead cloud migrations to OCI
Design cloud architectures
Automate migrations and infrastructure
Coordinate Dev Ops engineers
Talk directly to clients
Help build repeatable Dev Ops processes
You must be strong in OCI, comfortable with AWS / Azure / GCP, hands-on, obsessed with automation, and comfortable discussing technical architecture with clients.
English is a plus, not required.This is not a ticket-based Dev Ops job
If you're looking for a role where you maintain Jenkins pipelines, restart servers, open support tickets, and wait for instructions, this is not the role for you.
This role is about designing and solving infrastructure problems. We want someone who can look at a system and think:\"We can automate 80% of this.\"
And then actually build the automation.What you'll actually do
Cloud Architecture Design infrastructure for systems running in OCI, AWS, Azure, and GCP, migrating from one to another.Cloud Migrations
A lot of our work will be migrations like AWS → OCI, Azure → OCI, GCP → OCI.
Your job is not just to do the migration, but to help us turn migrations into repeatable processes, scripts, templates, automation and tooling so that each migration becomes easier than the last.Automation
We want to automate everything that can be automated:
Automated infrastructure provisioning
Migration scripts
CI/CD pipelines
Environment replication
Monitoring setups
If you like writing scripts that replace hours of manual work, you'll enjoy this role.Client Discussions
You will often join calls with clients to understand infrastructure problems, design migration strategies, estimate effort, and propose solutions. You must be comfortable discussing technical topics clearly.Leading Dev Ops Engineers
As the Dev Ops work grows, you'll coordinate other engineers working on projects, reviewing architecture, guiding implementations, and ensuring quality.What we're looking for
You probably have many years working with infrastructure. But more importantly, you have good instincts about systems.
You likely:
Love automating infrastructure
Hate manual processes
Can quickly understand unfamiliar systems
Are comfortable debugging production environments
Enjoy designing architectures
Can communicate clearly with both engineers and clients
You should also be comfortable using AI tools to accelerate your work. Tools like Chat GPT, Claude, and Cursor can dramatically increase productivity when used well. We expect you to take advantage of that.Technical Expectations
Cloud
Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) - important
AWS
Azure
GCP
Dev Ops
Docker
Kubernetes
Terraform or other Infrastructure-as-Code tools
CI/CD pipelines
Linux systems administration
Networking fundamentals
Automation
Comfortable writing scripts in Bash, Python, Go, or similar.Languages
Portuguese required. English is a plus as some clients are international, so it may eventually become useful in the future, but it's not required.Why work with Quave
We are a small, profitable, independent company. No investors. No corporate bureaucracy. We focus on doing great work for clients and building great software.
Things we value: Speed. Quality. Pragmatism. Autonomy.
Quave literally stands for Quality (Qua) and Velocity (Ve).Pay and Benefits
This is a full-time remote position. Compensation will depend on experience.
Fully remote work
Flexible hours
22 days paid time off per year
Quarterly bonus based on company performance
AI allowance for productivity tools
We work as a distributed team of independent contractors.Hiring Process
Application review
Technical conversation
Architecture discussion
Conversation(s) with one or more partners
This is a leadership role and you will coordinate other engineers as the Dev Ops work grows. But at Quave our leaders are hands-on. You should be comfortable writing automation and infrastructure code yourself when needed.

title: Landholder and reforestation delivery manager
description:
About Nature CoNature Co delivers nature-based solutions (Nb S) for investors, corporates and other purpose driven organisations to scale up action on climate change and biodiversity loss. We specialise in nature-based project development including reforestation, agroforestry, farmer managed natural regeneration and mangrove restoration. Nature Co has extensive expertise in working with local communities to protect and restore natural ecosystems through participation in the global voluntary carbon market.
Nature Co is currently implementing a large-scale reforestation project in Brazil for the generation of verified carbon credits.
We are a diverse, mission-driven team that values inclusion, integrity, and innovation. Nature Co is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to building an equitable and inclusive workplace for all.Role and responsibilities
The Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager is the primary field-based interface with landholders, communities, reforestation contractors, and other local stakeholders for Nature Co’s projects in Brazil. This position will build and manage a pipeline of landholders interested in reforestation, lead outreach and onboarding, coordinate site inspections, lead the collection of relevant data required for carbon standard checks, and lead signature of landholder agreements. The role will also play a key role in ensuring compliance (contracts and carbon standards) as well as coordinate schedules between landholders and contractors for the implementation of reforestation activities. This will include confirming site readiness, conducting periodic field quality audits, documenting and tracking progress, and resolving issues that could delay delivery or degrade quality.
The role requires a strong combination stakeholder engagement and management experience, and a commitment to quality and impact. The role requires extensive travel and field work across Minas Gerais, Bahia and Espírito Santo.Primary roles and responsibilities include:
Landholder engagement, onboarding, and pipeline management
Map priority municipalities and referral partner networks (city governments, co-ops, farmer associations, NGOs); plan and run outreach activities, events and information sessions.
Manage the landholder onboarding process (identify → qualify → onboard → contract), using CRM/trackers to keep status, documents and next actions current.
Prepare clear information packs (benefits, obligations, timelines) and respond to inquiries in a timely, professional manner.
Maintain ongoing landholder relationship management to support retention, satisfaction, and smooth site access throughout implementation.
Eligibility, due diligence & agreements
Coordinate site inspections and initial diagnostics in consultation with other team members (parcel boundaries, vegetation status, access, water, risks).
Support land tenure verification and FPIC documentation
Lead closure of contract signatures.
Maintain organized repository of all landholder records within Nature Co’s data management system
(land titles, eligibility documents, contracts, site maps, inspection notes, photos, consultation records).
Reforestation delivery enablement
Translate signed landholder agreements into implementation-ready site plans (site-specific scope, access instructions, constraints, schedule windows).
Align field schedules with landholders and contractors to ensure access, minimize disruption to farm activities, and maintain trust and cooperation.
Support in the delivery of field delivery progress from contractors by site (start/finish dates, activities completed, challenges, next steps), and escalate issues early (access, weather delays, input shortages, labor constraints).
Support in monitoring reforestation activities (during and post planting) and coordinate, where required, rapid response with contractors/landholders (grazing, fire risk, pests, drought stress).
Stakeholder engagement and safeguards
Plan and document stakeholder consultations and community meetings in accordance with Nature Co policies and procedures (agendas, attendance lists, minutes, photos).
Support the team in the operation of the grievance mechanism: receiving grievances and responding in accordance with the Nature Co grievance mechanism.
Maintain landholder contact and ensure landholder information is kept up to date.
Coordinate access, for other project staff and contractors as required.
Reporting
Lead or assist the development of formal monthly, quarterly, and annual project implementation reports for internal and external stakeholders in line with contract and/or carbon standard requirements.
Prepare ad hoc reports, documents, and presentations for internal and external stakeholders.
Teamwork and culture
Support the management of a cross-functional, international team, fostering collaboration and ensuring that project milestones and goals are met.
Stay current on emerging best practices in Nb S and carbon projects; proactively share insights across the organisation and with partners.Skills and attributes
To perform successfully in this role, you will have:
A minimum of five (5) years of experience in reforestation projects with direct contact with rural landholders and reforestation planting service providers.
Degree in forest engineering, agronomy, ecology, or environmental science.
Intermediate English and native Portuguese language skills
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage confidently across cultures and stakeholder groups.
Strong project management skills, including experience managing timelines, deliverables, and working across multidisciplinary teams.
A proactive, self-starting approach with the ability to anticipate problems, adapt quickly, and take initiative under limited supervision.
A collaborative mindset and ability to lead and motivate internal teams and external partners
Ability to provide strategic and technical guidance across complex, multi-stakeholder projects.
Strong organisational skills and attention to detail in documentation and reporting.
A positive, energetic personality with resilience and drive to see projects through to delivery.Extensive travel within Brazil is a requirement to perform this position.Location
Remote, with residence in Minas Gerais, Espirito Santo, or BahiaSubmission instructions
Email CV and brief cover letter to with subject: Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager
Submission deadline: 30 March 2026

title: Devops engineer
description:
We're looking for a Dev Ops / Cloud Lead who knows how to design, automate, and operate cloud infrastructure.This role focuses heavily on Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) due to a strategic partnership in that ecosystem. Many of our clients are migrating infrastructure to OCI or need help operating multi-cloud environments.We need someone who can design solutions, automate processes, and solve infrastructure problems, not just maintain pipelines.Why this role existsWe have a strategic partnership with Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI). Clients are asking us to migrate infrastructure to OCI, and many of them also need ongoing Dev Ops operations and architecture support.We need someone who can own this technically. Not just executing tasks, but executing the task is an important part of the job as well.Design solutions. Talk to clients. Automate migrations. Coordinate engineers. And when necessary, jump in and fix things yourself.TL; DRYou will help lead cloud and Dev Ops initiatives at Quave. Your job is to:- Lead cloud migrations to OCI
- Design cloud architectures
- Automate migrations and infrastructure
- Coordinate Dev Ops engineers
- Talk directly to clients
- Help build repeatable Dev Ops processesYou must be strong in OCI, comfortable with AWS / Azure / GCP, hands-on, obsessed with automation, and comfortable discussing technical architecture with clients.English is a plus, not required.This is not a ticket-based Dev Ops jobIf you're looking for a role where you maintain Jenkins pipelines, restart servers, open support tickets, and wait for instructions, this is not the role for you.This role is about designing and solving infrastructure problems. We want someone who can look at a system and think:"We can automate 80% of this."And then actually build the automation.What you'll actually doCloud Architecture Design infrastructure for systems running in OCI, AWS, Azure, and GCP, migrating from one to another.Cloud MigrationsA lot of our work will be migrations like AWS → OCI, Azure → OCI, GCP → OCI.Your job is not just to do the migration, but to help us turn migrations into repeatable processes, scripts, templates, automation and tooling so that each migration becomes easier than the last.AutomationWe want to automate everything that can be automated:- Automated infrastructure provisioning
- Migration scripts
- CI/CD pipelines
- Environment replication
- Monitoring setupsIf you like writing scripts that replace hours of manual work, you'll enjoy this role.Client DiscussionsYou will often join calls with clients to understand infrastructure problems, design migration strategies, estimate effort, and propose solutions. You must be comfortable discussing technical topics clearly.Leading Dev Ops EngineersAs the Dev Ops work grows, you'll coordinate other engineers working on projects, reviewing architecture, guiding implementations, and ensuring quality.What we're looking forYou probably have many years working with infrastructure. But more importantly, you have good instincts about systems.You likely:- Love automating infrastructure
- Hate manual processes
- Can quickly understand unfamiliar systems
- Are comfortable debugging production environments
- Enjoy designing architectures
- Can communicate clearly with both engineers and clientsYou should also be comfortable using AI tools to accelerate your work. Tools like Chat GPT, Claude, and Cursor can dramatically increase productivity when used well. We expect you to take advantage of that.Technical ExpectationsCloud- Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) - important
- AWS
- Azure
- GCP-Dev Ops- Docker
- Kubernetes
- Terraform or other Infrastructure-as-Code tools
- CI/CD pipelines
- Linux systems administration
- Networking fundamentalsAutomationComfortable writing scripts in Bash, Python, Go, or similar.LanguagesPortuguese required. English is a plus as some clients are international, so it may eventually become useful in the future, but it's not required.Why work with QuaveWe are a small, profitable, independent company. No investors. No corporate bureaucracy. We focus on doing great work for clients and building great software.Things we value: Speed. Quality. Pragmatism. Autonomy.Quave literally stands for Quality (Qua) and Velocity (Ve).Pay and BenefitsThis is a full-time remote position. Compensation will depend on experience.- Fully remote work
- Flexible hours
- 22 days paid time off per year
- Quarterly bonus based on company performance
- AI allowance for productivity toolsWe work as a distributed team of independent contractors.Hiring Process1. Application review
2. Technical conversation
3. Architecture discussion
4. Conversation(s) with one or more partners

title: Sap s/4 hana application architect - product management (arquitecto de aplicaciones sap s/4 hana - g
description:

Responsible to support and assist in the design and implementation of the Supply Chain Operations template including configurations and determining the best ways to use S/4 HANA by merging business and IT needs and focusing on utilizing the system for the greatest efficiency and utilization.Work very closely with Lead Solution Architect – Sales & Operations to meet SAP implementation deliverables.Key Position Accountabilities
Being part of Global IT team and responsible for SAP MM (Materials Management) and Variant Configuration related system configuration and associated developments are designed, built, tested & deployed according to S/4 HANA best practices.
Lead and Support the Product Management Area in the SAP implementation project from solution and architecture perspective and ensure timely completion of related project activities with key focus on quality.

Support incidents or change requests for the live Business units.SELECTION CRITERIA

Bachelor / Master's degree in Business, Computer Science, or equivalent discipline is required with minimum 10 years of consulting experience with multiple Industries.

Should have demonstrated hands-on experience in delivery of large, complex, global engagements involving multi-currency, multi-location, multi-organization complexities.

Understanding on SAP Best Practices and knowledge in Master data, MM module, their integrations & technology.
Ability to learn new tasks quickly; demonstrate flexibility when presented with change.
Lead and support a team environment.
Strong communication skills in English, self-driven and motivated.
Ability to manage and deliver multiple priorities in a constrained timelineDesirable:
SAP S/4 HANA Certification in SAP MM.

Office based/Remote with occasional international travel.

title: English teacher
description:
Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you!Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good Wi Fi, a webcam, and a microphone.If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach!
Whether you’re looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we’ve got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week.What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at Latin Hire?
You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts.
If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out.
When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that!In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with Latin Hire:Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week!
You be your own boss and set your own schedule
Work from anywhere (as long as you have good Wi Fi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone).
Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month.Minimum Requirements:Portuguese as a first language.
C1 or C2 Level English Speaker
University degree in English Teaching or related area.
One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language.
Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2 MB) internet connection.
Must pass a criminal background check.
Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability.

title: Senior business analyst – supply chain
description:
Who We Are
We are an IFS integrator, providing end-to-end ERP implementation projects and exceptional support services. As strategic business partners, we collaborate with clients across key industries, helping them drive digital transformation.
Our global team of 200+ members brings extensive expertise, including former IFS customers who understand real-world operational challenges and dedicated IFS specialists with deep functional and technical knowledge. Together, we deliver outstanding services to reshape businesses and optimize supply chain operations.Who We Are Looking For
We are currently seeking aSenior Business Analyst – Supply Chain , a client-facing leadership role responsible for driving complex ERP implementations within supply chain domains (procurement, inventory, logistics, planning, and distribution).
This role requires a strong functional expert who can lead requirement gathering, solution design, and implementation while acting as a key advisor to clients and an escalation point for junior analysts.
If you are passionate about supply chain optimization, ERP transformation, and leading cross-functional collaboration in global projects, we encourage you to apply.Key Responsibilities
Business Requirements & Client Engagement
• Lead requirement gathering sessions with stakeholders across supply chain functions.
• Analyze business processes (procurement, inventory, warehousing, logistics) to identify improvements and optimization opportunities.
• Translate complex supply chain and technical concepts into clear language for non-technical stakeholders.
• Perform gap analysis between current operations and ERP capabilities, ensuring scalable and efficient solutions.
• Advise clients on best practices aligned with industry standards and digital transformation strategies.Solution Design, Implementation & Testing
• Lead supply chain module implementation within ERP (IFS or similar).
• Supervise and mentor Business Analysts and Junior Analysts within the domain.
• Collaborate with Project Managers on planning, estimations, and risk mitigation.
• Work closely with development and technical teams to ensure accurate solution delivery.
• Lead design discussions to align system architecture with business objectives.
• Ensure quality assurance testing and validation of supply chain functionalities.
• Support cross-functional alignment with Solution Architects and other domains.
• Deliver user training sessions and create functional documentation to ensure adoption.Training, Expertise & Continuous Improvement (20%)
• Act as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) in supply chain processes and ERP functionalities.
• Stay up to date with industry trends, including digital supply chain, automation, and best practices.
• Maintain relevant certifications (IFS or equivalent ERP modules).
• Drive continuous improvement initiatives across projects and internal practices.Must Have
• Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Industrial Engineering, Business, or related field.
• Minimum 5 years of experience in supply chain processes (procurement, logistics, inventory, planning).
• Minimum 3 years in client-facing roles.
• Experience in ERP implementation projects (IFS preferred).
• Strong understanding of supply chain operations across industries such as Manufacturing, Energy, Construction, or Services.
• Fluent in Portuguese and English (Spanish or French is a plus).
• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
• Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving capabilities.
• Experience with project management and collaboration tools.
• Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office.
• Availability to travel.
• Legally authorized to work in Brazil.What We Offer
• Competitive salary and benefits package.
• Career growth opportunities with certifications and professional development.
• A collaborative and international work environment.
• Involvement in high-impact global supply chain transformation projects.Why Hoist?
If you are looking for an opportunity to lead impactful supply chain transformations and grow your career in a dynamic and global environment, Hoist is the place for you.
Join our team and be part of a people-first culture that values collaboration, innovation, and professional growth.
