title: Performance marketing analyst
description:
We’re looking for a Paid Media Marketing Specialist to drive high-quality leads by creating, managing, and measuring Digital Marketing campaigns across Google, You Tube, social, and other relevant channels.About us:
Smarter Contact is the market-leading AI-powered communications platform for real estate professionals in the US market. Our Saa S products power tens of millions of conversations monthly, helping real estate professionals close more deals using text and voice.The ideal candidate is a hands-on, independent strategic thinker who brings deep expertise in running digital marketing programs and developing digital marketing assets (with our designer) within B2 B Saa S organizations.If you’re used to depending on task queues, waiting for someone to tell you what to do, or only being reactive instead of mostly proactive, this isn’t the role for you. But if you have a bias for execution and love taking ownership of outcomes — keep reading.What You’ll Own:
Develop programs and strategies for customer acquisition, retention, and expansion through multiple channels, including search, PMAX, social, retargeting, content (written and video), and more.
Define KPIs and implement measurement, analytics, benchmarking, and reporting methods to gauge success for marketing channels, campaigns, and initiatives.
Drive continual improvements in lead conversion rates and revenue close rates.
Continue to scale our marketing efforts and take primary responsibility for exceeding our KPIs for each quarter.
Work closely with the overall Marketing team to define required assets such as content, images, video, etc.What We’re Looking For:
5+ years of experience working on B2 B demand generation for technology or software companies with a strong track record.
Experience using Performance Max and/or other AI related technologies.
Strong understanding and experience with multiple demand channels, including digital, paid social, field, and email marketing to drive pipeline.
Are highly analytical and data-driven, with a proven track record of optimizing marketing funnels, owning and hitting pipeline goals, and increasing ROI.
Have experience establishing data-driven decision-making frameworks leveraging Hub Spot and other marketing automation tools to measure performance, optimize spend, and maximize efficiency.
Knows how to use Google Ads, Performance Max, Search Console, Analytics, Tag Manager, and other associated tools.
You have a self-starter mentality with creative problem-solving skills, with the ability to think on your feet and “Google it” when needed.
You are a team player, a quick learner, and highly coachable with a positive can-do attitude.
You can work autonomously, independently, collaboratively, and effectively as part of a remote team.
You have exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with an ability to succinctly communicate value propositions.
You have full professional proficiency in the English language.
You must be willing, able, and available to work in US time zones.✨ Bonus Points:
Have experience scaling growth marketing in a fast-growing startup, particularly in Saa S or B2 B technology.
Have a strong network in the growth marketing community and stay up to date with the latest trends and innovations, especially AI tools.⚡️ Why Smarter Contact?
USD base compensation
15 days PTO + 5 sick days + 10 floating holidays
High autonomy, fast execution, real impact
Professional development benefit
Wellness benefit
Employment anniversary and birthday gift
Quarterly health allowance
Remote-first team with a strong performance culture
This opportunity is offered as a full-time independent contractor roleReady to grow with us?
We’re looking for a proven Performance Marketing Specialist ready to build the next chapter of their career — and stay for the long haul. If that’s you, we’d love to hear from you.

title: Principal technical support engineer (remote)
description:
In our 'always on' world, we believe it's essential to have a genuine connection with the work you do.
We are excited to announce that we are hiring a Principal Technical Support Engineer in working fromBrazil remotelyto join our team and provide high‑level technical expertise to our Ruckus Premium (Bull Dog) customers.Your primary responsibility is to serve as a key technical resource, delivering expert assistance and ensuring prompt resolution of complex customer issues.How You'll Help Us Connect the World:You work directly with customers to troubleshoot problems, isolate root causes, and drive cases to closure with a high level of technical accuracy and professionalism. When needed, you reproduce customer scenarios in the Support Lab to validate findings and deepen understanding of the issue.
You collaborate closely with Engineering teams to manage escalations, resolve product bugs, and ensure that long-term corrective actions are identified and implemented. Throughout each case, you provide consistent updates to sales teams, internal management, and customers, maintaining clear communication and transparency at every stage.Given the nature of the role, you are expected to support a staggered work week when required (such as Sunday through Thursday or Tuesday through Saturday) and participate in a rotating on-call schedule. Flexibility in work hours is essential to accommodate urgent customer needs. You thoroughly document customer interactions, engineering engagements, and action plans to ensure high-quality case management and knowledge continuity.Beyond case handling, you contribute to the organization by creating and refining knowledge articles, troubleshooting guides, and internal training materials. You provide mentoring and coaching to team members to help strengthen overall team capability. You also participate regularly in customer and internal conference calls for high-profile cases and escalations, ensuring issues receive appropriate visibility. All responsibilities are carried out with strict adherence to Service Level Agreement KPIs.Required Qualifications for Consideration:8+ years of experience working in the networking space
5+ years of experience working in a TAC
Excellent written and oral communication ability, including formal presentation skills to customers, partners, Ruckus accounts and support teams
Excellent understanding and applied knowledge of TCP/IP, L3 routing, L2 switching, Multicast, firewalls, QOS
Solid understanding and troubleshooting skills with wireless technologies 802.11x, WLAN authentication, encryption, EAP, PSK, Radius, AAA, DNS
Expertise of wireless deployments – AP’s, Controllers, Client associations, etc
Excellent understanding of RF transmission and antenna behavior
Technical expertise in troubleshooting and resolving complex Layer 2/3 and/or wireless issues in multi-vendor environments
Experience providing support to direct customers, resellers, and field personnel in resolving company product related issues
Ability to provide technical guidance to other members in the team
Experience working in a support lab environment for problem replication
Experience documenting the sequence of events related to resolving customer technical issues
Proficient with analyzing data traces from protocol analyzers such as Wireshark
High level of English.
Available Monday through Friday or ‘staggered work week’s, i.e. Sunday through Thursday or Tuesday through Saturday and weekend or overnight hours as required.Important Candidate Notice: On January 9, 2026, Comm Scope finalized the sale of its Connectivity and Cable Solutions segment, which included the Comm Scope name and brand, to Amphenol Corporation. The remaining businesses — Access Networks Solutions (now rebranded asAurora Networks) andRUCKUS Networkshave been unified under the new parent company, renamed asVistance Networks. The role being advertised is part of RUCKUS Networks.Why Join Us?
Vistance Networks shapes the future of communications technology, pushing past what is possible. We deliver solutions that bring reliability and performance to a world always in motion. Our global team of innovators and employees are trusted advisors who listen to customers first, then deliver value.RUCKUS Networks delivers purpose-driven enterprise networks that enable superior business outcomes in demanding environments. Our solutions combine AI-powered automation, proactive network assurance, and context-aware security, providing exceptional performance with simplified management.If you want to grow your career alongside bright, passionate, and caring people who strive to create what's next…..come connect to your future at Vistance Networks.Vistance Networks is an Equal Opportunity Employer (EEO), including people with disabilities and veterans.

title: Sap s/4 hana brim application expert (experto en aplicaciones sap s/4 hana brim)
description:
ASSA ABLOY Global Solutions is rolling out SAP S/4 HANA across the Division which will enable and support its business expansion strategy in line with the new operating business model.
PRIMARY JOB PURPOSE
Responsible to deliver design and system configuration for the BRIM module in SAP S/4 HANA, ensuring successful rollout and adoption of standardized Service-to-Cash processes across business units. The candidate is responsible for translating business requirements into system solutions, managing data migration, testing, training, and post-go-live support, while aligning with SAP best practices and project timelines.KEY POSITION ACCOUNTABILITIES
Being part of Global IT team and responsible for SAP BRIM (Billing and Revenue Innovation Management) configuration and associated developments are designed, built, tested & deployed according to S/4 HANA best practices.
Facilitate and support workstream managers / Solution Architects & leads right from requirement gathering, solution design with focus on Sales and Customer Service processes and integration of same with operations, finance & product management workstreams.
Analyse business requirements related to subscription order management, subscription billing, contract management, and convergent charging.
Configure and customize SAP BRIM components including SOM (Subscription Order Management), CC (Convergent Charging), CI (Convergent Invoicing), and FI-CA (Contract Accounting).
Responsible for creating/maintaining functional specifications for WRICEF (Workflow, Report, Interface, Conversion, Enhancement, Forms) objects.
Perform configuration, testing, training, migration, cutover, go-live and hyper care activities.
Support incidents or change requests for the live Business units.SELECTION CRITERIA
Essential:
Bachelor / master’s degree in business, Computer Science, or equivalent discipline is required with minimum 10 years of consulting experience with multiple Industries.
Minimum 2 full lifecycle implementations / roll outs & support experience in BRIM module in S/4 HANA projects with related modules SOM, CI, CC and FI-CA.
Hands-on experience in configuring BRIM components and managing end-to-end billing cycles.
Understanding on SAP Best Practices in BRIM and SD modules and their integrations & technology.
Experience in S/4 HANA environment and Fiori applications.
Strong communication skills in English, self-driven and motivated.
Ability to manage and deliver multiple priorities in a constrained timelineDesirable:
SAP S/4 HANA Certification in SAP BRIM.
Knowledge of new features in SAP S/4 HANA like embedded analytics, user experience using Fiori, SAP cloud platform
Exposure to SAP BTP or cloud-based BRIM extensions.
Basic ABAP debugging or familiarity with enhancement frameworks.WORK ENVIRONMENT FACTORS
Office based/Remote with occasional international travel.
Health and Safety accountability statements.
Working times are European time zone, however open to be available in APAC/US time zone as well for the need basis.We are the ASSA ABLOY Group

description:
Descrição da Empresa Sugerimos que insira os detalhes aqui.
Descrição do Cargo Estamos à procura de um Assistente Administrativo para se juntar ao time D MAIS EDUCAÇÃO em Salvador, BA. As responsabilidades do cargo incluem o suporte administrativo geral, atendimento telefônico com postura e educação, organização de documentos e realização de tarefas rotineiras de escritório. Este é um cargo de tempo integral e requer presença nas dependências da empresa.
Qualificações
  • Assistência Administrativa: Habilidade em prestar suporte administrativo e gerenciar tarefas comuns de escritório de forma organizada e eficiente.
  • Etiqueta Telefônica: Experiência em atendimento telefônico com eficácia e cordialidade, garantindo boa comunicação com os diversos públicos da empresa.
  • Comunicação: Capacidade clara e adequada para comunicar-se de forma verbal e escrita, essencial para interagir com diferentes equipes e partes interessadas.
  • Gestão Administrativa e Clerical: Conhecimentos em tarefas administrativas de suporte executivo e habilidades clericais, como organização de documentos e controle de agendas.
  • Experiência prévia comprovada na área administrativa e domínio do pacote Microsoft Office serão considerados diferenciais significativos.

title: Gerente regional - nordeste
description:
Buscamos um(a) Gerente Regional Comercial para atender o Estado da Bahia, e que terá as seguintes responsabilidades:
Gerenciar todos os resultados da regional: NPS (Net Promoter Score), Margem, Faturamento, Volume, Custos, Prazo, impostos, Obrigações legais, etc.);
Realizar a gestão de equipe, monitorando e desenvolvendo as pessoas nas suas atividades e responsabilidades;
Garantir a performance de venda e desenvolvimento da equipe através dos padrões e indicadores da empresa;
Planejar, coordenar e supervisionar a comercialização regional dos produtos da empresa visando cumprir as metas e expansão dos negócios na região: acompanha o mercado detectando oportunidades de negócio, contata e visita clientes em potencial, informa-se sobre projetos, viabiliza sua participação solicitando, inclusive, suporte das áreas técnicas da empresa;
Atender clientes internos e externos, atendendo suas necessidades sobre os produtos e serviços. Requisitos e qualificações:
Formação superior completa em Administração, Contabilidade, Marketing ou áreas correlatas;
Desejável pós-graduação;
Experiência na área comercial de no mínimo 5 anos;
Gestão de equipe;
CNH categoria B é mandatório;
Disponibilidade para viagens pelo Estado da Bahia e Brasil é mandatório (a base deste(a) profissional será Salvador/BA);
Conhecimento intermediário do pacote Office.

title: Executivo de território
description:
Estamos em busca de um profissional dinâmico e motivado para integrar nossa equipe comercial. Se você é apaixonado por desafios, tem atitude de dono e busca uma carreira de sucesso, essa oportunidade é para você!
Responsabilidades:
Visitar entre 8 a 12 Farmácias de pequeno e médio porte da região;
Planejar e identificar as oportunidades de vendas, verificar, executar MPDV, dentro das rotinas do PEX (Programa de Excelência) na base de PDVs;
Atingir as metas de vendas estabelecidas;
Participar das reuniões diárias – matinal e fechamento de vendas on-line, de segunda à sexta.
Participar de treinamentos e eventos para atualização e desenvolvimento profissional; Requisitos e qualificações
Excelente comunicação e capacidade de negociação;
Capacidade analítica verificar e atuar nas oportunidades;
Disciplina para cumprimento de rotina;
Disposição para trabalhos externos e viagens estaduais;
Carteira de motorista B;
Experiência Comercial Bens de consumo, Bebidas, Sorvete, Canal conveniência, setor de Adquirência (desejável);
Proatividade, atitude de dono e foco em resultados;
Desejável: Cursando Ensino Superior (Cursos prioritários: Engenharias, Economia, Física, Estatísticas, Matemática, Adm,) Motivos para trabalhar na Legrand:
A Legrand oferece uma carreira acelerada com oportunidades de aprendizado e desenvolvimento real, em uma cultura de crescimento e meritocracia; A Legrand hoje:
Empresa com mais de 100 SKUs, sendo 25 produtos líderes ou vice-líderes de mercado;
Faturamento anual superior a R$1 bilhão, com destaque para o produto Expec, que gera R$300 milhões por ano; História recente:
Nos últimos três anos e meio, a Legrand dobrou de tamanho, aumentou seu market share e subiu duas posições no ranking, agora sendo a terceira maior;
Quintuplicou o número de colaboradores e foi certificada no ranking GTPW de melhores empresas para trabalhar nos últimos dois anos;
Novo lema " Viva a Vida", focado em criar marcas amadas pelos consumidores.

description:
Sobre o Grupo Fleury
O Grupo Fleury é uma das maiores e mais respeitadas instituições de medicina e saúde do Brasil. Referência por sua excelência técnica, médica e de atendimento, é também destaque nas melhores práticas ESG.

title: Inspetor eletricista em camaçari/ba e região (cnpj ativo e regular)
description:
Busco por Inspetor Eletricista em Camaçari/BA e região (até 100km)
️ Atribuições:
Acompanhar e realizar ensaios de recebimento (FAT) em equipamentos de distribuidoras de energia, garantindo conformidade com especificações técnicas e critérios de aceitação;
Atuar na inspeção e verificação de transformadores, TCs, TPs, postes, medidores, reguladores e equipamentos de segurança;
Avaliar equipamentos elétricos e eletromecânicos em geral, com foco principal nos itens utilizados por distribuidoras de energia;
Elaborar relatórios técnicos de inspeção, registrando resultados, não conformidades e evidências técnicas dos ensaios realizados.
Requisitos:
Formação técnica ou superior completa em Elétrica (Técnico ou Engenheiro);
Experiência comprovada com ensaios de recebimento (FAT) em equipamentos de distribuidora de energia;
Conhecimento prático em equipamentos elétricos e eletromecânicos, especialmente transformadores, TCs, TPs, medidores e reguladores;
Capacidade de análise técnica e elaboração de relatórios técnicos claros e objetivos.
Você se destaca se:
Possuir experiência prévia com inspeções para concessionárias ou distribuidoras de energia;
Tiver atuação direta em FATs de equipamentos elétricos de média e/ou alta tensão.
Forma de contratação:
Trabalho de prestação de serviços de acordo com a demanda do cliente pago por diárias/horas trabalhadas. É imprescindível já ter CNPJ ativo.
Local de atuação:
Camaçari – BA (atuação limitada a até 100 km)
Importante:
Só serão contatados, os profissionais dentro do perfil e isso inclui ter a formação, experiência e estar na localidade requerida pela vaga.
Não aceitamos CV de outras cidades para essa vaga, pois não custeamos passagens ou estadias para esse contrato, portanto nenhum CV de regiões distantes será considerado/contatado neste momento.
O CV deve conter e-mail, celular e cidade/bairro de residência.
OBS.: FAVOR NÃ O SE CANDIDATAR À VAGA CASO NÃ O POSSUA O PERFIL DA VAGA!
With over 5,600 employees and 200 offices in 70 countries worldwide, RINA is a multinational player which provides certification, marine classification, product testing, site supervision and vendor inspection, training and engineering consultancy services across a wide range of sectors. Our business model covers the full process of project development, from concept to completion. The aim is to guarantee a project's technical, environmental and safety - and sometimes also economic and financial - sustainability.
At RINA, we endeavor to create a work environment where every single person is valued and encouraged to develop new ideas. We provide equal employment opportunities and are committed to creating a workplace where everyone feels respected and safe from discrimination or harassment of any kind. We are also compliant to the Italian Law n. 68/99.

title: Analista de sistemas sênior
description:
ANALISTA DE SISTEMAS SÊ NIOR | CIBERIAN TECNOLOGIA
Vaga também para PCD – 100% Presencial | Camaçari-BA
Há 24 anos transformando o mercado de tecnologia!
A Ciberian Tecnologia é uma das referências no setor de Tecnologia da Informação e Comunicação, especializada em fornecer soluções inovadoras que integram pessoas, processos e tecnologia. Nossa missão é impulsionar o sucesso dos nossos clientes através de soluções que promovem o desenvolvimento sustentável e o crescimento a longo prazo.
O que você vai fazer:
Desenvolver e dar manutenção em aplicações web (Front-end e Back-end);
Construir e evoluir APIs em Python;
Implementar regras de negócio com foco em segurança e controle de acesso;
Atuar com integrações e rotinas de importação de dados (XML e arquivos layout fixo – bases de saúde/SIGTAP);
Trabalhar com mensageria e processamento de eventos;
Atuar com banco de dados, versionamento e ambiente containerizado;
Apoiar melhorias técnicas e evolução da arquitetura do sistema. Requisitos Técnicos:
Formação superior em TI ou áreas correlatas.
Experiência técnica com as seguintes tecnologias:
Desenvolvimento Front-End: Angular (Standalone Components), Type Script, Angular Material, Rx JS
Desenvolvimento Back-End/APIs: Python, Flask (Blueprints), SQLAlchemy ORM
Banco de Dados: Postgre SQL
Autenticação e Segurança: JWT, RBAC (controle de permissões por página/ação), 2 FA por e-mail
Integrações e ETL: Importação e processamento de XML e arquivos ZIP/TXT layout fixo (SIGTAP e bases de saúde)
Mensageria/Eventos: Apache Kafka e Zookeeper
Dev Ops e Versionamento: Docker, Docker Compose, scripts Power Shell (build/restart), Git (fluxo Git Lab)
Desejável:
Experiência com React Native (app mobile);
Por que escolher a Ciberian?
Valorizamos as relações humanas e o desenvolvimento profissional;
Ambiente que incentiva a inovação e criatividade;
Projetos desafiadores com impacto real na sociedade;
Cultura colaborativa e de aprendizado contínuo;
Comprometimento com a excelência técnica. Benefícios:
Benefício flexível para alimentação/refeição (i Food);
Plano de saúde;
Assistência odontológica;
Assistência psicológica;
Parcerias educacionais;
Total Pass (acesso a academias e atividades físicas);
Avus Saúde (descontos em exames, farmácias e consultas médicas);
Vale Transporte. Buscamos pessoas apaixonadas por tecnologia, que queiram fazer parte de uma empresa em constante evolução. Se você se identifica com nossa cultura e quer trabalhar em projetos desafiadores, venha fazer parte do nosso #time Ciberian!

description:
Requisitos para inscrição!!!
Formação Graduação em Engenharia e desejável Pós Graduação em Engenharia de Segurança;
Conhecimento ferramentas Google e Pacote Office;

title: Professor de inglês - vocabulário -  -  lauro de freitas
description:
Empresa
A Superprof permite que milhares de pessoas encontrem professores particulares e aprendam em mais de 2000 disciplinas : matemática, inglês, desenho, esportes e muito mais...
Em 10 anos, a Superprof se tornou líder mundial em aulas particulares, com presença em mais de 70 países.
A chave para o sucesso? Oferecer aos professores máxima flexibilidade, liberdade e um modelo de comissão de 0%. Vantagens
Gratuito, aberto e sem intermediários, a Superprof oferece a você a oportunidade de dar aulas particulares e compartilhar seu conhecimento na matéria que você escolher.
Criar seu anúncio leva apenas alguns minutos, é fácil e totalmente gratuito.
Milhares de alunos encontraram seu professor na Superprof todos os dias.
Como funciona?
- Você publica seu anúncio de professor gratuitamente
- Os alunos entram em contato com você.
- Você ministra suas aulas e recebe o pagamento diretamente com o aluno
Com a Superprof, você escolhe:
- Seus preços: entre R$40 e R$120 por hora, por exemplo
- Os alunos que você ensina
- O pagamento será feito via diretamente pelo aluno.
- Seu horário com 100% de flexibilidade de horários
- Para ministrar suas aulas presencialmente ou online.
A melhor parte? Atendimento ao cliente disponível 24 horas por dia, 7 dias por semana, via e-mail, para responder às suas perguntas. Descrição
Olá! Eu gostaria de fazer aulas de Inglês - Vocabulário, para melhorar meu nível. Existem professores disponíveis para 2h-4h por fim de semana em Lauro de Freitas? Obrigado por sua resposta!
Habilidades buscadas
Em todas as aulas ministradas na Superprof, sua seriedade e profissionalismo são nossa prioridade.
Portanto, esperamos que você seja:
- Pontual.
- Reativo.
- Um bom professor
- Educado
- Disponível
- Apaixonado
- Legal !
Estamos convencidos de que essas qualidades são a chave para conduzir seus alunos ao sucesso que buscam.

title: Mainframe storage engineer (home office)
description:
ITTConnect is seeking a Senior Mainframe Storage Engineer (IBM z OS systems) to work remotely for a client in the US. This is a potentially long term position with a client that is a global leader in consulting, digital transformation, technology and engineering services present in nearly 50 countries. This client is working with one of the major players in the mainframe technology and tools area.
Job location: Remote, work from home anywhere in Brazil .
All interviews will be in English only (must be professionally fluent).
We are seeking an experienced Mainframe System Engineer to join our team and provide operational, consultancy, and migration support in a complex IBM Z environment. The ideal candidate will have deep expertise in mainframe operations, storage administration , and migration projects involving IBM and CA products. This role requires strong technical proficiency, problem-solving skills, and the ability to collaborate effectively across teams to ensure seamless system operations and migrations.
Job responsibilities :
Manage and support mainframe operations, ensuring high availability and performance.
Provide consultancy and technical assistance for migration projects
Implement and configure IBM storage solutions such as DFSMSrmm , DFSMShsm , and related advanced audit and reporting tools. Assist with installation and configuration of IBM OMEGAMON for Storage and other monitoring tools.
Develop and maintain JCL scripts, REXX, and Assembler programs for automation and operational efficiency.
Utilize TSO and ISPF for system management and troubleshooting.
Collaborate with storage administrators to assess migration impacts and provide training/documentation.
Ensure compliance with system standards and best practices for SMP/E and z/OS environments.
Key skills : Mainframe Operations Expertise: Minimum 5+ years in mainframe operations, service, or support roles. Proficiency in TSO , ISPF , and JCL . Ability to write REXX and Assembler programs. Experience with DFSMSrmm and/or CA-1 Tape Management System . Hands-on experience with IBM tools such as: >> IBM OMEGAMON for Storage
>> IBM Advanced Audit and Reporting for DFSMShsm
>> IBM Advanced Catalog Management (ACM)
>> IBM Advanced Allocation Management (AAM) Ability to migrate tools, including the following, within mainframe systems >> CA-1 to DFSMSrmm migration (configuration, installation, JCL code, runtime parameters).
>> CA FAVER to IBM Advanced Catalog Management migration (customized JCL creation).
>> IBM Global Resource Serialization (GRS) migration (training, PARMLIB member creation,
operational considerations).
>> CA Allocate to IBM Advanced Allocation Management migration (installation, configuration, training). Strong written and verbal communication skills for documentation and stakeholder interaction.
Preferred Skills and Proficiencies: Knowledge of IBM Z system operation and configuration, including SMP/E . Familiarity with competing products and migration strategies.
Experience with Storage Administration on IBM Z . Migration experience across IBM and CA products with ability to create customized JCL and runtime parameters.

title: Software engineer sênior - vaga afirmativa para pessoas lgbtqiapn+
description:
A abertura atual é para a Artefact do Brasil, mas estamos em modelo Free Office. Quem nós somos
Nós da Artefact Brasil acreditamos e vivemos uma cultura com base na empatia!
Um ambiente de trabalho saudável é um lugar onde todas as vozes são ouvidas, respeitadas e valorizadas.
Temos como nosso compromisso a construção de um ambiente mais diverso e inclusivo, porque a empatia é para todas as pessoas, independentemente de etnia, cor, gênero, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou crença religiosa.
Queremos conosco mentes e corações incríveis! Venha ser Artefact ! title: Itsm support specialist
description:
We are looking for an Ivanti ITSM Specialist to take over the managed support and administration of an existing Ivanti environment. The main goal is to ensure platform stability, manage day-to-day operations, and support the ITSM application while parallel assessments are running.
Key Responsibilities Platform Administration: Handle day-to-day configuration and maintenance of the Ivanti ITSM platform. Queue Management: Manage incident and request queues, performing triage and ensuring timely resolution. User Management: Administer users, groups, and maintain the service catalog. Reporting: Generate and maintain dashboards and operational reports as needed. Maintenance & Support: Provide minor enhancements and break-fix support to ensure \"nothing stops, nothing breaks.\"
Vendor Liaison: Act as the point of contact with Ivanti vendors for technical escalations. Technical Requirements (Must-haves) Experience: Proven experience administering Ivanti Service Management (ISM) or Ivanti Neurons for ITSM . ITSM Knowledge: Strong understanding of IT Service Management processes (Incident, Request, Change management). Reporting: Ability to run and customize reports within the Ivanti environment.
Soft Skills: Proactive \"keep the lights on\" mindset, ability to work independently, and clear communication.

title: Senior data engineer
description:
Company: Fraud Deflect
Role: Senior Data Engineer
Language: Native/fluent English. Resumes in English.
About the role
Maintain and evolve Fraud Deflect’s data stack: reliable pipelines, strong data models, and stable production operations on Linux. Focus is improving what exists, not rewriting everything.
Responsibilities
Own data architecture and data modeling for core datasets.
Maintain and improve existing pipelines (stability, backfills, performance, data quality).
Build/operate Airflow workflows (SLAs, retries, alerting, idempotency).
Write and optimize SQL in My SQL (schemas, migrations, indexing, query tuning).
Develop pipeline/tooling code in Python.
Operate and debug on Linux (services/jobs, logs, incidents, automation).
Work within the current stack (Airflow, AWS, My SQL; Click House is a plus).
Add basic observability; dashboards/visuals are a plus.
Communicate clearly; apply strong analytical thinking and problem-solving.
Required
Strong My SQL/SQL.
Airflow in production.
AWS experience.
Python proficiency.
Comfortable maintaining systems on Linux.
Strong communication, critical thinking, and troubleshooting skills.
Nice to have
Observability/visualization (metrics, dashboards, alerting).
Prior Clickhouse experience.
How to apply
Send an English resume and links to APIs/code/docs showing Python, Clickhouse, SQL, automation, and payments/chargebacks work.

title: L3 support engineer
description:
Job Title: L3 Support Engineer (Linux / Kubernetes / Open Shift / Open Stack)
Location: Remote
Job Summary:
Looking for an L3 Support Engineer with strong expertise in Linux and hands-on experience in Kubernetes, Open Shift, and Open Stack . This role focuses on advanced troubleshooting, system stability, and supporting critical infrastructure in a fast-paced production environment.
Key Responsibilities: Provide L3 production support for Linux-based systems and cloud/container platforms. Troubleshoot and resolve complex issues related to Kubernetes, Open Shift, and Open Stack environments. Perform root cause analysis (RCA) and implement permanent fixes for recurring incidents. Monitor system performance, availability, and reliability, ensuring minimal downtime . Collaborate with L1/L2 support, Dev Ops, and engineering teams for issue resolution and improvements. title: Devops engineer
description:
We're looking for a  Dev Ops / Cloud Lead who knows how to design, automate, and operate cloud infrastructure.
This role focuses heavily on  Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) due to a strategic partnership in that ecosystem. Many of our clients are migrating infrastructure to OCI or need help operating multi-cloud environments.
We need someone who can design solutions, automate processes, and solve infrastructure problems, not just maintain pipelines.

Why this role exists
We have a strategic partnership with Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI). Clients are asking us to migrate infrastructure to OCI, and many of them also need ongoing Dev Ops operations and architecture support.
We need someone who can own this technically. Not just executing tasks, but executing the task is an important part of the job as well.
Design solutions. Talk to clients. Automate migrations. Coordinate engineers. And when necessary, jump in and fix things yourself.

TL; DR
You will help lead cloud and Dev Ops initiatives at Quave. Your job is to:
Lead cloud migrations to OCI
Design cloud architectures
Automate migrations and infrastructure
Coordinate Dev Ops engineers
Talk directly to clients
Help build repeatable Dev Ops processes You must be strong in OCI, comfortable with AWS / Azure / GCP, hands-on, obsessed with automation, and comfortable discussing technical architecture with clients.
English is a plus, not required.

This is not a ticket-based Dev Ops job
If you're looking for a role where you maintain Jenkins pipelines, restart servers, open support tickets, and wait for instructions, this is not the role for you.
This role is about designing and solving infrastructure problems. We want someone who can look at a system and think:
\" We can automate 80% of this.\"
And then actually build the automation.

What you'll actually do
Cloud Architecture Design infrastructure for systems running in OCI, AWS, Azure, and GCP, migrating from one to another.

Cloud Migrations
A lot of our work will be migrations like AWS → OCI, Azure → OCI, GCP → OCI.
Your job is not just to do the migration, but to help us turn migrations into repeatable processes, scripts, templates, automation and tooling so that each migration becomes easier than the last.

Automation
We want to automate everything that can be automated:
Automated infrastructure provisioning
Migration scripts
CI/CD pipelines
Environment replication
Monitoring setups If you like writing scripts that replace hours of manual work, you'll enjoy this role.

Client Discussions
You will often join calls with clients to understand infrastructure problems, design migration strategies, estimate effort, and propose solutions. You must be comfortable discussing technical topics clearly.

Leading Dev Ops Engineers
As the Dev Ops work grows, you'll coordinate other engineers working on projects, reviewing architecture, guiding implementations, and ensuring quality.

What we're looking for
You probably have many years working with infrastructure. But more importantly, you have good instincts about systems.
You likely:
Love automating infrastructure
Hate manual processes
Can quickly understand unfamiliar systems
Are comfortable debugging production environments
Enjoy designing architectures
Can communicate clearly with both engineers and clients You should also be comfortable using AI tools to accelerate your work. Tools like Chat GPT, Claude, and Cursor can dramatically increase productivity when used well. We expect you to take advantage of that.

Technical Expectations
Cloud
Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) - important
AWS
Azure
GCP Dev Ops
Docker
Kubernetes
Terraform or other Infrastructure-as-Code tools
CI/CD pipelines
Linux systems administration
Networking fundamentals Automation
Comfortable writing scripts in Bash, Python, Go, or similar.
Languages
Portuguese required. English is a plus as some clients are international, so it may eventually become useful in the future, but it's not required.
Why work with Quave
We are a small, profitable, independent company. No investors. No corporate bureaucracy. We focus on doing great work for clients and building great software.
Things we value:  Speed. Quality. Pragmatism. Autonomy.
Quave literally stands for  Quality (Qua) and Velocity (Ve).
Pay and Benefits
This is a full-time remote position. Compensation will depend on experience.
Fully remote work
Flexible hours
22 days paid time off per year
Quarterly bonus based on company performance
AI allowance for productivity tools We work as a distributed team of independent contractors.
Hiring Process
Application review
Technical conversation
Architecture discussion
Conversation(s) with one or more partners This is a leadership role and you will coordinate other engineers as the Dev Ops work grows. But at Quave our leaders are hands-on. You should be comfortable writing automation and infrastructure code yourself when needed.

title: Ai solution architect

This role focuses on designing and delivering enterprise-grade AI-driven automation solutions. Experience with enterprise RPA platforms such as Ui Path or similar.

Experience supporting enterprise Automation or AI Centers of Excellence.
Expertise in establishing architecture standards, reusable components, and automation governance frameworks.

title: Senior azure cloud engineer (temporary contract)
description:
About You
This is a high‑impact senior Azure Cloud / Dev Ops role supporting a Private Equity Group (PEG) platform. The team is greenfield, the infrastructure is new, and the customer is highly selective and security‑conscious. You must operate with strong autonomy, deep hands‑on Azure expertise, and the ability to own cloud architecture end‑to‑end. The expectation is to design, build, operate, and evolve production systems directly.
You will work closely with VP‑level technical stakeholders in an environment where reliability, deployment safety, and clarity in communication are essential. This position requires someone who can challenge assumptions constructively, explain architectural tradeoffs clearly , and operate effectively in ambiguous, early‑stage environments.

Note: This position is offered under a contractor model for a period of 6 months with the possibility of extension.
You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies 5+ years of hands‑on Azure architecture experience, including subscription and resource group strategies, identity and access control (RBAC, managed identities), and end-to-end ownership of production Azure environments. Strong experience designing and operating Azure networking, including VNets, subnets, NSGs, routing, private endpoints, and firewall concepts. Hands‑on production experience with Azure Paa S services, including Azure App Services, Azure Database for Postgre SQL, Azure Front Door, and Azure Storage. Expert-level Kubernetes and AKS operations , including cluster provisioning and upgrades, node pools, scaling strategies, networking integration (CNI, ingress), and workload isolation and security best practices. Production-grade Terraform expertise, including modular design, environment separation, and state management with Azure backends. Strong CI/CD automation experience integrating infrastructure as code and application deployments using Git-based pipelines.
Solid reliability engineering experience , including monitoring and alerting design, incident response and recovery, post-incident analysis, and the ability to reason about availability, scalability, cost optimization, and deployment safety. title: Devops engineer
description:
We're looking for a  Dev Ops / Cloud Lead who knows how to design, automate, and operate cloud infrastructure.
This role focuses heavily on  Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) due to a strategic partnership in that ecosystem. Many of our clients are migrating infrastructure to OCI or need help operating multi-cloud environments.
We need someone who can design solutions, automate processes, and solve infrastructure problems, not just maintain pipelines.

Why this role exists
We have a strategic partnership with Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI). Clients are asking us to migrate infrastructure to OCI, and many of them also need ongoing Dev Ops operations and architecture support.
We need someone who can own this technically. Not just executing tasks, but executing the task is an important part of the job as well.
Design solutions. Talk to clients. Automate migrations. Coordinate engineers. And when necessary, jump in and fix things yourself.

TL; DR
You will help lead cloud and Dev Ops initiatives at Quave. Your job is to:
Lead cloud migrations to OCI
Design cloud architectures
Automate migrations and infrastructure
Coordinate Dev Ops engineers
Talk directly to clients
Help build repeatable Dev Ops processes You must be strong in OCI, comfortable with AWS / Azure / GCP, hands-on, obsessed with automation, and comfortable discussing technical architecture with clients.
English is a plus, not required.

This is not a ticket-based Dev Ops job
If you're looking for a role where you maintain Jenkins pipelines, restart servers, open support tickets, and wait for instructions, this is not the role for you.
This role is about designing and solving infrastructure problems. We want someone who can look at a system and think:
\" We can automate 80% of this.\"
And then actually build the automation.

What you'll actually do
Cloud Architecture Design infrastructure for systems running in OCI, AWS, Azure, and GCP, migrating from one to another.

Cloud Migrations
A lot of our work will be migrations like AWS → OCI, Azure → OCI, GCP → OCI.
Your job is not just to do the migration, but to help us turn migrations into repeatable processes, scripts, templates, automation and tooling so that each migration becomes easier than the last.

Automation
We want to automate everything that can be automated:
Automated infrastructure provisioning
Migration scripts
CI/CD pipelines
Environment replication
Monitoring setups If you like writing scripts that replace hours of manual work, you'll enjoy this role.

Client Discussions
You will often join calls with clients to understand infrastructure problems, design migration strategies, estimate effort, and propose solutions. You must be comfortable discussing technical topics clearly.

Leading Dev Ops Engineers
As the Dev Ops work grows, you'll coordinate other engineers working on projects, reviewing architecture, guiding implementations, and ensuring quality.

What we're looking for
You probably have many years working with infrastructure. But more importantly, you have good instincts about systems.
You likely:
Love automating infrastructure
Hate manual processes
Can quickly understand unfamiliar systems
Are comfortable debugging production environments
Enjoy designing architectures
Can communicate clearly with both engineers and clients You should also be comfortable using AI tools to accelerate your work. Tools like Chat GPT, Claude, and Cursor can dramatically increase productivity when used well. We expect you to take advantage of that.

Technical Expectations
Cloud
Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) - important
AWS
Azure
GCP Dev Ops
Docker
Kubernetes
Terraform or other Infrastructure-as-Code tools
CI/CD pipelines
Linux systems administration
Networking fundamentals Automation
Comfortable writing scripts in Bash, Python, Go, or similar.
Languages
Portuguese required. English is a plus as some clients are international, so it may eventually become useful in the future, but it's not required.
Why work with Quave
We are a small, profitable, independent company. No investors. No corporate bureaucracy. We focus on doing great work for clients and building great software.
Things we value:  Speed. Quality. Pragmatism. Autonomy.
Quave literally stands for  Quality (Qua) and Velocity (Ve).
Pay and Benefits
This is a full-time remote position. Compensation will depend on experience.
Fully remote work
Flexible hours
22 days paid time off per year
Quarterly bonus based on company performance
AI allowance for productivity tools We work as a distributed team of independent contractors.
Hiring Process
Application review
Technical conversation
Architecture discussion
Conversation(s) with one or more partners This is a leadership role and you will coordinate other engineers as the Dev Ops work grows. But at Quave our leaders are hands-on. You should be comfortable writing automation and infrastructure code yourself when needed.

description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, transparência, autenticidade, engenhosidade e empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores? Aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?

Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.


Nosso Cliente

Esta vaga atenderá nosso cliente, uma grande multinacional do segmento de petróleo e gás.


O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

  • Desenvolver aplicações web full stack utilizando combinações de .NET Core , C# , Node.Js , React , Angular ou Vue .
  • Criar e integrar APIs RESTful , garantindo segurança, estabilidade e alta performance.
  • Construir funcionalidades robustas no front-end utilizando frameworks JavaScript modernos.
  • Trabalhar com Azure Web Apps , Azure SQL , Azure Functions e API Management para desenvolver soluções em nuvem escaláveis e seguras.
  • Colaborar em um ambiente Agile/Scrum , participando de refinamentos, plannings, reviews e cerimônias de time.
  • Utilizar GitHub para versionamento, code reviews, integração contínua e boas práticas modernas de desenvolvimento.
  • Realizar troubleshooting, debugging e otimizações de aplicações em ambiente de produção.
  • Implementar práticas de secure coding , garantindo conformidade, segurança e confiabilidade do software.
  • Aplicar habilidades analíticas em automações, manipulação de dados ou geração de insights quando necessário.
  • Contribuir para soluções digitais modernas, escaláveis e orientadas a dados, dentro de um ambiente global e colaborativo.


O que você precisa ter

  • Experiência sólida em desenvolvimento de software full stack.
  • Experiência prática com:
  • .NET Core e C#
  • Pelo menos um framework front-end moderno ( React , Angular , Vue )
  • Node.Js para serviços backend ou full stack com Vue
  • Experiência construindo e consumindo APIs REST .
  • Familiaridade com Azure SQL , Azure Web Apps e práticas de desenvolvimento em nuvem.
  • Entendimento sólido de versionamento com GitHub .
  • Vivência com metodologias ágeis e participação em times Scrum .
  • Conhecimento de boas práticas de secure coding .
  • Inglês avançado (escrita e conversação).


Será um destaque no seu perfil

  • Experiência com Python para analytics, automações ou utilitários backend.
  • Vivência com Azure API Management ou práticas de governança de APIs.
  • Conhecimento de ferramentas de trabalho ágil, como Azure DevOps (ADO) .
  • Capacidade de aplicar conceitos básicos de dados/analytics para enriquecer funcionalidades.
  • Experiência com consultas OData (especialmente em ADO ou outras APIs).


Onde você vai trabalhar

No conforto da sua casa. A posição é oferecida em regime 100% Home Office , com atuação para um time global e ambiente ágil.

title: Business Process Analyst
description:

  • Location: Brazil, Colombia, or Costa Rica (Remote)
  • Employment Type: Full-Time (FTE)
  • Salary: BRL 8,000/month
  • Contract Period: April 20, 2026 – November 30, 2026


About the Role

We are seeking a detail-oriented and analytical Business Process Analyst I to support the design, optimization, and visibility of Go-To-Market (GTM) processes. This role will work cross-functionally with Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and Operations teams to improve execution efficiency, standardize metrics, and enhance overall business performance.


Key Responsibilities

1. GTM Process Design & Documentation

  • Document and refine key GTM execution processes, including:
  • Lead and demand handoffs
  • Opportunity and deal flow
  • Adoption, renewals, and expansion motions
  • Clarify ownership, handoffs, and stage expectations across teams
  • Identify execution gaps, friction points, and inconsistencies
  • Develop clear process maps, documentation, and lightweight playbooks

2. GTM Metrics & Execution Visibility

  • Define and standardize core GTM execution metrics (e.G., conversion rates, pipeline health, deal velocity, renewals)
  • Ensure clear metric definitions and alignment across teams
  • Build simple dashboards or reporting views to highlight execution risks and performance gaps
  • Analyze data and provide actionable insights to drive process improvements

3. Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Facilitate working sessions with stakeholders across Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and Operations
  • Capture key decisions and translate them into structured documentation
  • Support ongoing initiatives with data-driven analysis and consistent follow-through


Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Engineering, or a related field
  • 1–3 years of experience in business analysis, operations, or process improvement
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Experience with process mapping and documentation
  • Familiarity with CRM tools (e.G., Salesforce) and reporting/dashboard tools is a plus
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment

Preferred Skills

  • Experience with GTM processes or Revenue Operations

  • Basic understanding of data analysis tools (Excel, BI tools, etc.)

You will have regular career conversations with your manager where you will discuss your short and long-term career goals. We are committed to helping you develop in your career and offer the potential for internal mobility opportunities

title: Full-Time Social Ads Specialist
description:
About Us

BlueTuskr is a U.S.-based digital marketing agency specializing in e-commerce brands. As we continue to expand our paid advertising efforts across client accounts, we’re looking for a full-time Social Ads Specialist with strong technical (conversion tracking) and analytical skills, as well as proven client-facing experience. This role is 100% focused on paid social advertising — not SEO, not organic social.


What You’ll Do

As a Social Ads Specialist, you will manage a portfolio of social ad accounts for our clients, the majority of which are e-commerce sellers. You will be responsible for optimization, budgeting, monitoring, interpreting data and analytics, and clearly communicating campaign performance and strategy directly with clients. You will also stay current on new strategies, techniques, and processes that can improve campaign performance.


Platforms will primarily include Facebook and Instagram, with potential exposure to, Pinterest, and TikTok.


We are looking for someone who is self-motivated, analytical, demonstrates excellent written and verbal communication skills, and can confidently own both campaign performance and client relationships. This includes leading client calls, presenting performance insights, and acting as a strategic partner.


This role requires a strong understanding of post-iOS14 conversion strategies, audience targeting (lookalikes, custom audiences, interests, etc.), placements, and campaign structure. You must also be able to maintain accurate conversion tracking, including pixel setup, event configuration, and event prioritization.


More specifically, in this role you will:

  • Execute and optimize paid social campaigns across multiple client accounts
  • Own client communication, including leading calls and presenting performance updates
  • Measure and report campaign performance against goals (ROI and KPIs)
  • Recommend, execute, and analyze testing strategies for clients
  • Strategize ways to improve overall campaign performance
  • Stay current on the latest paid ads trends and platform updates


What We’re Looking For

  • 4+ years of proven experience managing paid social campaigns for e-commerce brands (especially Meta)
  • 2+ years of experience working within an agency environment (either in-house or servicing agency clients)
  • Proven client-facing experience, including leading calls and managing client relationships


What This Role Is NOT

This is not an SEO role, not organic social media management, and not content creation or community management. If your experience is not primarily in paid advertising, this role is not the right fit.


Time Commitment

title: Geólogo(A) Pleno De Exploração
description:
Geólogo(a) Pleno de Exploração

Local: Santaluz, BA

Quantidade de Vagas: 01

Modelo de Trabalho: FIFO (Fly In Fly Out – 19x11)

Modelo de trabalho em que o(a) profissional permanece 19 dias consecutivos em campo, seguidos de 11 dias de folga. Durante o período de trabalho, a atuação é 100% presencial na unidade operacional.

Sobre a Oportunidade

O(a) Geólogo(a) Pleno de Exploração será responsável por planejar e executar atividades de pesquisa e exploração mineral de ouro, incluindo sondagens, amostragens, mapeamento, modelamento e interpretações geológicas. Atua na geração e validação de alvos exploratórios, controle geológico de sondagem e atualização do modelo geológico do depósito aurífero. Contribui para a avaliação do potencial do ouro nas áreas de interesse, expansão de recursos e reservas minerais e cumprimento das exigências legais, assegurando a manutenção dos alvarás de pesquisa e lavra.

Principais Responsabilidades

  • Executar atividades de mapeamento geológico, interpretação de dados geofísicos e geoquímicos e amostragens em programas de pesquisa mineral, orientando tecnicamente as equipes de campo;
  • Controlar e acompanhar campanhas de sondagem, realizando descrição de testemunhos (litologias, estruturas, alterações e mineralizações) e garantindo os protocolos de QA/QC;
  • Desenvolver, implementar e monitorar sistemas de garantia e controle de qualidade dos dados de exploração, assegurando sua utilização nos processos de modelamento e estimativa de recursos e reservas;
  • Gerar mapas, seções geológicas e produtos técnicos para caracterização e avaliação das áreas de pesquisa e frentes de lavra;
  • Realizar inserção, controle e gestão de banco de dados geológicos, garantindo organização, rastreabilidade e confiabilidade das informações;
  • Elaborar relatórios técnicos e normativos, atender exigências regulatórias e participar de auditorias técnicas, assegurando a qualidade e acuracidade das informações reportadas.

Requisitos Obrigatórios

  • Formação Superior Completa em Geologia;
  • Experiência em exploração mineral (mapeamento, sondagem e modelamento geológico);
  • Experiência comsoftwares de modelagem geológica (ex: Leapfrog e ArcGIS);
  • Disponibilidadepara atuar em regime FIFO (19x11).

Requisitos Desejáveis

  • Experiência com depósitos de ouro, cobre ou metais básicos;
  • Conhecimento emsistemas auríferos: Orogênicos/Narrow veins.

title: Clinical Trial Associate Ii
description:
Clinical Trial Associate IIResumo da Posição O Clinical Trial Associate II desempenha um papel fundamental de suporte no planejamento, execução e encerramento de estudos clínicos nacionais e internacionais, com crescente autonomia e independência operacional. Com base em experiências prévias em operações de estudos clínicos, espera-se que o CTA II gerencie proativamente a documentação e os processos principais, identifique e resolva desafios operacionais, e atue como um ponto de coordenação confiável entre as equipes de estudo, fornecedores e centros de pesquisa. Este cargo também contribui para melhorias de processos e apoia a equipe na preparação para auditorias e inspeções.Principais Responsabilidades: - Fornecer suporte operacional para a execução bem-sucedida dos estudos clínicos, do desenvolvimento do protocolo até o encerramento do estudo, em conformidade com as Boas Práticas Clínicas (GCP) e normas regulatórias internacionais. - Gerenciar de forma independente os controles dos estudos clínicos, incluindo acompanhamento de documentos regulatórios, progresso de start-up, métricas de recrutamento, registros de faturas/pagamentos e desempenho de fornecedores, assegurando precisão, consistência e atualizações em tempo hábil. - Coordenar reuniões de estudos clínicos (internas e externas), incluindo preparação de agendas, logística dos encontros e atas detalhadas com ações de acompanhamento. - Apoiar a supervisão de fornecedores e CROs, acompanhando entregas, identificando lacunas ou riscos e comunicando-os preventivamente aos Clinical Trial Managers (CTMs). - Auxiliar na preparação e submissão de documentos para Comitês de Ética/Comissões de Ética (IRB/EC) e para órgãos regulatórios, com papel ampliado na gestão de prazos e controle de qualidade. - Realizar revisões contínuas do Trial Master File (TMF) e reconciliações;
liderar atividades de controle de qualidade de documentos com supervisão mínima e contribuir ativamente para o planejamento de prontidão para inspeções. - Coordenar e acompanhar a logística de equipamentos e suprimentos dos estudos clínicos junto a fornecedores e centros. - Colaborar com CTMs e demais áreas para promover melhorias contínuas de processos e contribuir para atualizações de Procedimentos Operacionais Padrão (SOP) e instruções de trabalho. - Assumir responsabilidade por projetos especiais e iniciativas transversais que exijam iniciativa, pensamento analítico e discernimento para resolver problemas.Qualificações - Graduação preferencialmente nas áreas de Ciências Biológicas ou Saúde. - Inglês Fluente - Conhecimento prático demonstrado das diretrizes ICH-GCP e normas regulatórias aplicáveis;
experiência prévia no suporte a TMF, CTMS e atividades de controle de qualidade documental é obrigatória. - Fortes habilidades interpessoais e de comunicação escrita;
confortável em interagir com áreas como Garantia da Qualidade, Gerenciamento de Dados, Bioestatística, Segurança e Suprimentos Clínicos. - Capacidade de antecipar as necessidades da equipe, tomar iniciativa e propor soluções em um ambiente dinâmico. - Confortável em lidar com dados sensíveis, exercendo discrição adequada.Contratação no regime PJ, posição remota com disponibilidade para viagens internacionais conforme necessidade.

Key Responsibilities: Project Planning & Execution:Define projectscope, objectives, and deliverablesfor cybersecurity and IT infrastructure projects. Provide regular project status updates, performance metrics, and risk assessments to clients, senior management, and team members. Facilitate meetings, gather feedback, and manage expectations to maintain alignment with project goals and client needs. Coordinate testing, user acceptance, and security reviews on project outputs (e.G., new system implementations, policy rollouts). Strong understanding ofIT systems, networks, and cybersecurity fundamentalsto effectively communicate with technical teams and align projects with security best practices. Proficiency with project management tools (e.G., MS Project, Jira, or Trello) for planning, tracking, and reporting. Skilled in developing project documentation and managing project scope changes. Capacity to anticipate challenges, craft mitigation strategies, and adapt to evolving project needs. Must be detail-oriented but also able to see the big picture to ensure projects deliver strategic value. Preferred Qualifications: Advanced Knowledge:Familiarity withcybersecurity frameworks(e.G., NIST CSF, ISO 27001) and regulatory standards (e.G., GDPR, HIPAA) to integrate compliance into project plans. Background innetwork/security infrastructure projectsor software development projects is advantageous. Methodologies:Certifications or hands-on experience withAgile/Scrummethodologies (e.G., Certified Scrum Master) orDevOps/DevSecOpspractices. Experience Requirements: Experience:7+ yearsof experience in project management within the IT or cybersecurity domain. Leadership experience in a matrixed or cross-functional team environment is essential. postgraduate qualification preferred. Strong quantitative, analytical, and communication skills;
fluency inPortuguese and English. Must meetfit and properstandards withno disqualifying factors, including: not to have been declared bankrupt or insolvent;
unblemished reputation;
knowledge of the line of business, the services to be provided and the crypto segment, as well as crypto market dynamics and the risks associated with those activities;
technical capability, compatible with the functions to be exercised. not having been previously rejected or investigated by the Central Bank of Brazil within the past three years for submitting false, omitted, or inconsistent information in any authorization request

title: Manager, Corporate Development - M&A Origination & Deal Sourcing
description: Gemini Group (csigemini.Com) is part of Constellation Software Inc. (TSX: CSU), a global acquirer, builder, and manager of vertical market software businesses. Gemini partners with high-quality software companies, providing long-term operational support, capital, and strategic guidance to help them grow sustainably. Our portfolio spans multiple vertical markets and operates through decentralized business units that are deeply embedded in their respective industries. Learn more here: csigemini.ComThe Role The Manager, Corporate Development will play a critical role in identifying, building, and nurturing strategic relationships that lead to new acquisition opportunities for Gemini Group.In this role, you will engage with software company leaders. Your success will be measured by your ability to cultivate meaningful, trust-based relationships that ultimately result in Gemini acquiring high-quality software businesses. Relationship-building in this role is a long-term endeavor - often taking multiple years from first contact to acquisition. Success requires persistence, strategic thinking, disciplined pipeline management, high-quality market research, and a consistent ability to add value across many conversations.As Gemini continues to expand its presence globally, this Brazil based role will also play a foundational part in helping scale Gemini's M&A capability in the LATAM market. Over time, the Manager, Corporate Development will have the opportunity to contribute to the growth of a localized M&A function - including shaping best practices and helping establish Gemini as a preferred partner for LATAM software entrepreneurs. This is a unique chance to be a builder of Gemini's deal-sourcing footprint in Brazil while advancing your own leadership trajectory within the organization.Key Outcomes Develop, manage, and expand an M&A pipeline using Salesforce CRM, including market mapping within assigned software verticals. Meet and exceed weekly and quarterly sourcing and relationship-building KPIs. Work both independently and in collaboration with Gemini's M&A leadership to efficiently evaluate potential acquisition opportunities. Ensure accurate categorization and allocation of leads within relevant portfolio verticals. Effectively screen and qualify opportunities at the top of the acquisition funnel to support Portfolio Managers and operating teams. Support the long-term build-out of Gemini's LATAM/Brazil M&A presence by contributing to sourcing processes, knowledge sharing, and future team development. Engage directly with founders, CEOs, and controlling shareholders, conducting high-quality M&A conversations to understand ownership dynamics, M&A insights, motivations, business insights and timing of a future, potential deal. Qualify opportunities through initial commercial, operational, and financial assessment, filtering deals before internal escalation. Coordinate internally with global teams (Perseus / CSI) to align on pipeline prioritization and strategic fit. Maintain structured tracking of interactions and insights (CRM-driven), ensuring continuity and depth of relationship over time.Relevant Experience & Competencies At least three years of experience in M&A business development, with proven involvement in various aspects of M&A such as mandate origination (including private equity), initial contact with key decision-makers, deal negotiation, or client-facing roles in M&A or finance within the software or technology sector. Experience in outbound deal origination planning. Previous exposure on relationship-building meetings (virtual or in-person) with company owners to explore strategic M&A opportunities. Demonstrated interest in building a long-term career in software investing, M&A, or corporate development. Track record of high performance in business development, entrepreneurship, or other competitive environments. Strong executive presence with the ability to confidently engage senior leaders, including CEOs, investors, and advisors. Highly organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable working autonomously. Self-motivated, proactive, and results-driven with a strong sense of urgency.Other Requirements Willingness to travel occasionally within Brazil and broader LATAM as well as internationally to Canada, the U.S., and Portugal. Professional working proficiency in both English and Portuguese is required. Professional working proficiency in Spanish is a bonus.

title: Research Engineer, Multimodal
description:
The Role We are looking for aResearch Engineer, Multimodalto help deliver frontier-quality multimodal datasets, evaluations, and RL environments that improve state-of-the-art models for leading AI labs and enterprise clients.This is a hands-on, research-facing technical role. You will work directly with customer researchers and engineers to turn their multimodal model improvement goals into concrete data specs — designing tasks that test genuine cross-modal reasoning, not just text comprehension with images attached.We're targeting candidates with roughly 4–5 years of experience building or improving multimodal AI systems — especially where strong results depended on data curation across modalities, evaluation design, or building systems that handle the complexity of real-world documents, charts, and visual interfaces.What You'll Do 1. Design and deliver multimodal datasets and evaluation environments Work with customer researchers to define data requirements for multimodal capabilities: chart reading, document QA, UI understanding, diagram-based reasoning, OCR-aware tasks, and visual grounding. Design task suites that test true multimodal reasoning — tasks where the answer requires integrating information across text, images, tables, and document structure, not just surface-level pattern matching. Build ground-truth signals and verification systems for multimodal tasks, where correctness often depends on spatial relationships, visual context, and cross-reference between modalities. Define task formats and data schemas that capture the full richness of multimodal inputs while remaining tractable for model training.2. Build quality and validation systems for multimodal data Perform deep audits of produced data — spotting subtle errors in visual grounding, incorrect chart readings, OCR artifacts, layout misinterpretations, and ambiguous visual references. Implement automated validation: consistency checks across modalities, format and schema validation, deduplication, and difficulty/diversity controls. Where appropriate, develop synthetic data generation pipelines: programmatic chart/table generation, document layout templating, controlled visual perturbations, and augmentation across visual conditions. 3. Prove impact through evaluations and training runs Design and run evals targeting multimodal capabilities aligned with customer goals. Produce analysis connecting data to outcomes: pre/post comparisons on targeted multimodal tasks, error breakdowns by modality and task type, and ablations identifying which data attributes drive model lift. When needed, run fine-tuning or RL experiments (or partner with research) to demonstrate measurable multimodal improvement. 4. Collaborate with cross-functional delivery teams Provide clear specs, visual examples, and edge cases to engineers, QAs, domain SMEs, and data production groups. Run fast feedback loops grounded in multimodal quality metrics. Review and improve outputs from large-scale multimodal data creation efforts, maintaining a high bar for cross-modal correctness and realism.Who We're Looking For 1. Required Qualifications 4–5 years of experience building or improving AI systems involving multimodal data — images, documents, charts, tables, or visual interfaces combined with text. Hands-on experience with at least one of: document understanding, chart/diagram reasoning, OCR systems, UI understanding, or vision-language models. Strong intuition for what makes a good multimodal task: genuine cross-modal reasoning requirements, clear ground truth, and resistance to text-only shortcuts. Demonstrated ability to be extremely detail-oriented — you catch when a chart label is misread, a table cell is misaligned, or a visual reference is ambiguous. Python proficiency required;
comfort with SQL and structured data workflows strongly preferred. Ability to communicate clearly with researchers and engineers — turning multimodal model goals into concrete data specs.2. Highly valued experience RL or post-training experience: RLHF/RLAIF, reward modeling, verifier training, or environment design applied to multimodal tasks. Experience with vision-language models (CLIP, LLaVA, GPT-4V, Gemini, or equivalent). Agentic evaluation involving visual grounding: browser-use agents, UI navigation, or screen-based task completion. Experience building evaluation frameworks or benchmarks for multimodal systems. Audio/video understanding experience (optional but valued).Why Turing Work directly with the world's leading AI labs on the multimodal datasets and evaluations training the next generation of vision-language models. Real impact: your data will directly shape how models learn to read charts, understand documents, navigate interfaces, and reason across modalities. Talent-dense team with high autonomy, rapid iteration, and an exceptional learning curve.Why Turing Work directly with the world's leading AI labs on the RL environments powering post-training for frontier models. Real impact: your environments and reward systems will directly shape how models learn to reason, act, and improve. Talent-dense team with high autonomy, rapid iteration, and an exceptional learning curve.Values: We are client first : We put our clients at the center of everything we do, because their success is the ultimate measure of our value. We work at Start-Up Speed:We move fast, stay agile and favor action because momentum is the foundation of perfection We are Al forward:We help our clients build the future of Al and implement it in our own roles and workflow to amplify productivity.Advantages of joining Turing: Amazing work culture (Super collaborative & supportive work environment;
5 days a week) Awesome colleagues (Surround yourself with top talent from Meta, Google, LinkedIn etc. as well as people with deep startup experience) Competitive compensation Flexible working hoursDon't meet every single requirement? Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single qualification. Turing is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, protected veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristics. At Turing we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace and celebrate authenticity, so if you're excited about this role but your past experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.For applicants from the European Union, please review Turing's GDPR notice here.

title: Investment Banking Intern
description: Investment Banking Internship - WSO Global Talent Program Our Global Talent Program offers an unparalleled opportunity to gain hands-on experience and build a formidable resume through an immersive, 10-week virtual internship.We are activelyscreening thousands of top students globallyto identify future finance leaders. This highly selective program is offered inpartnership with leading boutique investment banksin key markets, includingthe US, UK, APAC, Europe, MENA markets.Only two students are selected per quarterfor this off-cycle, ongoing program, ensuring a focused and high-impact experience for our interns per geographic region.What You'll Gain: Intensive Financial Training (Weeks 1-2):The internship kicks off with two weeks of rigorous, in-house virtual training led by industry experts. You'll gain a strong foundation in core investment banking skills, including: 3-Statement Financial Modeling Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) Analysis Trading Comparables (Comps) Precedent Transactions Advanced Excel & PowerPoint techniques Industry Research & Sourcing Strategies Real-World Experience (Weeks 3-10):Following successful completion of the initial training and assessments, you'll be introduced to a Managing Director or Partner at one of our boutique investment bank partners. For the next eight weeks, you'll work directly on live projects, providing invaluable support with: Pitch Book Development Valuation Analysis (Comps, DCFs) Financial Modeling Sourcing & Due Diligence Industry and Company Research And other critical tasks to support ongoing deals. We look forward to reviewing your application!
